At some point, once the recovery is firmly rooted, the Fed is likely to start signaling that higher rates are coming. One hint of an eventual rate hike would be the Fed's changing or dropping its pledge to hold rates at record-low levels for an "extended period."

这是一项艰巨的任务。过早提高利率并撤销支持措施可能会阻碍经济复苏；而长期维持低利率并保留政府支持措施则可能引发通货膨胀。

<!--en-->
It's a delicate task. Boosting rates and removing supports too soon could short-circuit the recovery. On the other hand, holding rates low and keeping government supports intact too long could unleash inflation.

虽然美联储没有调整旨在降低抵押贷款利率的计划，但它确实表示会将从房利美和房地美购买的债券规模从2000亿美元削减至1750亿美元，因为这类债券的供应量已经减少。

<!--en-->
Though it didn't change a program to help drive down mortgage rates, the Fed did say it will trim its purchases of debt from Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac to $175 billion, from $200 billion, because the supply of that debt has declined.

在9月底的上一次会议上，美联储同意放缓从房利美和房地美购买1.25万亿美元抵押贷款证券的计划进度，决定在3月底而非年底完成购买。截至目前，美联储已购买了7760亿美元的这类抵押贷款证券。

<!--en-->
At its previous meeting in late September, the Fed agreed to slow the pace of a $1.25 trillion program to buy mortgage securities from Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac. It decided to wrap up the purchases by the end of March instead of at year-end. So far, the Fed has bought $776 billion of the mortgage securities.

美联储降低抵押贷款利率的努力正在取得成效。房地美上周报告称，30年期贷款的平均利率为5.03%，低于去年的6.46%。

<!--en-->
Its efforts to lower mortgage rates are paying off. Rates on 30-year loans averaged 5.03 percent, Freddie Mac reported last week. That's down from 6.46 percent last year.

分析师们表示，尽管美联储将放缓对抵押贷款证券的购买速度，但只要这些购买仍在继续，住房贷款利率应会维持在5%左右的较低水平。⁶该报道引用了美联储的新闻稿内容，同时也提供了分析这些声明的经济学家的观点，从而有助于了解美联储理事会可能的想法。

<!--en-->
Though the Fed will slow its purchases of mortgage securities, rates for home loans should remain low in the 5 percent range as long as the purchases continue, analysts say.⁶
The story quotes from the Fed's press release but also provides analyses from economists who have viewed the statement, giving insight into what the Fed's board may be thinking.

随后，美联储会公布会议纪要。由于从会议召开到纪要发布的间隔时间较长，这些会议中讨论的内容往往新闻价值不高，但有时也能反映出成员们之间的分歧。美联储还会每年向国会提交两次经济报告，主席也会被要求到国会作证。作为主席，本·伯南克在影响经济方面拥有巨大权力。伯南克自2006年起担任美联储主席，一直深度参与引导经济走出大萧条以来最严重的经济衰退。正因如此，他在其他理事会成员中的影响力极为强大。他们常常会根据伯南克的言论和观点来投票。

<!--en-->
Later, the Federal Reserve releases minutes from the meetings. While the newsworthiness of what was discussed in these meetings is often muted as a result of the delay in the time between the meeting and the release of the minutes, they sometimes show disagreements among the members. The Fed also presents a report on the economy to Congress twice a year, and the chairman is called to testify before Congress. As chairman, Ben Bernanke carries tremendous clout in influencing the economy. Bernanke has been chairman of the Fed since 2006, and has been heavily involved in steering the economy out of the biggest economic downturn since the Great Depression. Because of that, his influence among the other board members is tremendous. They often vote based on what Bernanke says and believes.

正因这种影响力，每当伯南克发表讲话时，记者们都会仔细记录并分析他的话语。他在国会及其他场合的演讲都被视为重大新闻。美联储会为媒体提供伯南克及其他理事会成员、银行行长的演讲稿副本。那些多年负责报道美联储和货币政策领域的记者，会试图从这些演讲中寻找线索，以了解理事会成员对经济的看法。[^717]：⁶摘自J. Aversa于2009年11月4日为美联社撰写的《美联储再次承诺将利率维持在历史低位》，版权归2009年美联社所有，经许可转载。56 • 经济话题

<!--en-->
Because of that influence, when Bernanke talks, reporters carefully chronicle and analyze his words. His speeches before Congress and others are considered major news. The Fed makes copies of Bernanke's speeches and the speeches of other board members and bank presidents readily available to the media. Reporters who have spent years covering the Fed and monetary policy will look for clues as to what board members are thinking about the economy in these speeches.
[^717]: ⁶ From "Fed again holds pledge to hold rates at record-lows," by J. Aversa, November 4, 2009, Associated Press. Copyright 2009 by The Associated Press. Reprinted with permission.
56 • It's the Economy

### 专家建议

<!--en-->
*Tips from the Pros*

麦克拉奇报社的经济记者凯文·霍尔谈经济报道经验：

<!--en-->
McClatchy newspapers economics correspondent Kevin Hall on covering the economy:

**做好日程规划：**这有助于督促相关人员履行职责，尤其是在财政部这样的机构。如果政府表示希望能在11月前完成50万套抵押贷款的调整，那就不要等到11月才去报道这件事。在日程表上标明相关事项，以便在9月时就查看数据，判断是否可行。往往在截止日期前数月就能看出趋势。良好的日程规划能促使政策制定者更加积极行事！

<!--en-->
**Keep a calendar:** It helps holding folks accountable, especially in places like the Treasury Department. If the government says it hopes to have 500,000 mortgages modified by November, don't wait until November to write that story. Have something in the calendar so that you check in September to see if the numbers show it is possible or impossible. Trends are often clear months before the deadline. Keeping a good calendar helps you keep policymakers' feet to the fire!

不过也要有所准备。除非你喜欢学术性写作，否则这些演讲可能读起来相当枯燥。许多公开讲话都充斥着对经济走向的长篇复杂解释。负责报道美联储的记者的任务就是将这些讲话简化为最简洁的形式。

<!--en-->
Be forewarned, however. These speeches can be tedious to read unless you're a fan of academic writing. Many of the public comments are filled with long and complicated explanations of where the economy is going. The job for any reporter covering the Fed is to boil the speech down to its simplest form.

以下是美联社一名记者如何开始一篇关于伯南克在国会演讲的报道的：

<!--en-->
Here's how a reporter for the Associated Press began a story about a Bernanke speech to Congress:

美联储主席本·伯南克周二在国会表示，经济正处于“严重收缩”状态。但他也带来了一线希望：如果政府能够扶持脆弱的银行系统，华尔街也能复苏，那么经济衰退或许会在今年结束。

<!--en-->
The economy is suffering a “severe contraction,” Federal Reserve Chairman Ben Bernanke told Congress on Tuesday. But he planted a glimmer of hope that the recession might end this year if the government managed to prop up the shaky banking system, and Wall Street rallied.

伯南克称，继2008年底出现25年来最严重的下滑之后，经济在今年前六个月很可能将继续萎缩。

<!--en-->
Bernanke said the economy is likely to keep shrinking in the first six months of this year after posting its worst slide in a quarter-century at the end of 2008.

伯南克表示希望经济衰退能在今年结束，但这一预测存在重大风险。任何经济好转都取决于美联储和奥巴马政府能否让信贷及金融市场恢复正常运转。

<!--en-->
Bernanke said he hoped the recession will end this year, but that there were significant risks to that forecast. Any economic turnaround will hinge on the success of the Fed and the Obama administration in getting credit and financial markets to operate more normally again.

伯南克对参议院银行委员会说：“只有在这种情况下，我认为当前的经济衰退才有可能在2009年结束，2010年将成为复苏之年。”

<!--en-->
“Only if that is the case, in my view there is a reasonable prospect that the current recession will end in 2009 and that 2010 will be a year of recovery,” Bernanke told the Senate Banking Committee.

再加上美联储主席表示监管机构无意将银行国有化的说法，足以提振华尔街情绪。道琼斯工业平均指数上涨了236点以上，标准普尔500指数也有所上升，而此前这两大指数均在一天前跌至1997年以来的最低水平。

<!--en-->
That along with the Fed chief's remarks that regulators don't intend to nationalize banks was enough to buoy Wall Street. The Dow Jones industrials added more than 236 points and the Standard & Poor's 500 index also rose, a day after both hit their lowest levels since 1997.

任何经济复苏都面临的风险包括：其他国家的经济和金融状况比预期更糟糕，这将损害美国的出口，进一步加剧美国本已脆弱的金融形势。

<!--en-->
Among the risks to any recovery are if economic and financial troubles in other countries turn out to be worse than anticipated, which would hurt U.S. exports and further aggravate already fragile financial conditions in the United States.

另一个担忧是，美联储和其他华盛顿政策制定者可能无法打破恶性循环——不断消失的工作岗位、暴跌的房价以及缩水的储蓄迫使消费者大幅削减开支，进而使经济陷入更严重的下滑态势。而处境艰难的企业则会进一步裁员并采取其他紧缩措施。

<!--en-->
Another concern is that the Fed and other Washington policymakers won't be able to break a vicious cycle where disappearing jobs, tanking home values and shrinking nest eggs are forcing consumers to cut back sharply, worsening the economy's tailspin. In turn, battered companies lay off more people and cut back in other ways.

伯南克表示：“要打破这一负面反馈循环，我们必须在财政刺激措施的基础上，继续采取强有力的政府行动来稳定金融机构和金融市场。”

<!--en-->
“To break that adverse feedback loop, it is essential that we continue to complement fiscal stimulus with strong government action to stabilize financial institutions and financial markets,” Bernanke said.

为重振经济，美联储已将一项关键利率降至历史最低水平，奥巴马最近也签署了价值7870亿美元的刺激计划，内容包括增加政府支出和减税措施。

<!--en-->
In an effort to revive the economy, the Fed has slashed a key interest rate to an all-time low and Obama recently signed a $787 billion stimulus package of increased government spending and tax cuts.

此外，财政部长蒂莫西·盖特纳对备受争议的7000亿美元银行救助计划进行了改革，新增了与私营部门合作收购银行不良资产的内容，并提高了政府在这些银行中的持股比例，期望以此释放信贷。奥巴马政府还将投入750亿美元用于遏制房屋止赎现象。

<!--en-->
In addition, Treasury Secretary Timothy Geithner has revamped a controversial $700 billion bank bailout program to include steps to partner with the private sector to buy rotten assets held by banks as well as expand government ownership stakes in them all with the hopes of freeing up lending. The Obama administration also will spend $75 billion to stem home foreclosures.

伯南克称，这些措施以及其他大胆举措——包括即将启动的旨在增加汽车、教育、信用卡等领域的消费贷款供应的计划——将逐步缓解经济压力并推动经济复苏。他向议员们表示该计划“即将启动”，但未给出具体日期。⁷ 这是经济板块 • 57 投资者也对美联储主席的言论作出了反应。在伯南克之前，美联储主席是艾伦·格林斯潘。如果格林斯潘警告称经济增长过快，投资者就会抛售股票，因为这意味着美联储可能会提高利率以减缓经济增长，进而降低企业利润。反之，如果格林斯潘认为经济需要提振，一些人则可能认为利率会下降，从而促使投资者因预期更高的利润而买入股票。过去，道琼斯工业平均指数及其他股票指数常常会根据美联储主席的讲话或联邦公开市场委员会的决策而涨跌。

<!--en-->
Those and other bold steps including a soon-to-be-operational programto boost the availability of consumer loans for autos, education, credit cards and other things should over time provide relief and promote an economic recovery, Bernanke said. That program is “about to open,” he told lawmakers, without providing an exact date.⁷
It's the Economy • 57
Investors also react to what the Fed chairman says. Before Bernanke, the chairman was Alan Greenspan. If Greenspan warned that the economy was growing faster than it should, investors sold stocks because that meant the Fed might raise interest rates to slow growth, causing profits for companies to ease. Or, if Greenspan believed that the economy needed a boost, some might have believed that interest rates would be lowered, leading investors to want to buy stocks because of the potential for higher profits. It has been common in the past for the Dow Jones Industrial Average and other stock indexes to jump or fall based on the Federal Reserve chairman's comments or a decision by the Federal Open Market Committee.

不过，伯南克比他的前任更易于理解。CNN财经编辑、长期从事经济报道的专家迈伦·坎德尔指出，格林斯潘在谈论经济问题时往往含糊其辞，导致媒体对他的公开表态产生不同解读（Kandel, 2003）。而伯南克虽然不像格林斯潘那样高调，但让报道美联储的工作变得更加容易。

<!--en-->
Bernanke, however, has been easier to understand than his predecessor. Myron Kandel, the CNN Financial Editor and one of the long-time business journalist experts on the economy, noted that Greenspan was evasive about what he actually meant when talking about the economy and pointed out how the media could come away from his public pronouncements with different takes (Kandel, 2003). Bernanke, meanwhile, has maintained a lower profile than Greenspan but has made it easier to cover the Fed.

## 失业率

<!--en-->
*Unemployment Rates*

随着经济状况改善，一个地区或国家的就业岗位数量会增加。当人们开始购买更多产品和服务时，生产这些产品的企业可能会决定雇佣更多工人以满足需求。相反，如果购买商品和服务的人减少，企业则可能会解雇那些不再需要的员工。

<!--en-->
The number of jobs in a region or the country increases as the economy improves. When people start buying more products and services, the companies that make them may decide they need to hire more workers to meet that demand. Or, if fewer people are purchasing goods and services, businesses may fire workers they no longer need to make those goods.

失业率就是衡量这一经济状况的指标。当更多人失业并寻求新工作时，失业率会上升；而当更多人找到工作时，失业率则会下降。失业人员会对经济产生更大影响。由于他们没有收入，很可能减少对非生活必需品的支出。而那些重新找到工作的失业者，则可以通过购买此前因失业而推迟购买的物品来帮助刺激经济。

<!--en-->
The unemployment rate is a measure of this part of the economy. The unemployment rate rises when more people have lost jobs and are looking for new jobs, and it falls when more people find jobs. Workers out of a job have a broader effect on the economy. Because they no longer have an income, they are likely to spend less on goods that are not necessary for them to survive. Unemployed workers who then get jobs may help stimulate the economy by purchasing goods they held off buying until they found employment.

失业问题是美联储关注的主要宏观经济问题之一。他们需要了解失业率是在上升还是下降，以便在必要时通过刺激经济来创造就业机会。

<!--en-->
Unemployment is one of the major macroeconomic issues that the Federal Reserve follows. They want to know if unemployment is rising or decreasing in order to stimulate the economy to produce jobs if needed.

失业率以百分比形式表示。美国劳工统计局通常在每月的第一个星期五发布全国失业报告。（各州的数据以及大都市统计区的数据也通常会一并公布。）除了列出失业率外，这份报告还会详细说明每月新增的就业岗位数量。就业增长可以反映经济增长，其重要性几乎与失业率相当。如果大量新就业者有更多资金用于购买商品和服务，这也可能预示着通货膨胀的潜在风险。[^743]：⁷ 摘自J. Aversa所写的《伯南克：经济正经历“严重收缩”》，2009年2月24日，美联社报道。版权所有2009年美联社，经许可转载。58 • 这是经济板块 以下是报道月度失业率时应遵循的方法：

<!--en-->
The unemployment rate is measured as a percentage. The Bureau of Labor Statistics typically releases the national unemployment report on the first Friday of the month. (State data is also typically available, as is data for metropolitan statistical areas.) But in addition to listing the unemployment rate, this reportalso details the number of new jobs created each month. Job growth can indicate economic growth and is almost as important as the unemployment rate. Job gains can also signal the potential for inflation if there are a number of new workers willing to pay more for goods and services now that they are getting a regular paycheck.
[^743]: ⁷ From “Bernanke: Economy suffering ‘severe contraction,’ ” by J. Aversa, February 24, 2009, Associated Press. Copyright 2009 by The Associated Press. Reprinted with permission.
58 • It's the Economy
Here is how the monthly unemployment rate should be covered:

由于雇主持续削减岗位并推迟招聘，北卡罗来纳州的失业率在3月上升至6%。

<!--en-->
North Carolina's unemployment rate edged up to 6 percent in March as employers continued to slash jobs and postpone hiring.

该州在周二的月度失业报告中称，一个月前的季节性调整后失业率为5.8%，这表明经济仍远未完全复苏。

<!--en-->
A month earlier, the state had a seasonally adjusted rate of 5.8 percent, suggesting that the economy is still far from a full recovery, the state said Tuesday in its monthly unemployment report.

3月份约有76,724名工人报告失业，比2月份多出4,700人；另有36,191人报告已失业六个月或更长时间。

<!--en-->
About 76,724 workers reported losing their jobs in March, 4,700 more than in February, while an additional 36,191 reported being out of a job six months or longer.

制造业的失业人数下降最为严重，因为雇主将生产业务转移到海外并利用了生产效率的提升。建筑行业也出现了就业岗位减少的情况，主要原因是恶劣天气以及商业地产需求的急剧放缓。

<!--en-->
The biggest losses were in manufacturing, as employers moved jobs overseas and took advantage of productivity gains. The construction industry also suffered a decline in jobs, largely because of bad weather and a sharp slowdown in demand for commercial real estate.

北卡罗来纳州银行家协会的经济学家哈里·M·戴维斯表示：“经济增速不足以创造足够多的就业机会。”

<!--en-->
"The economy is just not growing fast enough to create jobs," said Harry M. Davis, an economist for the N.C. Bankers Association.

在阿巴拉契亚州立大学教授经济学的戴维斯称，该州的经济发展速度仅为每年2%，远低于降低失业率所需的3%。

<!--en-->
Davis, who teaches economics at Appalachian State University, said the state's economic output is increasing at an annual rate of 2 percent, well below the 3 percent rate needed for unemployment to fall.

戴维斯表示，随着伊拉克战事结束，预计未来几个月就业市场将逐步改善。他以近期消费者信心、企业利润和商业投资的上升为例，认为这表明雇主可能会重新开始招聘。

<!--en-->
But with the major fighting in Iraq over, the job market is expected to gradually improve during the next few months, Davis said. He pointed to recent increases in consumer confidence, corporate profits and business investment as evidence that employers are likely to start hiring again.

北卡罗来纳州立大学的经济学家迈克尔·L·沃尔登预测，今年的失业率仍将高于5%。“我们进入这次经济衰退时失业率为3.1%，短期内不太可能降至这一水平，”沃尔登说道。

<!--en-->
Michael L. Walden, an economist at N.C. State University, predicts the unemployment rate will remain above 5 percent this year. "We went into this recession with 3.1 percent unemployment, and we're not likely to get down to that anytime soon," Walden said.

全国范围内，3月份的失业率为5.8%，4月份为6%。

<!--en-->
Nationally, unemployment was 5.8 percent in March and 6 percent in April.

一年前，北卡罗来纳州的失业率为6.9%，比现在高0.9个百分点，但州政府官员称，此后的下降具有误导性，主要是计算方式发生变化所致。

<!--en-->
A year ago, North Carolina's unemployment rate was 0.9 percent age points higher, at 6.9 percent, but state officials said the decline since then is misleading and largely the result of changes in the way the rate is calculated.

尽管如此，该州表示，从年度对比来看，这里的就业和失业状况仍好于去年同期——从2002年3月开始，失业人数减少了37,669人，降至249,488人；而就业人数则增加了9,811人，达到390万人。

<!--en-->
Nevertheless, year-to-year comparisons of the employed and unemployed in North Carolina indicate that the job market is better than this time last year, the state said. The number of workers out of a job fell by 37,669 from March 2002 to 249,488, while the number of workers with jobs increased by 9,811 to 3.9 million.

不利的一面是，该州的劳动力——即正在工作或寻找工作的人——较去年减少了27,858人，降至415万人。经济学家称，如此大幅度的下降表明工人们要么离开了该州，要么在经济好转之前放弃了求职。Economy.com负责报道北卡罗来纳州经济的丽莎·安德森表示：“通常情况下，当经济开始复苏时，劳动力规模会扩大。但目前我们并未看到这种情况，这说明人们感到沮丧。”

<!--en-->
On the downside, the state's labor force—made up of people who are working or looking for work—decreased by 27,858 from a year ago to 4.15 million. Economists said a decline of that magnitude is evidence that workers are moving out of the state or giving up on their job searches until the economy improves.
It's the Economy • 59
"Normally, when the economy begins to recover, the labor force grows. We're just not seeing that right now, and that's signaling that people are discouraged," said Lisa Anderson, who follows North Carolina for Economy.com.

两年来失业率的持续上升已经耗尽了该州的失业保险基金。该基金依靠对雇主的季度征税来为非自身过错而失业的工人提供救济金。

<!--en-->
Two years of rising joblessness has emptied the state's unemployment insurance trust fund. Supported by quarterly taxes on employers, the fund provides jobless benefits to workers who lose their jobs through no fault of their own.

在本周征收第一季度税款之前，该州向联邦政府借款5300万美元以继续发放救济金。就业安全委员会的女发言人米歇尔·沃克称，该州已通过最近的税款收入偿还了这笔款项，目前基金中还有2060万美元。该州预计本月还能从雇主那里筹集约2亿美元。⁸ 这篇报道指出，虽然某些行业的就业岗位有所增加，但其他行业却在减少，同时许多失业工人可能已离开该州去寻找工作，或者干脆停止了求职。

<!--en-->
Before collecting first-quarter taxes this week, the state borrowed $53 million from the federal government to continue paying benefits. The state paid the federal government back with the recent tax collections and now has $20.6 million in the trust fund, said Michele Walker, a spokeswoman for the Employment Security Commission. The state still expects to collect about $200 million from employers this month.⁸
The story focuses on the fact that jobs were created in some industries but lost in others and points out that many workers who have lost jobs may have left the state to find employment or simply stopped looking.

这篇报道该如何改进？如果作者能找到一位上个月失业的工人，并通过其经历来讲述故事，就能让读者更直观地了解求职的感受。不过，这篇报道也有大量专家对当地就业市场的分析。商业记者除了报道失业率数据外，还有许多其他方法可以跟踪所在地区的就业情况，其中很多方法有助于提供关于就业状况的更短期概览。

<!--en-->
How could this story have been improved? If the writer had been able to find a worker who had lost his or her job within the past month and used an anecdote of that situation, the story would have brought home to the reader what it is like to be looking for work. But it has plenty of expert quotes analyzing the local job market. There are plenty of other ways that a business reporter can track employment in his or her region without simply reporting the numbers of an unemployment rate. Many of these help give a more short-term overview of what may be happening with jobs.

当企业招聘员工，尤其是大量招聘时，它们很可能会通过新闻稿宣布这一消息。此类新闻稿的标题很可能是“XYZ产品公司将扩建本地工厂并新增200个岗位”。这类报道对读者很有帮助，尤其是那些认为自己可能有资格胜任这些岗位的人。如果报道能提供有关如何申请这些岗位或企业需要招聘哪些类型的工作——如体力劳动、工厂工作、行政助理、软件开发等——的信息，那就更能为读者服务。

<!--en-->
When companies hire workers, particularly a large number of workers, they are likely to announce this move with a news release heralding the event. "XYZ Products to expand local plant and add 200 workers," will likely be the headline on such a release. These stories can be informative to readers, particularly those who think they might be able to fill one of these jobs. Such stories provide a service to the readers if they give information on how to apply for the jobs or what type of jobs the company is looking to fill—manual labor, factory, administrative assistants, software development, etc.

乔治亚州南部的《布莱克希尔时报》就是这样在头版刊登了一篇关于某家企业为当地社区创造就业机会的报道：

<!--en-->
*The Blackshear Times* in south Georgia began a front-page story on a business adding jobs to its community this way:

这家总部位于佛罗里达州杰克逊维尔的公司专为底特律的各大汽车制造商定制厢式车和卡车，它将在韦克罗斯的工业园内建造一座价值240万美元的工厂。

<!--en-->
A Jacksonville, Florida company that customizes vans and trucks for major Detroit automakers will build a $2.4 million plant in Waycross' industrial park.

成立仅23年的Sherrod Vans公司将于周四上午9点在占地25英亩的地块上动工兴建一座面积为69,000平方英尺的厂房，该地块位于工业大道对面、Clayton Homes附近。该公司预计约10个月后即可投入运营，届时将雇佣至少100名当地工人，并计划很快将人数扩大到150人。[^768]：⁸ 摘自A. Martinez于2003年5月7日撰写的《该州失业率升至6%，此前已连续两个月下降》，载于《The News & Observer》报D1版。版权所有2003年《The News & Observer》报，经许可转载。60 • 经济状况 该公司的年度薪资支出预计将超过600万美元。⁹ 关于就业题材的素材来源有很多。有进取心的记者有时可以通过浏览报纸的分类广告来了解企业招聘当地员工的意图。通常，企业在宣布迁址前会先在某一地区发布招聘信息，以观察当地劳动力市场的需求情况。另外需要注意的是，会议委员会会每月发布一份“求职指数”，通过调查全国主要报纸上的招聘广告来追踪对劳动力的需求情况。

<!--en-->
Sherrod Vans, a 23-year-old firm, will break ground Thursday at 9 a.m. on a 69,000 square-foot building located on 25 acres just across Industrial Boulevard from Clayton Homes. The company hopes to be in operationin approximately 10 months, employing at least 100 workers from this area with plans to expand to 150 soon after.
[^768]: ⁸ From "State's jobless rate rises to 6%; up after 2 months of declines," by A. Martinez, May 7, 2003, *The News & Observer*, p. D1. Copyright 2003 by *The News & Observer*. Reprinted with permission.
60 • It's the Economy
Annual payroll for the company is expected to top $6 million.⁹
There are many sources for ideas about employment stories. An enterprising reporter can sometimes find out about a company's intent to hire local workers by scanning his newspaper's classified ads. Often, a business will advertise jobs in an area to see what kind of demand it will get from the local workforce before announcing the move. Also note that the Conference Board releases a monthly Help-Wanted Index that tracks the demand for workers by surveying advertising in major newspapers across the country.

此外，个别企业的裁员事件同样可以是重要的新闻素材。有时，这些裁员事件首次表明某家企业可能正面临财务困境。裁员也可能意味着某个行业正在衰退，或是出现了新的竞争对手抢走了业务。许多企业不愿谈论裁员事宜，也很少通过正式声明来公布此类决定，但心怀不满的工人可能会打电话告知记者。如果企业的管理人员给员工写了说明这一决定的备忘录，那么这份备忘录往往会匿名出现在新闻编辑室的传真机上，尤其是当记者与这些工人建立了联系之后。

<!--en-->
In addition, individual company layoffs can also be important stories. Sometimes, they signal for the first time that a business may be in financial trouble. Layoffs can also be an indication that an industry is slumping or that a new competitor is taking away business. Many companies are not likely to want to discuss layoffs and rarely announce such decisions with a release, but disgruntled workers may call reporters to let them know. If an executive at the business writes a memo to employees explaining the decision, that memo often shows up anonymously on the newsroom fax machine, especially if reporters have cultivated relationships with workers.

然而，还有一种更为可靠的方法可以及时了解裁员情况。一项名为《工人调整与再培训通知法》的联邦法律要求企业在工厂关闭或实施裁员后的60天内通知其员工。这些通知需提交给州劳工部门及地方政府官员，公众也可查阅。如果受影响的员工有工会代表，这些通知也会一并交给劳工官员。如果记者从未看过此类《工人调整与再培训通知法》的备案文件，他或她应该查明当地负责监管这些文件的人员是谁。这些文件中可能包含当地媒体尚未知晓的新闻线索。一般来说，只要企业拥有100名或更多员工，且这些员工的工作时长每周超过20小时、在职时间至少为6个月，就必须提交该法要求的通知。如果工厂关闭会导致至少50名员工失去工作且持续时间超过30天，也属于该法规的覆盖范围。对于裁员而言，若企业拥有500名以上员工，或者即使员工人数不足500名但裁员会导致至少三分之一的员工失业，也属于该法规的适用范畴。

<!--en-->
There is another, more reliable method to find out about layoffs in a timely manner, however. A federal law known as the Worker Adjustment and Retraining Notification Act, or more commonly referred to as the WARN Act, requires businesses to notify their workers within 60 days of a plant closing or a layoff. These notifications are filed with state Labor Departments and local government officials and can be reviewed by the public. The WARN Act notices are also given to labor officials if the affected workers are represented by a union. If a reporter has never looked at a WARN Act filing, he or she should find out who in the area oversees these documents. They can be filled with stories of which the local media outlet was unaware. In general, businesses must file WARN Act notices if they have 100 or more workers, as long as the workers have been on the job for at least six months and work more than 20 hours per week. Plant closings are covered if the shutdown will result in the loss of work for at least 50 workers for more than 30 days. Layoffs are covered under the law if the company has more than 500 workers or more than 50 employees if the layoff will result in at least one third of them losing their job.

找到那些更换工作的人可以带来有趣的就业题材报道，从而让读者了解当地经济状况。当地医院是否存在护士短缺问题？如果有，管理层正在采取哪些措施吸引更多护士来到该地区？像CVS这样的药店连锁店常常会为药剂师提供激励措施，让他们在一段时间内前往小城镇工作。另一个值得关注的就业趋势可能是已经退休的老年工人重新回到职场。他们这样做的原因可能多种多样，包括退休储蓄不足，或是厌倦了居家生活。[^775]：⁹ 摘自R. Williams于2002年9月25日撰写的《定制厢式车工厂将为当地创造100多个就业岗位》，载于《The Blackshear (Georgia) Times》报第1版。版权所有2002年《The Blackshear Times》报，经许可转载。经济状况 • 61

<!--en-->
Finding workers who have changed jobs can lead to interesting employment stories that give a glimpse into the local economy. Is there a nursing shortage at the local hospital? If so, what are administrators doing to attract more nurses to the area? Drug store chains such as CVS often provide incentives for pharmacists to move to small towns for a certain time period. Another interesting employment trend may be that elderly workers who have already retired are rejoining the workforce. This may be for various reasons, but could include thefact that they did not save enough for retirement or simply became bored with staying at home.
[^775]: ⁹ From “Customizing van facility means 100+ jobs for area,” by R. Williams, September 25, 2002, *The Blackshear* (Georgia) *Times*, p. 1. Copyright 2002 by *The Blackshear Times*. Reprinted with permission.
It's the Economy • 61

### 汽车与房屋销售

<!--en-->
*Auto and Home Sales*

当人们花钱购买生活所需的商品和服务时，经济学家及其他希望了解消费者支出趋势的人会密切关注他们的消费行为。其中最常被追踪的两大项目就是汽车销售和房屋销售。这两类高价商品的增减情况能够很好地反映经济的走向。虽然就业数据可以告诉读者消费者是否有能力消费，但具体商品的销售数据能提供更直观的信息，因为它能体现消费者愿意花费这笔钱的程度。

<!--en-->
When people spend money buying goods and services to live, economists and others wanting to get a feel for consumer spending trends watch and track their expenditures closely. Two of the biggest items tracked are sales of automobiles and sales of houses. Increases and decreases in both of these big-ticket items can give a good picture of where the economy is headed. Whereas employment information may tell readers whether a consumer has the ability to spend money, information about sales for specific items gives an even better picture because it shows how willing a consumer is to spend that money.

各汽车制造商及美国经济分析局通常会在每月末立即发布轿车与卡车的销售数据。汽车销量会随经济状况呈现周期性变化，同时也与利率密切相关。当利率较低时，消费者更有动力购买汽车。汽车销售约占该国国内生产总值的5%，但由于车辆属于“非必需”消费品，因此常被用作衡量消费者行为的指标。汽车销量上升可能意味着消费者对工作和经济状况满意，愿意花钱购买新车；而汽车销量下滑则可能表明消费者对经济感到担忧。

<!--en-->
Individual automakers and the Bureau of Economic Analysis typically release sales statistics for cars and trucks right after the end of the month. Auto sales can be cyclical, depending on the economy, and are tied to interest rates as well. If interest rates are low, then there is an incentive for consumers to purchase cars. Car sales are about 5 percent of the country's Gross Domestic Product, but since vehicle sales are considered "discretionary" purchases, they are often examined as a barometer for consumer behavior. Increasing car sales likely mean that consumers are happy with their jobs and the economy and feel comfortable spending money on a new vehicle. If car sales slump, the decline could be an indication that consumers are worried about the economy.

长期投入大量记者资源报道汽车行业的《底特律新闻报》通常会以如下方式报道汽车销售情况：

<!--en-->
Here is how *The Detroit News*, a paper that spends a lot of reporter resources and time covering the auto industry, typically covers car sales:

由于优惠措施充足、热门新产品涌现以及国家经济状况改善，4月美国汽车销量同比增长2.8%，为今年首度回升。

<!--en-->
U.S. auto sales rose 2.8 percent in April—the first gain of the year—as generous incentives, popular new products and an improving national economy drew shoppers to showrooms.

位于俄勒冈州班登的CNW营销公司顾问Art Spinella表示：“消费者信心依然非常强劲。除了持续的优惠政策外，我不确定还有其他原因能解释这一强劲表现。”

<!--en-->
"Consumer confidence remains very strong," said Art Spinella, a consultant with CNW Marketing in Bandon, Ore. "I'm not sure there's any other reason (for the strong showing) than continued incentives."

据估计，4月汽车制造商售出了145万辆新车，高于2001年同期的135万辆。

<!--en-->
Automakers sold an estimated 1.45 million new vehicles in April, up from 1.35 million in April 2001.

根据Autodata Corp的数据，4月新轿车、皮卡、迷你货车及SUV的年化销售量为1740万辆，而去年同期为1665万辆。

<!--en-->
New cars, pickups, minivans and SUVs sold at an annualized rate of 17.4 million units in April, compared with 16.65 million a year earlier, according to Autodata Corp.

随着收入增加、失业率下降以及其他经济健康迹象的出现，汽车制造商现在预计今年美国汽车销量有望达到1700万辆甚至更高，高于此前1500万辆的预估。

<!--en-->
With incomes rising, unemployment falling and other signs of a healthy economy, automakers now forecast U.S. auto sales could rise to 17 million units or more this year, up from previous estimates as low as 15 million units.

今年以来，新车及轻型卡车的需求仅比2001年的强劲水平低1.7%。

<!--en-->
So far this year, demand for new cars and light trucks is off just 1.7 percent from strong 2001 levels.

4月的销售数据促使通用汽车公司将第二季度的预期产量从之前的150万辆上调至153万辆。克莱斯勒则计划在其17家北美工厂中的14家安排加班生产。

<!--en-->
April's showing prompted General Motors Corp. to bump up planned output during the second quarter to 1.53 million vehicles from an earlier forecast of 1.5 million. Chrysler plans to run overtime at 14 of 17 North American factories.

由于销售情况远好于预期，汽车制造商们开始减少那些在9·11恐怖袭击后用于维持需求的昂贵折扣和融资优惠，这有望提升他们的利润水平。62 • 经济因素的影响 通用汽车旗下本土品牌4月的销量增长了12.4%，位居首位；戴姆勒克莱斯勒集团的克莱斯勒品牌销量增长了2.8%。只有处境不佳的福特汽车公司该月销量下降了8%。

<!--en-->
With sales shaping up much stronger than expected, automakers arestarting to pull back on the expensive discounts and financing deals that helped sustain demand after the Sept. 11 terrorist attacks. This could improve their profit pictures.
62 • It's the Economy
GM led the way in April with a 12.4 percent sales gain for its domestic brands. DaimlerChrysler AG's Chrysler Group logged a 2.8 percent improvement. Only troubled Ford Motor Co. finished the month with a decline of 8 percent.

亚洲汽车制造商在美国市场的销量持续增长，丰田汽车公司的销量上升了0.3%，本田汽车公司的需求上升了1.1%，日产汽车公司的销量则上升了14.8%。三菱汽车公司的销量上升了8.4%，现代汽车公司的销量上升幅度超过13%。

<!--en-->
Asian automakers continued to gain sales in the U.S. market, with Toyota Motor Corp. sales rising 0.3 percent, demand at Honda Motor Co. up 1.1 percent and Nissan Motor Co. up 14.8 percent. Mitsubishi Motors Corp. sales rose 8.4 percent and Hyundai Motor Co. sales were up more than 13 percent.

在德国汽车制造商中，梅赛德斯-奔驰的销量增长了7.2%，宝马公司的销量上升了15.1%，而大众公司的销量则下降了0.4%。

<!--en-->
Among German automakers, Mercedes-Benz posted a 7.2 percent gain and BMW AG sales rose 15.1 percent while Volkswagen AG posted a 0.4 percent decline.

通用汽车取消了周二的免费贷款，并降低了部分选定车型의返现额度。消费者可以选择1.9%至3.9%的贷款利率，或获得1000美元、2000美元或3000美元的现金返现，这一金额低于此前的最低2000美元标准。

<!--en-->
GM eliminated Tuesday free loans and reduced some rebates on selected new cars and trucks. Buyers can get financing of 1.9 percent to 3.9 percent or $1,000, $2,000 or $3,000 cash back. That's down from a minimum of $2,000.

通用汽车的销售分析师Paul Ballew表示，该公司希望该计划能在节省成本的同时促使消费者继续购车。

<!--en-->
The automaker hopes the program compels consumers to continue buying while saving GM money, said GM sales analyst Paul Ballew.

目前，克莱斯勒和福特都尚未跟进通用汽车最近削减返现优惠的举措。

<!--en-->
For now, neither Chrysler nor Ford is following GM's latest move to curtail rebate offers.

较低的优惠支出加上稳定或增长的销量，将有助于这两家汽车制造商实施大规模的转型计划。福特预计今天会宣布新一轮的优惠措施。

<!--en-->
Lower incentive spending, combined with stable or growing sales, would help both automakers as they execute massive turnarounds. Ford is expected to announce a new round of incentives today.

克莱斯勒将继续为大多数克莱斯勒、道奇和吉普车型提供最高2500美元的现金返现或低利率融资，同时还提供为期7年、行驶里程达10万英里的动力总成保修服务。

<!--en-->
Chrysler will continue to offer up to $2,500 cash back or low-rate financing on most Chrysler, Dodge and Jeep vehicles, along with a seven-year, 100,000-mile powertrain warranty.

克莱斯勒的销售高级副总裁Gary Dilts在谈到通用汽车的新折扣政策时表示：“就我们目前的观察来看，这些措施并不会让我们感到惊慌。并非所有情况都适用同一套方案。”

<!--en-->
"What we see right now, it wouldn't make us jump," Gary Dilts, Chrysler's senior vice-president of sales, said of GM's new discounts. "One size does not fit all."

分析师们表示，汽车制造商希望适度调整优惠力度，以保持强劲的销量，让工厂持续运转，同时避免过度侵蚀利润。“如果这要让他们付出数十亿美元的返现成本，他们可不想再经历一次1700万辆的销量水平，”位于特洛伊的J.D. Power and Associates公司预测执行总监Walter McManus说道。

<!--en-->
Analysts said automakers are hoping to adjust incentives enough so that sales remain robust while factories keep humming without carving too deeply into profits. "They don't want another 17 million year if it costs them billions in rebates," said Walter McManus, executive director of forecasting for J.D. Power and Associates in Troy.

通用汽车4月的销量增长反映了市场对卡车的强劲需求以及轿车销量的小幅回升。该月零售销量增长了15%。

<!--en-->
GM's April sales gain reflected strong demand for trucks and a slight improvement in car sales. Retail sales climbed 15 percent for the month.

这家排名第一的汽车制造商得益于对SUV和皮卡的强劲需求。在GMC Envoy、Chevrolet TrailBlazer SUV以及Chevrolet S-10皮卡的推动下，通用汽车的卡车销量增长了24%。¹⁰该文章解释了汽车销量上升的原因，并说明了该行业上一次出现销量增长是在何时。尽管文章以数据为主，但也提供了对该行业及其对经济影响的整体概述。或许缺少的是那些近期已购车或正在考虑购车的消费者的意见。[^803]：¹⁰摘自S. Carney于2002年5月2日发表在《底特律新闻》第1A版的文章《激励措施推动4月汽车销量上涨；消费者信心带动2.8%的增长》，版权归《底特律新闻》所有，经许可转载。这是“经济”板块的第63篇报道。汽车销量有时会因制造商的激励政策及经销商的回扣而出现大幅波动：某个月的销量可能很高，下个月却未必如此。新车型的推出也会影响销量。然而对于规模较小的媒体机构而言，新车销量是解读当地经济状况的重要素材，尤其是当该地区只有一两家新车经销商时。虽然有时很难从这些经销商那里获取新车销售数据，但它们很可能是判断当地经济是处于增长还是衰退态势的最佳指标。

<!--en-->
The No. 1 automaker was helped by strong demand for SUVs and pickups. GM truck sales soared 24 percent, led by the GMC Envoy and Chevrolet TrailBlazer SUVs and Chevrolet S-10 pickup.¹⁰
The story explains why car sales have increased and gives perspective as to when the last time sales increased for the industry. Although the story is numbersintensive, it also gives a broad overview of the industry and how it is affecting the economy. Missing, perhaps, are comments from consumers who either recently made a car purchase or are considering a car purchase.
[^803]: ¹⁰ From "Incentives spark April auto sales; consumer confidence drives 2.8% gain," by S. Carney, May 2, 2002, *The Detroit News*, p. 1A. Copyright 2002 by *The Detroit News*. Reprinted with permission.
It's the Economy • 63
Car sales data can sometimes fluctuate wildly, depending on manufacturers' incentives and dealer rebates. Sales may be strong one month but not the next. New model introductions also influence sales. For smaller media outlets, however, new car sales can be a vital story in explaining the local economy, particularly if there are just one or two new car dealers in the area. Getting information about new sales from those dealers can sometimes be hard, but they are likely the best gauge of a local economy's potential for growth—or decline.

购房是消费者所进行的各项消费中价值最高的。购房可能是一件压力很大的事情，许多消费者会竭尽全力确保买到符合自身需求的房子。在全国范围内，通常每月都会发布报告的美国人口普查局负责统计新建房屋的销售情况。新建房屋销售量约占总销售量的15%。全美房地产经纪人协会则负责统计现有房屋的销售情况，同样每月都会发布报告。

<!--en-->
Buying a home is the one purchase a consumer will make that will be worth more than a vehicle. Buying a home can be a stressful event, and many consumers go to great lengths to ensure that they are getting the right house for their needs. Nationally, the Bureau of the Census, which typically reports on a monthly basis, tracks new home sales. New home sales make up about 15 percent of total sales. The National Association of Realtors measures existing home sales, also issuing a report on a monthly basis.

现有房屋销售量约占总房屋销售量的85%。不过，新建房屋销售对整体经济依然很重要，因为它们反映的是新的房屋所有权形成，而现有房屋销售通常是指现有房主购买新房并出售旧房。现有房屋销售数据基于合同成交情况，而新建房屋销售数据则基于销售合同的签订时间。在许多社区，可以通过联系当地的房地产经纪人协会获取房屋销售数据。正如这篇《布法罗新闻》的文章所指出的，这类本地数据往往比全国性数据更能引起读者的兴趣：

<!--en-->
Existing home sales make up about 85 percent of total home sales. Still, new home sales are important for the overall economy because they reflect new ownership, whereas existing home sales are typically current homeowners buying a new home and selling the old. Existing home sales numbers are based on contract closings, whereas new home sales data is based on the signing of a sales contract. In many communities, home sales data can be found by contacting a local realtors association. These local numbers are frequently more valuable to your readers than the national data, as this *Buffalo News* story suggests:

今年该地区的房屋销售开局强劲，较去年同期增长了4.5%。

<!--en-->
Area home sales got off to a strong start this year, rising 4.5 percent from a year ago.

根据布法罗尼亚加拉房地产经纪人协会的数据，伊利县和尼亚加拉县共售出了673套房屋。

<!--en-->
A total of 673 homes were sold in Erie and Niagara counties, according to the Buffalo Niagara Association of Realtors.

较低的抵押贷款利率继续使得购房具有吸引力。Hunt Real Estate ERA的总裁兼首席执行官彼得·F·亨特表示，尽管上个月天气不佳，房屋销售依然保持强劲。

<!--en-->
Low mortgage rates continued to make homebuying attractive. Peter F. Hunt, president and chief executive officer of Hunt Real Estate ERA, said home sales remained robust in spite of some unpleasant weather last month.

“虽然下了很多雪，但我仍然认为房地产是当今值得投资的领域，”亨特说道。

<!--en-->
"We had lots of snow, but I still believe that real estate is an investment of choice today," Hunt said.

该房地产经纪人协会称，该地区独栋住宅的中间售价较去年同期下降了5%，降至79,500美元。

<!--en-->
The median sale price for a single-family home in the area dropped 5 percent from a year ago, to $79,500, the Realtors association said.

中间价指的是一半的待售房屋售价高于这一数值，另一半低于这一数值。与平均价格相比，它受极高价或低价房屋的影响较小。

<!--en-->
The median price means half the number of homes sold for more than that amount, and half sold for less. It's less affected by exceptionally high or low-priced homes than the average price.

该地区待售房屋的平均价格较去年同期略有下降，略低于97,000美元。

<!--en-->
The average price of homes sold in the area fell slightly from a year ago, to just below $97,000.

与去年同期相比，潜在购房者可选的房源再次减少，这一趋势已经持续了很长时间。待售房屋数量下降了12%，不足4,000套。

<!--en-->
Prospective homebuyers once again had fewer properties to choose from than they did a year ago, continuing a lengthy trend. The number of homes for sale dropped 12 percent, to less than 4,000.

亨特表示，市场上新上市的房屋周转速度很快，这迫使潜在买家在看到心仪的房源时必须迅速采取行动。他说，上个月有那么一天，就有六份购房报价被提交。

<!--en-->
Hunt said that homes that are coming onto the market are turning over rapidly, forcing prospective buyers to be ready to act quickly when they see something they like. On one day last month, he said, six offers were

### 专家建议

<!--en-->
*Tips from the Pros*

麦克拉奇报社的经济新闻记者凯文·霍尔关于报道经济领域的建议：

<!--en-->
McClatchy newspapers economics correspondent Kevin Hall on covering the economy:

**深入细节：**如果你要撰写关于房地产市场的文章，那就最好了解证券化运作机制及其在当前环境中的状况。我们很少报道这些市场的具体细节，但你确实需要掌握整个全局。住宅和商业房地产都依赖于这些市场，而这些市场目前大多处于停滞状态。信用违约互换也是如此，虽然其技术性很强，但对于理解当前的危机以及未来市场格局至关重要。仅仅知道房屋是否在售是不够的，还有许多金融方面的因素会影响房屋的销售情况，比如信贷的可用性、银行将抵押贷款推向二级市场的能力、建筑商获取信贷的难易程度等等。

<!--en-->
**Get into the weeds:** If you are writing about the housing market, then you had better understand how securitization works and where it stands in today's environment. Seldom do we write about the nitty gritty of these markets, but you really have to understand the entire picture. Residential and commercial real estate depends on these markets, which are now dead in the water for the most part. Same goes for credit-default swaps, which are as technical as it gets but are vital to understanding today's meltdown and what the landscape might look like going forward. It's not enough to know whether or not homes are selling. There are finance-related reasons why they are or are not: availability of credit, ability of banks to pass mortgages into a secondary market, builders access to credit, etc.

64 • 这是专为亨特房地产公司挂牌的一处房产所反映的经济状况。另一处房产在一天内就收到了五份报价。

<!--en-->
64 • It's the Economy made for one property listed with Hunt Real Estate. Another property had five offers in one day.

亨特表示：“那九个未中标的家庭又重新进入市场了。”

<!--en-->
"Those nine families that didn't win are back in the market," Hunt said.

价格较低的住宅推动了整体房屋销售量的增长。售价在50,000美元至60,000美元之间的住宅，其同比涨幅最大，达到了44%。

<!--en-->
Lower-priced homes helped drive the overall increase in the number of homes sold. Homes that sold for between $50,000 and $60,000 recorded the largest percentage gain—44 percent—of any segment from a year ago.

不过，高价住宅的需求也略有上升。售价至少为300,000美元的住宅有15套，而去年同期为11套。

<!--en-->
Still, there was also slightly higher demand for homes at the higher end. Fifteen homes sold for at least $300,000, up from 11 a year ago.

四间或以上卧室的住宅中位数价格上涨了5.5%，达到115,000美元。

<!--en-->
The median price for homes with four or more bedrooms increased 5.5 percent, to $115,000.

如果美国全国房地产经纪人协会的预测成真，今年全美地区的购房环境应会保持良好。

<!--en-->
If a National Association of Realtors forecast proves correct, homebuying conditions this year should remain favorable across the country.

该协会预计，今年上半年的30年期固定利率抵押贷款平均利率将为6.2%，到第四季度则会上升至6.6%。¹¹ 与汽车销售一样，房屋销售也受利率影响。当利率上升时，由于潜在买家希望以最低利率购房，房屋销售往往会下降；而当利率下降时，许多一直等待锁定更低利率的买家就会进入市场。

<!--en-->
The organization projects that the 30-year fixed interest mortgage rate will average 6.2 percent during the first half of the year, before rising to 6.6 percent in the fourth quarter.¹¹
Just like car sales, home sales are influenced by interest rates. When interest rates rise, home sales often decrease because potential buyers want to purchase at the lowest interest rate possible. When rates fall, buyers enter the market, as many may have been waiting to lock in a lower rate before signing a contract.

此外，还有一些机构负责监测与房屋销售相关的其他经济指标。例如，抵押贷款银行家协会会发布每周报告，统计全国的抵押贷款申请数量，并观察有多少消费者正在办理低利率贷款再融资。这一点值得关注，因为当消费者进行贷款再融资时，他们通常会有更多现金可用于购买其他商品和服务。美国全国房屋建筑商协会也会根据当前销售情况、未来三个月的预期销售情况以及新楼盘的潜在买家流量等三个因素发布月度报告。尽管这份报告的关注度不如其他房地产市场数据高，但它更为及时。美国人口普查局也会发布关于房屋开工量和许可数量的月度报告。该报告会追踪独栋住宅和公寓的建造情况，以及当地建筑管理部门批准的许可数量。虽然人们往往更关注开工量，但可以说许可数据更为可靠。

<!--en-->
In addition, there are groups tracking other economic barometers that relate to home sales. For example, the Mortgage Bankers' Association publishes a weekly report that tracks the number of mortgage applications across the county and looks at the number of consumers refinancing a loan at a lower interest rate. This can be important to watch, because when consumers are refinancing a loan, they are often freeing up more cash to spend on other goods and services. The National Association of Home Builders also issues a monthly report based on three factors—current sales, expected sales during the next three months, and potential buyer traffic at new home sites. Although this report is not as closely watched as other housing market data, it is more timely. The Census Bureau also issues a monthly report on housing construction starts and permits. The report tracks single-family home and apartment construction as well as permits authorized by local building authorities. The construction starts tend to get more attention than the permits, although it can be argued that the permit data is more reliable.

另一个反映消费者支出的关键指标是零售销售。当消费者在零售商处的支出增加时，说明经济正在增长；而零售销售下降则表明经济存在问题。美国人口普查局会定期测量零售销售数据并发布相关报告。零售销售数据按不同行业分类，包括家具、电子电器、食品饮料、服装、汽油、体育用品以及一般商品。由于零售销售约占国内生产总值（GDP）的30%，这些数据能够为了解消费者支出趋势提供重要信息，帮助读者及其他人判断经济的走向。大型零售商和一些华尔街投资银行也会发布销售报告。沃尔玛和塔吉特等大型零售商会根据门店的运营情况发布月度销售报告。商业记者应密切关注这些报告，因为它们可能是经济走势转变的第一个信号，同时也能反映出中小城镇的消费者如何支配自己的资金。[^831]: ¹¹ 摘自M. Glynn所著《地区房屋销售上升，但中位数价格下降》，2003年2月21日，《布法罗新闻报》，B-5版。版权所有2003年《布法罗新闻报》。经许可转载。《这就是经济》• 65

<!--en-->
Another key indicator of consumer spending is retail sales. When consumers spend more at retailers, it is an indication that the economy is growing, whereas declining retail sales indicate that the economy is in trouble. The Census Bureau measures retail sales and also releases its reports on a monthly basis. Retail sales figures are broken down into sectors, which include furniture, electronics and appliances, food and beverage, clothing, gasoline, sporting goods, and general merchandise. Because retail sales are almost 30 percent of the Gross Domestic Product (GDP), the information can provide valuable insight into consumerspending trends and give readers and others an indication of where the economy is headed. Large retailers and some Wall Street investment banks also issue sales reports. Big retailers such as Wal-Mart and Target issue monthly sales reports based on the performance at their stores. Business reporters should watch these reports closely. They may provide the first signal that the economy is turning. They can also be used to show what consumers in small- and medium-sized towns are doing with their money.
[^831]: ¹¹ From "Area home sales rise, but median prices decline," by M. Glynn, February 21, 2003, *The Buffalo News*, p. B-5. Copyright 2003 by *The Buffalo News*. Reprinted with permission.
It's the Economy • 65

## 国际贸易

<!--en-->
*International Trade*

当美国的零售商、汽车制造商、房屋建筑商以及其他企业无法向本国消费者销售商品和服务时，他们就会试图在其他国家销售产品。同样，外国企业也希望将产品销往美国市场。

<!--en-->
When retailers, automakers, homebuilders, and other U.S. companies are not selling goods and services to consumers in this country, they are trying to sell their products in other countries. Likewise, foreign companies are interested in selling their products to American consumers.

当美国经济的商品出口额超过进口额时，就会出现贸易顺差；反之，如果进口额超过出口额，则会出现贸易逆差。了解我国经济与其他国家经济的互动关系，对于理解企业的发展状况具有重要意义。

<!--en-->
When the U.S. economy exports more goods than it imports, there is a trade surplus. When it imports more goods than it exports, there is a trade deficit. An understanding of how our economy is interacting with economies of other countries can be an important factor in understanding business growth.

2008年，美国经济的商品和服务进口额比出口额多出约6770亿美元。这一逆差主要源于汽车、工业用品及材料、消费品等商品。实际上，美国在服务领域的出口额要高于进口额。

<!--en-->
In 2008, the U.S. economy imported approximately $677 billion more in goods and services than it exported. Most of the deficit resulted from goods such as automobiles, industrial supplies and materials, and consumer goods. The country is actually exporting more in services than it is importing.

然而，仅仅比较进出口数据并不能全面反映国际贸易的全貌。如今，外国市场对美国商品和服务的开放程度远高于十年前，同时美国的进口量也比以往更多。1960年，进出口占GDP的比例还不到10%，而如今这一比例已接近四分之一。

<!--en-->
Simply comparing the import and export figures, however, paints an incomplete picture of international trade. Foreign markets are much more open to U.S. goods and services than they were a decade ago, and the United States is also importing more goods than previously. Imports and exports were less than 10 percent of the GDP in 1960, but now they account for nearly a quarter of the GDP.

商务部下属的人口普查局负责统计国际贸易数据。该机构每月会发布按行业分类的进出口报告。一篇典型的贸易相关报道通常会像《密尔沃基哨兵报》的这篇报道一样开篇：

<!--en-->
The Census Bureau at the Commerce Department measures international trade. Each month, the agency releases a report on imports and exports, broken down by industry. A typical story covering trade would begin like this one from the *Milwaukee Journal-Sentinel*:

> 美国商务部周二报告称，自1975年以来从未出现过贸易顺差的美国，其长期存在的贸易逆差在3月进一步扩大，创下有记录以来第二高的月度逆差水平。3月的435亿美元贸易缺口仅次于12月创下的449亿美元纪录，经济学家认为这反映了这个世界最大经济体中最严重的失衡状况之一。“我们的消费量超过了生产量，”美国银行驻纽约的高级经济学家彼得·克雷茨默说道。当月，美国对进口石油的渴求以及对外国汽车的需求均创下新高。该机构表示，美国人口仅占全球的5%，却消耗了全球30%的石油，3月进口的原油金额创下91亿美元的纪录，而2月为75亿美元。经济学家称，由于担心伊拉克战争会扰乱石油供应，美国增加了石油储备。根据美国商务部的数据，3月美国的石油消耗量为3.007亿桶，高于2月的2.471亿桶。66 • 经济状况 美国商务部还报告称，3月美国购买了353万辆进口汽车，这一数字前所未有。按美元计算，进口汽车及零部件的销售额增长了2.1%，达到172亿美元。¹² 为什么国际贸易很重要？它能让企业以及依赖这些企业工作的员工了解他们向海外国家销售商品的成功程度。对许多企业而言，向海外销售的产品的数量越多，他们的业绩就越好。许多美国公司的很大一部分销售额来自国外市场。可口可乐虽被视为典型的美国企业，但其大约三分之二的饮料是在国际市场上销售的。另一家美国公司波音，其一半以上的飞机也是销往国外市场的。不过，理解国际贸易并不仅仅关乎销售情况。许多企业的利润还依赖于强劲的国际货币走势。当企业销售商品所在国家的货币相对于美元贬值时，他们在将当地货币兑换成美元现金时所获得的收入就会减少，利润也会随之降低。因此，那些拥有大规模国际业务或向国际市场销售产品的企业实际上更希望美元走弱——这一事实可能会让一些读者感到意外。由于货币价值的大幅波动，许多外国经济被视为不稳定，而美国经济则被认为相对稳定。不稳定的经济往往会出现通货膨胀的巨大起伏，进而导致其货币价值波动，这使得在外国经济体内开展业务充满风险。财经记者应当查明所报道的企业是否有海外业务，随后研究这些国家的经济近期是否出现过波动，因为这可能是企业利润增减的原因。美国劳工统计局编制了进出口价格指数，用于衡量进出该国的商品和服务价格。这些月度报告反映了进口商支付的价格变化或出口商销售商品的价格变化。石油等大宗商品以及小麦等农产品常常会影响进口价格的变化。了解外国经济的动态对于撰写有关美国经济以及特定美国公司的文章非常重要。对于那些可能在当地或地区开展业务的外国企业，了解其情况也同样关键。这些外国企业可能会受到本国经济事件的影响，而其在美国的子公司却能正常运营。 尽管关于外国公司的信息较为有限，但可以从美国的监管机构获取有关这些公司的文件及其他申报资料，这些资料有助于解释与其它国家的贸易情况。[^851]: ¹² 来自J. Schmid于2003年5月14日发表在《密尔沃基新闻哨兵报》第1D版的文章《美国持续消费导致贸易逆差创历史第二高；因对伊拉克战争的担忧，原油进口额升至91亿美元》，版权所有2003年Journal Communications。经许可转载。经济栏目 • 67

<!--en-->
> The United States, which has not posted a trade surplus since 1975, saw its chronic trade deficit widen in March to the second-highest monthly shortfall on record, the Commerce Department reported Tuesday.
> The $43.5 billion trade gap in March was second only to December's record trade deficit of $44.9 billion, reflecting what economists call one of the weightiest imbalances in the world's biggest economy.
> "We consume more than we produce," said Peter Kretzmer, senior economist in New York for the Bank of America. America's insatiable thirst for imported oil and its demand for foreign cars both hit records in the month.
> The U.S., which has 5 percent of the world's population and consumes 30 percent of the world's petroleum, imported a record $9.1 billion in crude oil, up from $7.5 billion in February, the agency said.
> The nation increased its oil stocks on fears that the war in Iraq could disrupt supplies, economists said. According to the Commerce Department,the U.S. soaked up 300.7 million barrels of oil in March, up from 247.1 million barrels in February.
66 • It's the Economy
Americans purchased an unprecedented 3.53 million imported vehicles in March, the agency reported. In dollar terms, sales of imported cars and car parts rose 2.1 percent to $17.2 billion.¹²
Why is international trade important? It lets businesses—and the workers who rely on jobs at those businesses—know how successful they have been in selling their goods to countries overseas. For many businesses, the more products they sell overseas, the more successful they are. Many U.S. companies make a large portion of their sales outside of the country. Coca-Cola is considered one of the many all-American companies, and yet this business sells approximately two-thirds of all of its drinks in international markets. Another U.S. company, Boeing, sells more than half of its airplanes to foreign markets.
But there is more to understanding international trade than sales. Many companies depend on strong international currencies for profits. When the currency in countries where businesses sell goods falls in comparison with the dollar, they receive less revenue and, thus, smaller profits when they convert that currency into U.S. cash. So many companies with large international operations or that sell their products to international markets actually want a weak dollar—a fact that can be surprising to some readers.
Because of wild fluctuations in the value of their currencies, many foreign economies are considered unstable, whereas the U.S. economy is viewed as relatively stable. Unstable economies often have huge ups and downs in inflation and hence the value of their currencies, which can make doing business in a foreign economy a risky proposition. Business reporters should find out whether any companies they are writing about have business in foreign countries. Then they should research those countries to see whether their economies have had any upswings or downswings recently. That may be the cause of an increase or decrease in a company's profits.
The Bureau of Labor Statistics compiles import and export price indexes that measure prices of goods and services imported to or exported from the country. These monthly reports reflect changes in the prices paid by importers or the prices at which exporters sell their goods. Commodity products such as oil and agriculture products such as wheat often affect import price changes.
Knowing what is happening in foreign economies can be important to writing about the U.S. economy and to writing about specific American companies. It is also vital to have an understanding of foreign corporations that may have local or regional operations. These foreign businesses may be affected by economic events back home, whereas the U.S. subsidiary is operating smoothly. Although information about foreign companies is limited, documents and other filings on foreign companies can be obtained from U.S. regulatory agencies that help explain trade with other countries.
[^851]: ¹² From “Trade deficit 2nd highest ever as U.S. continues to consume; Crude oil imports climb to $9.1 billion over Iraq war fears,” by J. Schmid, May 14, 2003, *Milwaukee Journal Sentinel*, p. 1D. Copyright 2003 by Journal Communications. Reprinted with permission.
It's the Economy • 67

## 消费者信心

<!--en-->
*Consumer Confidence*

判断经济走势几乎就如同成为某个国家或地区的心理学家。很多时候，必须深入了解消费者的想法才能知晓他们的真实态度。

<!--en-->
Gauging where the economy is headed is almost like being a psychologist for the country or a region. Many times, it is necessary to get inside the head of consumers to determine what they are thinking.

经济学家、华尔街投资者以及企业都会密切关注消费者信心报告，因为这些报告被视为预示经济走向的先行指标。如果消费者信心上升，人们未来更有可能在商品和服务上消费；而若消费者信心下降，这些购买行为可能会被推迟。影响消费者信心的因素有很多。最广为人知的两份消费者信心报告来自会议委员会和密歇根大学。会议委员会每月会对5,000户家庭进行调查，会提出诸如“您如何评价您所在地区的当前整体商业状况？良好、正常还是糟糕？”以及“您认为六个月后您家庭的总收入会如何变化？增加、不变还是减少？”之类的问题。密歇根大学的调查则会询问“与一年前相比，您和与您同住的家人在经济状况上是变好了还是变差了？”以及“展望未来，您认为一年后您和与您同住的家人在经济状况上会比现在更好、更差，还是基本保持不变？”会议委员会的问卷侧重于劳动条件，而密歇根大学的调查则聚焦于经济状况。不过两者都会根据综合指数给出一个数字，反映与前一个月相比消费者情绪的变化。其他事件，如9/11恐怖袭击，也会影响消费者情绪，那次袭击之后消费者信心便出现了下滑。

<!--en-->
Economists, Wall Street investors, and corporations widely watch consumer confidence reports because they are considered a leading indicator of where the economy is headed. If consumer confidence is on the rise, people are more likely to spend money in the future on goods and services; if consumer confidence falls, those purchases may be delayed. Many factors influence consumer confidence. The two most widely known consumer confidence reports come from The Conference Board and the University of Michigan. The Conference Board, which polls 5,000 households every month, asks questions such as: *How would you rate the present general business conditions in your area? Good, normal, or bad?* and *How would you guess your total family income to be six months from now? Higher, same, or lower?* The Michigan report asks questions such as: *Would you say that you and your family living with you are better off or worse off financially than you were a year ago?* and *Now looking ahead, do you think that a year from now you and your family living with you will be better off financially, worse off or just about the same as now?* The Conference Board questions emphasize labor conditions, whereas the Michigan survey focuses on financial conditions. But each comes out with a number reflecting the change in consumer sentiment from the previous month based on an overall index. Consumer sentiment can be affected by other events, such as the 9/11 terrorist attacks, as well. After that, consumer confidence fell.

在一篇报道2002年7月下半月消费者信心有所上升的文章中，路透社的一名记者将消费者信心与其他经济因素联系起来，比如较低的利率以及汽车制造商提供的优惠措施。尽管消费者能够以更低利率重新申请房贷，还能以几乎零利息的价格购买新车，但他们依然对经济状况感到担忧。该报道还指出，2002年7月的消费者信心已降至去年11月以来的最低水平，但这一数值仍高于经济学家的预测。

<!--en-->
A Reuters reporter tied consumer confidence to other economic factors such as lower interest rates and incentives from car manufacturers when he filed a report that noted that consumer confidence increased in the second half of July 2002. Despite their ability to refinance home mortgages at lower rates and buy new cars with little or no interest, consumers were still concerned about the economy. The report also noted that in July 2002, consumer confidence had hit its lowest level since the previous November but that the level of consumer confidence was higher than forecasted by economists.

消费者信心报告往往能及时发布，在对消费者进行调查后的几天内就能得出结果，因此其数据备受关注。那些希望撰写经济相关文章的记者可以通过采访当地消费者，了解他们对经济形势及消费行为的看法，从而跟进这些关于消费者信心的研究结果。另外，会议委员会的预期指数也能为了解经济状况提供重要参考，该指数用于预测消费者对未来六个月的看法。如果该指数连续两个月低于80分，经济学家就会认为经济衰退即将来临。虽然会议委员会和密歇根大学的报告在各类报道中被引用最多，但还有其他报告也在衡量消费者情绪，包括ABC新闻和《金钱》杂志发布的报告。68 • 经济篇

<!--en-->
Consumer confidence reports can be timely, issued within days of when consumers were questioned, so their findings are closely watched. Reporters interested in writing about the economy can follow up on the results of these studies on consumer confidence by interviewing local consumers and getting their feelings about the economy and spending. Also note that another good picture of the economy comes from the Conference Board's Expectations Index, which projects consumer feelings about six months in the future. If that index falls below a rating of 80 for two months, then economists believe a recession is coming. Although the Conference Board and the Michigan reports are the two most widely cited in stories, other reports also gauge consumer sentiment, including one by ABC News and *Money* magazine.
68 • It's the Economy

## 建议练习

<!--en-->
*Suggested Exercises*

1. 在学期初挑选一只股票或固定数量的股票，记录整个学期这些股票的价格变化。学期结束时，将你所选股票的业绩与其他同学的进行比较。你认为哪些经济因素影响了你所选股票的涨跌？
2. 选择一周中的某一天，查看你所在社区或州的十几只股票。那天它们的价格是上涨还是下跌？与整个股市相比表现如何？当天是否发生了某些事件，导致某个行业公司的股票涨跌，而其他股市则朝相反方向变动？
3. 在班级里询问同学们他们在暑假或其他时间从事过什么类型的工作。他们是如何获得这些工作的？工作体验如何？他们中有没有人曾经担心会失业？找工作有多困难？
4. 使用会议委员会和密歇根大学使用的一些问题，对校园内的30名学生进行消费者信心调查，并在课堂上汇报调查结果。你的调查结果是否与其他提出相同问题的学生的结果不同？如果有差异，你认为原因是什么？![Image](https://easylink-easydoc-task.s3.oss-cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com/public/edc1ee29f2d6cbd71fef4a3f9d614e83.png?X-Amz-Algorithm=AWS4-HMAC-SHA256&X-Amz-Credential=LTAI5t9E8h6okbJxhoCnJXq1%2F20261014%2Fcn-shanghai%2Fs3%2Faws4_request&X-Amz-Date=20261014T071651Z&X-Amz-Expires=3600&X-Amz-SignedHeaders=host&X-Amz-Signature=da6afbb4568530b8cfbaffe8d32b666ba868f18337b1b98ab884189e6b50c987)

<!--en-->
1. Pick one stock or a set number of stocks at the beginning of the semester. Track the prices of the stocks you picked throughout the semester. At the end of the semester, compare the performance of your stocks with that of others in the class. What economic factors do you think influenced the rise or fall of your stocks?
2. Pick a day of the week and look at a dozen stocks in your community or in your state. Did they rise or fall for the day? How did they do compared to the rest of the stock market? Was there something that happened during the day that caused stocks of companies in one industry to rise or fall while the rest of the stock market moved in the opposite direction?
3. Go around the class asking your fellow students what type of jobs they've had during summer vacations or other times in their lives. How did they get these jobs? What was it like to be in the workforce? Were any of them ever afraid of losing their job? How hard was it to find a job?
4. Conduct a consumer confidence survey of 30 students on campus using some of the questions used by the Conference Board and the University of Michigan and report your findings in class. Do your results differ from other students who asked the same questions? If so, why do you think there's a difference in opinion?

## 4

节奏仍在继续

<!--en-->
The Beat Goes On

### 我们掌握了节奏

<!--en-->
*We Got the Beat*

与任何媒体机构的其他新闻编辑部一样，商业新闻机构也会通过将记者分配到不同的报道领域来组织报道工作。不过，与其他无论位于何处都必有警察、政府、教育、政治等固定报道领域的新闻编辑部不同，商业新闻编辑部则如同雪花一般——没有两个是完全相同的。

<!--en-->
Just like other news desks in any media operation, a business news outfit organizes its coverage by dividing its reporters into covering different beats. Unlike other news desks, however, where beats such as police, government, education, and politics are staples no matter where the media organization is based, business news desks are like snowflakes—no two are exactly alike.

如果你在底特律为《News》或《Free Press》工作，总会有几名负责汽车领域的记者，但《Denver Post》的商业编辑部却没有专门撰写汽车相关报道的人。《The Los Angeles Times》有负责电影和娱乐行业商业动态的记者，而《St. Louis Post-Dispatch》只有在特写版块对电影进行评论时才会提及它们。作为《Atlanta Journal-Constitution》的商务记者，我大部分时间都在报道饮料行业，因为可口可乐公司的总部距离新闻编辑室仅两英里。但在以能源行业为核心报道方向的《Houston Chronicle》的商业版面上，几乎从未出现过关于软饮的报道。

<!--en-->
If you’re in Detroit working for the *News* or the *Free Press*, there are a couple of reporters on the auto beat at all times, but the *Denver Post* has no one on its business desk writing about cars. *The Los Angeles Times* has business reporters covering the business of movies and entertainment, but the only time movies get mentioned in the *St. Louis Post-Dispatch* is when they’re reviewed in the features section. As a business reporter at the *Atlanta Journal-Constitution*, I spent most of my time writing about the beverage industry because the Coca-Cola Co. was headquartered two miles away from the newsroom. But there’s rarely, if ever, a story about soft drinks on the business page of the *Houston Chronicle*, where covering the energy industry is a primary focus.

换句话说，除非该商业新闻机构具有全国性影响力，比如《The Wall Street Journal》或《New York Times》的商务版块，否则其报道重点通常会放在能够影响最多读者的当地经济动态上。即便如此，有些新闻编辑部仍会设有与其他新闻部门共享的专项报道领域。例如，劳德代尔堡的《The Sun-Sentinel》历史上就曾有一名体育商务记者，其报道也会出现在体育版块中。

<!--en-->
In other words, unless the business news organization is national in scope, like *The Wall Street Journal* or the *New York Times* business section, the coverage focuses on what’s going on in the local economy that impacts the biggest number of readers. And even then, some business desks will have specialty beats that they share with other news departments. *The Sun-Sentinel* in Fort Lauderdale, for example, has historically had a sports business reporter whose stories have also appeared in the sports section.

尤其是在当今新闻行业环境下，人们也认识到商务记者可能需要负责报道各种主题，无论这些是否属于他们的专业领域。如果负责银行领域的记者去度假，而其负责领域又出现了重大新闻，就必须有人顶替并撰写相关报道。由于需要覆盖的行业种类繁多，商务记者可能不得不同时处理多项任务。以下是2009年底《Atlanta Business Chronicle》的报道领域划分：

<!--en-->
There’s also the understanding, particularly in these new times in journalism, that a business reporter can be called on to cover a variety of topics, whether they are their specialty or not. If the banking reporter goes on vacation and a big story breaks on his or her beat, someone else is going to have to step in and write that piece. And there may be so many different important industries to cover that a business reporter may be asked to juggle a few balls. My first business news job, atHere are the beats at the
