192 • 财务数据可以是您的帮手：健康的企业的整体现金流应为正数。如果整体现金流为负数，意味着企业用于运营的资金超过了通过产品和服务销售所获得的收入。在健康的企业中，现金流会逐期持续增长。以可口可乐为例，2009年前六个月的现金流为29亿美元，而2008年前六个月则为25亿美元。

<!--en-->
192 • Financial Numbers Can Be Your Friend
Healthy companies have an overall positive cash flow. If the overall cash flow number is negative, the company is spending more money to operate the business than is coming in through the sale of products and services. In healthy companies, cash flow continues to increase from time period to time period. In the case of Coca-Cola, its cash flow in the first six months of 2009 was $2.9 billion, up from the $2.5 billion in the first six months of 2008.

华尔街投资者和商业记者还会用其他方式衡量上市公司的财务表现。其中一种方法是分析企业的利润率。不同行业的利润率可能存在差异，有的较高，有的较低。杂货零售商的利润率通常较低，有时甚至只有2%。不过，无论高低，利润率都是净利润除以营业收入得出的数值。以可口可乐为例，其近20亿美元的净利润除以近83亿美元的营业收入，可得利润率略高于24.6%。借助这些数据，投资者和记者可以比较可口可乐与竞争对手百事公司的利润率。只需找到百事公司的相应数据并计算即可。在这个例子中，投资者和记者会发现可口可乐的利润率（24.6%）高于其竞争对手（15.7%）。另一个衡量企业健康状况的指标是营业利润率，这也是一个简单的除法运算，即营业成本除以销售额。同样，该数值也应与竞争对手及整个行业的水平进行比较。

<!--en-->
Wall Street investors and business reporters also measure a public company's financial performance in other ways. One of these measures is an analysis of a company's profit margin. Profit margins can be high for some industries and low for others. The profit margin for grocery retailers is low, sometimes as low as 2 percent. However, whether high or low, a profit margin is the net income divided by the revenue. If we look back at Coca-Cola's profit margin, the net income of nearly $2.0 billion can be divided by its revenue of nearly $8.3 billion to show a profit margin of a little more than 24.6 percent. With this information, investors and reporters can see how Coca-Cola's profit margin compared with that of its rival PepsiCo, for example. One must simply find the same numbers for PepsiCo and do the math. In this example, investors and reporters will find that Coca-Cola has a higher profit margin (24.6%) than its competitor (15.7%). A similar measure of a company's health is its operating margin, which is another case of simple division, where operating costs are divided by sales. Again, this number for a specific company should be compared with those of competitors and of the overall industry.

行业内另一种比较指标是股本回报率（ROE）。这一指标是将净利润除以股东权益。ROE用于评估企业对股东投入资金的运用效率。许多管理良好的企业的ROE超过20%。简单来说，这意味着每向该公司投资1美元，就能创造20美分的利润。

<!--en-->
Another measure of comparison within an industry is return on equity (ROE). This measure divides net income by shareholders' equity. ROE assesses how well a company uses the money shareholders put into it. Many well-run companies have ROEs above 20 percent. In simple terms, this means that every $1 invested in the company creates 20 cents in profits.

另一项衡量企业表现的指标是资产回报率（ROA），亦称投资回报率。这同样是除法运算，即企业的净利润加上利息支出再除以总资产。这三个数值都可以在利润表和资产负债表上找到。企业会通过ROA来判断是否要开展新项目。例如，如果企业的ROA仅为5%，而借款建新工厂所需支付的利率为7%，那么企业可能会决定不借款。

<!--en-->
A similar measure of a company's performance is called return on assets (ROA), or return on investment. This is another division problem in which a company's net income, plus its interest expense, is divided by its total assets. All three of these numbers can be found on the income statement and the balance sheet. A company looks at its ROA to determine whether to take on new projects. If its ROA is 5 percent, for example, the company may decide not to borrow money to build a new plant if it is going to have to pay its lender 7 percent interest.

投资者用来评估企业最基本的指标之一是市盈率（P/E比率）。这是一个简单的比例关系，即企业股价除以每股收益（EPS）。例如，如果一家企业的股票交易价格为60美元，且每股盈利为2.50美元，那么它的市盈率为24。随后会将这一数值与竞争对手的市盈率以及整个股市的市盈率进行比较。

<!--en-->
One of the most basic measures investors use to examine a company is a price-to-earnings (P/E) ratio. This is a simple relationship in which the stock price of a company is divided by the earnings per share (EPS). For example, if a company has a stock that is trading at $60, and it has earned $2.50 per share in earnings, then it has a P/E ratio of 24. This number is then compared with competitors' P/E ratios and the overall stock market.

如果某家市盈率为24的公司有市盈率为30的竞争对手，那么该竞争对手的股票价格较高可能与其自身的一些优势有关。或许其管理团队更具价值，又或者市盈率较低的公司过去曾存在财务问题，投资者暂时不愿给予其更高的估值。对于评估公司战略及其在同行中的地位的商业记者而言，此类对比十分有用。通常认为，市盈率较高的公司比市盈率较低的公司具有更大的增长潜力。此外，某些行业的市盈率普遍高于经济领域的其他行业——在评估时务必结合所在行业的情况来看待这一数值。

<!--en-->
If the company with the P/E ratio of 24 has a competitor with a P/E ratio of 30, there may be something about the competitor that causes its stock price to be higher. Maybe its management team is considered more valuable. Or maybe thecompany with the lower P/E has had some financial problems in the past, and investors are not willing to give it the benefit of a higher ratio just yet. Such a comparison can be useful to a business reporter evaluating a company's strategy and where it stands in relation to its peers. Companies with higher P/E ratios are generally considered to be businesses with greater growth potential than those with lower P/Es. In addition, some industries generally have higher P/E ratios than other sectors of the economy—always evaluate this number within an industry.

财务数据可以是你的助力 • 193 华尔街和商业记者常用的另一项衡量公司状况的重要指标是市净率（P/B比率）。该比率是将公司股票价格除以公司的账面价值得出的。公司的每股账面价值通常会在SEC的备案文件中公布，计算方法为将公司资产除以已发行股数。如果一家公司的股票价格为每股60美元，但其账面价值仅为每股50美元，则说明该股票的交易价格高于其账面价值，换言之，股票价格是账面价值的1.2倍。

<!--en-->
Financial Numbers Can Be Your Friend • 193
Another important barometer of a company used by both Wall Street and business journalists is the price-to-book (P/B) ratio. This equation divides the price of the company's stock by the company's book value. A company's book value per share is often provided in SEC filings and is arrived at by dividing its assets by the number of shares outstanding. If a company has a stock price of $60 per share, but its book value is $50 per share, then it is said that the stock is trading above book value. Put another way, the stock price is 1.2 times the book value.

同样，市净率也是商业记者用来评估公司在股市中的表现及与竞争对手相比状况的宝贵指标。股价低于账面价值的公司可能会被投资者视为廉价标的，但股价低于账面价值也可能有其他原因。比如该公司可能一直在亏损，或是营收持续下滑。担心公司可能出现问题的投资者可能会抛售股票，从而压低其价值。总体而言，股市中的股票交易价格通常略高于账面价值，有些公司的股票交易价格甚至可能是其账面价值的三到四倍。微软就是一个很好的例子，由于该公司总能公布稳健的盈利业绩，因此受到投资者青睐，其股票交易价格也相应较高。

<!--en-->
Again, the P/B ratio is a measure that can be valuable to business reporters assessing a company's performance in the stock market relative to competitors. Companies with stock that trades below book value may be considered cheap by investors. But there may also be a reason why the stock is trading below book value. Maybe the company has been reporting losses or revenue has been falling. Investors, scared that the company could be in trouble, may be selling the stock, depressing its value. Overall, the stock market trades slightly above book value. The stock of some companies may trade at three or four times its book value. Microsoft is a good example of a company that is valued by investors for always reporting solid earnings and is therefore rewarded by being traded at higher values.

## 撰写盈利相关报道

<!--en-->
*Writing the Earnings Story*

本章在探讨季度盈利新闻稿中所包含的信息之前，先介绍了10-Q表格和10-K表格中的信息。这是因为这些备案文件中的信息和分析比新闻稿更为详细。备案文件能够完整且不受限制地展现一家公司的财务状况，而新闻稿则只是该公司对其自身表现的解读，两者并不总是一致。

<!--en-->
This chapter discussed the information contained in a Form 10-Q and Form 10-K before reviewing the information companies provide in quarterly earnings news releases. That is because the information and analysis in the filings are more detailed than they are in releases. The filings expose a complete, often unfettered, picture of a company's financial health, whereas the releases provide the company's interpretation of its performance. The two may not always correlate.

对商业记者来说不幸的是，公司几乎总是在通过新闻稿披露盈利情况之后才会向SEC提交季度10-Q或年度10-K文件。因此，大多数关于公司盈利的报道都是基于新闻稿中披露的信息而非备案文件中的内容撰写的。等到公司最终向SEC提交10-Q或10-K文件时，大多数记者早已忘记查看，从而可能错过报道机会。本章之所以强调这些备案文件，是因为它们往往包含重要的信息。

<!--en-->
Unfortunately for business writers, a company rarely, if ever, files its quarterly 10-Q or annual 10-K with the SEC before it discloses its earnings in a press release. As a result, most stories about a company's earnings are written on the basis of information that is disclosed in the release, not in the filing. By the time a company gets around to filing a 10-Q or 10-K with the SEC, most reporters forget to look at it and, consequently, may miss a story. This chapter has emphasized these filings because they often contain important nuggets of information.

许多公司喜欢在上午9:30股市开盘前或下午4点股市收盘后发布盈利公告。对于许多记者，尤其是那些在美联社、路透社、道琼斯或彭博新闻社等通讯社工作的记者来说，这意味着早晨和……

<!--en-->
Many companies like to put out earnings releases before the stock market opens at 9:30 a.m. or after the stock market closes for trading at 4 p.m. For many reporters, particularly those that work at wire services such as the Associated Press, Reuters, Dow Jones, or Bloomberg News, this means that the morning and

### 专业人士的经验建议

<!--en-->
*Tips from the Pros*

路透社记者Joe Rauch关于报道盈利新闻的建议：

<!--en-->
Reuters reporter Joe Rauch on covering earnings:

**为盈利新闻做准备：**在盈利公告发布前的几天和几周内，致电公司内部人士及竞争对手。虽然根据SEC的规定，具体数据属于保密信息，但你仍可以提前了解公司的运营状况。这个季度的情况如何？竞争对手是否正在取得优势？员工是否注意到产品销量有所下降？这些额外的工作会带来回报，能让你提前撰写关于盈利情况的报道，并呈现一线人员对公司表现的看法。最重要的是，这类工作能让你抢在竞争对手之前行动，在盈利消息公布时为读者提供更多背景信息和视角，因为你已经提前做好了准备。在此过程中，不要过度依赖分析师的预期或预测。正如我们在金融危机期间所看到的，除了少数例外，分析师往往是最后才意识到许多陷入困境的金融公司存在问题的群体。

<!--en-->
**Prep for earnings:** Call sources inside the company and competitors in the days and weeks leading up to an earnings announcement. While the actual numbers are closely guarded information because of SEC regulations, you can begin to get a feel for how the company's doing in advance of earnings. What has the quarter looked like? Are competitors gaining ground? Do employees notice they've been selling fewer widgets? The extra work will pay off. It leads to advance stories about earnings and what the frontline view is of the company's performance. Most importantly, this kind of work can get you ahead of the competition, enabling you to provide more context and perspective for the reader when earnings are announced because you're hitting the ground running. In this process, don't rely heavily on analyst expectations or projections. As we've seen during the financial crisis, analysts—except for limited examples—were generally the last to the party in recognizing the problems at many mortally wounded financial companies.

194 • 财务数据可以是你的朋友 在财报季的下午往往十分忙碌。需要再次强调的是，企业可能会利用财报来美化自身的业绩表现。有时企业会刻意强调营收的强劲增长，以此掩盖其在该季度在广告或其他方面的巨额支出，从而导致实际利润低于预期；而另一些时候，即便销售额疲软，企业也会夸大利润的增长幅度。正因如此，财经记者需要全面审视财报中的各项信息。虽然华尔街分析师和投资者主要关注企业是否达到了预期的盈利目标，但通过分析企业的整体表现或许能揭示更真实的情况。让我们来看看一家企业典型的财报开头是怎样的：

<!--en-->
194 • Financial Numbers Can Be Your Friend afternoon can be busy times during earnings season. It is important to note again that a company can use its earnings releases to put a spin on its performance. Sometimes a company will emphasize strong growth in revenue to mask the fact that it spent a lot of money that quarter on advertising or something else, making earnings lower than expected. Other times, companies will trumpet strong earnings growth despite weak sales. That is why the business reporter needs to look at the complete picture in an earnings release. Although Wall Street analysts and investors primarily focus on whether the company “made” its earnings projections, a better story may be told by looking at the overall performance of the company. Let’s look at how a typical earnings release from a company begins:

作为全球最大的家居建材零售商，家得宝今日公布了2002财年第三季度的业绩：净盈利达9.4亿美元，摊薄后每股收益为0.40美元，较2001财年同期的7.78亿美元、摊薄后每股收益0.33美元增长了21%。该季度的销售额增长了9%，达到145亿美元，而同店销售额则下降了2%。

<!--en-->
The Home Depot, the world’s largest home improvement retailer, today reported record net earnings of $940 million, or $0.40 per diluted share, for the third quarter of fiscal 2002, an increase of 21 percent compared with net earnings of $778 million, or $0.33 per diluted share, in fiscal 2001. Sales for the quarter increased 9 percent to $14.5 billion and comparable store sales decreased 2 percent.

家得宝董事长、总裁兼首席执行官鲍勃·纳尔德利表示：“由于我们持续在设施和员工身上投入资金，家得宝在第三季度实现了强劲的盈利表现。多亏了敬业的员工、忠诚的客户以及合作伙伴的支持，我们一年前推出的各项运营举措已开始显现成效。当前的零售环境，加上店内商品陈列的调整，对顾客流量造成了一定影响。不过在整个季度中，顾客们依然对家电、地板和电动工具等品类的高性价比表现出兴趣，这有助于提升我们的平均客单价。”

<!--en-->
“The Home Depot delivered strong earnings in the third quarter as we continue to reinvest in our facilities and associates. The operational initiatives we launched a year ago are delivering results, thanks to our dedicated associates, loyal customers and vendor partners,” said Bob Nardelli, Chairman, President & CEO of The Home Depot. “The current retail environment, coupled with merchandising changes and resets within our stores, affected customer traffic. Throughout the quarter, however, we saw customers respond to great values in areas like appliances, flooring, and power tools, supporting growth in our average ticket.”

纳尔德利继续说道：“展望未来，顾客可以放心，从今年第四季度到下一个财年，我们都将保持日常低价、更丰富的产品种类以及卓越的服务品质。虽然我们对明年经济形势仍持谨慎态度，但强劲的资产负债表和出色的经营业绩让我们能够坚持既定战略。”

<!--en-->
“Looking forward, our customers can be assured of everyday low prices, broader assortments and excellent service at the heart of our activities through the fourth quarter and into the next fiscal year,” Nardelli said. “While we remain cautious on the outlook for the economy into next year, the strength of our balance sheet and our operating performance allows us to stay on strategy.”

纳尔德利表示：“今年我们将开设200家新门店，并新增4万名员工。截至本季度末，我们的现金储备达40亿美元，股权价值超过200亿美元，在零售业中依然处于领先地位。”

<!--en-->
“This year we will open 200 new stores and add 40,000 associates. Our financial condition remains unsurpassed in retail, with $4.0 billion in cash and more than $20 billion in equity at the end of the quarter,” Nardelli said.

该季度内，家得宝新增了34家门店，其中包括两家位于墨西哥的门店。截至季度末，该公司总共运营着1,471家门店。

<!--en-->
During the quarter, The Home Depot added 34 stores, including two stores in Mexico. At the end of the quarter, the company operated a total of 1,471 stores.

家得宝重申，预计2002财年第四季度的摊薄后每股收益为0.31美元，按13周计算，较2001财年同期增长15%。该公司还表示，预计整个财年的摊薄后每股收益为1.57美元，按52周计算，较2001财年增长25%。² [^2150]: ² 摘自家得宝公司2002年11月19日发布的《2002年第三季度财报》，版权所有2002年家得宝公司，经许可转载。

<!--en-->
The Home Depot reconfirmed that it expects to earn $0.31 diluted earnings per share for the fourth quarter of fiscal 2002, an increase of 15 percent over the fourth quarter of 2001 on a 13-week basis. The company also indicated that it is comfortable with $1.57 diluted earnings per share for the fiscal year, a 25 percent increase over fiscal 2001 on a 52-week basis.²
[^2150]: ² From “Third quarter 2002 earnings release,” Home Depot Incorporated, November 19, 2002. Copyright 2002 by Home Depot. Reprinted with permission.

财务数据可以是你的朋友 • 195 这份财报首先呈现的是所有人都会关注的数字：净利润和每股收益。在家得宝，其利润较上一年同期的增长了21%。需要注意的是，这里并非与同年上一季度进行比较，而是与上一年同季度对比，这样才能更准确地反映企业的实际表现。

<!--en-->
Financial Numbers Can Be Your Friend • 195
This earnings release begins with the numbers that everyone will care about: the net income and net income per share. At Home Depot, the profit increased by 21 percent from the same quarter in the previous year. Note that the comparison is not made with the prior quarter in the same year but with the same quarter a year ago to provide a more accurate picture of how the company is performing.

财经记者应警惕那些试图将两个连续季度的业绩相提并论的企业。华尔街并不采用这种方式来评估业绩，记者也不应如此操作。此外，检查企业的计算方式也很重要。例如，记者应留意家得宝公布的21%的利润增长率——这个数字是指净利润的增长幅度还是每股收益的增长幅度？经过计算，实际上净利润的增长率为20.8%，每股收益的增长率为21.2%，因此企业报告的21%增长率可能指的是净利润的增长，也可能是每股收益的增长。

<!--en-->
The business reporter should be leery of any company that tries to compare earnings from two sequential quarters. That is not how Wall Street assesses earnings, and that is not how reporters should, either. It is also smart to check the company's math. For example, a reporter should look at the 21 percent growth in earnings figure that is given by Home Depot. Does that number apply to the growth in net income or the growth in net income per share? If one does the math, the actual figure is 20.8 percent growth in net income and 21.2 percent in net income per share, so the 21 percent growth reported by the company could reflect either the growth in net income or net income per share.

然而，对于其他公司而言，盈利的增长率可能并不统一。英特尔公司2002年的财报开头段落指出，第三季度的营收较上一季度及去年同期增长了3%，第二段才提到净利润有所上升。净利润较去年同期增长了547%，而每股收益则增长了400%。为什么会这样呢？是因为英特尔在最近一个季度的流通股数量更多。由于公司常常会增发股票或回购股票，以使每股收益的增长速度快于净利润的增长速度，因此衡量公司盈利增长的更好指标是净利润的增长率，而非每股收益的增长率。财经记者不应陷入这一误区，而应关注净利润金额的增减变化。

<!--en-->
For other companies, however, the percentage increase in earnings may not be uniform. The lead paragraph of an Intel Corporation earnings release (2002) began with the statement that third-quarter revenue was up 3 percent from the previous quarter and from the same quarter a year ago before mentioning in the second paragraph that net income rose. The net income figure was up 547 percent from the same quarter of the previous year but net income per share was up 400 percent. Why does this happen? Intel had more shares outstanding in the recent quarter. Because a company often issues more stock or repurchases stock to make its net income per share figure grow at a faster rate than its net income, a better barometer of a company's earnings growth is the percentage gain in net income, not the percentage gain in net income per share. A business reporter should not fall into this trap but should focus on the growth or decline in the dollar amount noted in net income.

英特尔先公布了营收数据，而后才提及盈利情况；而家得宝则是先公布盈利数据，再说明营收或销售额。在某些行业，营收和销售额作为衡量公司运营状况的指标，可能比利润更为重要。例如计算机行业就经常如此。不过，大多数公司的成功与否依然取决于其利润水平。

<!--en-->
Intel mentioned its revenue before its earnings, whereas Home Depot mentioned its earnings before its revenue, or sales. In some industries, revenue and sales can be more important than profits as barometers of how a company is performing. This is often the case in the computer industry, for example. However, the success of most companies is still measured by their profits.

财报中还有其他重要的行业指标。对于家得宝和沃尔玛这样的零售商，许多专家喜欢通过同店销售额来衡量它们的经营状况，这一数据就在家得宝财报的第一段中被提及。该数据反映了已开业至少一年的门店的销售表现。以家得宝为例，这些门店的销售额下降了2%，但该公司仍能实现整体销售额9%的增长。它是通过在当期开设新门店来提升总销售额的。

<!--en-->
Other industry barometers are also important in earnings releases. For retailers such as Home Depot and Wal-Mart, many experts like to measure their success by comparable, or same-store, sales, a figure mentioned in the first paragraph of the Home Depot release. This figure tells how sales have done at stores that have been open for at least a year. In the case of Home Depot, these sales fell by 2 percent, but the company was still able to increase its overall sales by 9 percent. The company achieved this by opening new stores during the quarter, thereby boosting total sales.

其他行业也有类似的业绩衡量指标，财经记者在阅读财报时也应留意。像可口可乐和百事公司这类饮料企业会报告一个季度内所售软饮料箱数的增减情况；安海斯-布希和库尔斯则会报告一个季度内所售啤酒桶数的增减情况。在家得宝的财报附表中，该公司还披露了其门店的平均消费额等信息。

<!--en-->
Other industries have similar measures of performance that a business reporter will want to look for in the earnings statement. Beverage companies such as Coca-Cola and PepsiCo report increases or decreases in the number of cases of soft drinks sold during a quarter. Anheuser-Busch and Coors report gains or losses in the number of barrels of beer sold during a quarter. In the table that accompanied Home Depot's earnings release, the company also disclosed information such as the average purchase at one of its stores.

#### 专业人士的建议

<!--en-->
*Tips from the Pros*

路透社记者乔·劳赫关于报道财报的经验：

<!--en-->
Reuters reporter Joe Rauch on covering earnings:

**除非没有意义，否则始终要进行同比比较：**在当前的经济环境下，为了尽可能美化财报数据，企业往往按时间顺序展示业绩（即“这是3月31日的业绩，这是6月30日的业绩”）。普遍认可的标准是进行季度间的同比比较，以此消除季节性因素等影响，实现公平的对比。

<!--en-->
**Always compare numbers year-over-year, except when it doesn't make sense:**
Companies in the current economy, when grasping for the best spin on earnings, often present earnings in a sequential basis (i.e., Here's how we did as of March 31, and here's June 30). The generally accepted standard is to compare quarters year-over-year, to eliminate seasonality and other factors to get an "apples-to-apples" comparison.

这是通用标准，但也存在一些例外情况。例如在当前的银行体系危机中，投资者密切关注银行的问题贷款规模在各季度间的变化，以此判断银行的健康状况。在这种情况下，同时公布季度数据以及年度同比数据是有意义的。总体而言，务必向可靠的信息来源了解公司为何以这种方式公布数据，并与行业内的其他公司进行比较。他们这么做是因为这是行业标准，还是为了刻意粉饰数据？

<!--en-->
That's the general standard, but some exceptions exist. In the current banking system crisis, for example, investors were closely following how banks' problem loan levels moved from quarter to quarter, to gauge how healthy banks were. In that case, reporting those quarterly numbers makes sense, along with reporting the annual, year-over-year comparison. In general, always check with reliable sources on how/why the company is reporting numbers that way. Compare with others in the sector. Are they doing it because it's an industry standard, or are they doing it to put the skirt on the pig?

196 • 财务数据可以成为你的帮手：财经撰稿人通常通过传真或如今越来越常见的电子邮件获取公司的财报。以下是彭博社亚特兰大分社的一名记者如何从家得宝的财报中提取关键信息并加以解读的示例。这篇报道在财报发布不到两小时后，于上午9点50分通过彭博社电讯发送出去。报道中提到的电话会议则在上午9点开始：

<!--en-->
196 • Financial Numbers Can Be Your Friend
Business writers typically receive the earnings release from a company by facsimile or, increasingly nowadays, by e-mail. Here is how a reporter in Bloomberg's Atlanta bureau took the information from the Home Depot release and explained what was important. This story was sent out on Bloomberg's wire at 9:50 a.m., less than two hours after the earnings were released. The conference call mentioned in the story began at 9 a.m.:

全球最大的家居建材零售商家得宝表示，由于公司有效控制了成本，第三季度的盈利增长了21%。而已开业至少一年的门店的销售额则出现了下降。

<!--en-->
Home Depot Inc., the world's largest home-improvement retailer, said third-quarter earnings rose 21 percent as the company controlled expenses. Sales at stores open at least a year declined.

净利润从去年的7.78亿美元、即每股33美分，上升至9.4亿美元、即每股40美分。家得宝在一份声明中表示，截至11月3日的三个月内，公司销售额增长了8.9%，达到145亿美元。该公司的股价一度下跌了12%。

<!--en-->
Net income increased to $940 million, or 40 cents a share, from $778 million, or 33 cents, a year earlier. Sales in the three months ended Nov. 3 rose 8.9 percent to $14.5 billion, Home Depot said in a statement. The company's shares dropped as much as 12 percent.

在罗伯特·纳尔德利担任首席执行官的两年时间里，经营至少一年的家得宝门店销售额下降了2%，这是幅度第二大的下滑。该公司此前预计的增幅可达4%。随着美国市场趋于饱和，家得宝正面临增长放缓的问题。规模较小的竞争对手劳氏公司也在波士顿等大城市蚕食家得宝的客源。

<!--en-->
Home Depot's sales at stores open at least a year fell 2 percent, the second-biggest decline in Robert Nardelli's two years as chief executive. The company had forecast a gain of as much as 4 percent. Home Depot is grappling with slower growth after saturating the U.S. market. Smaller rival Lowe's Cos. is also entering Home Depot's turf in bigger cities such as Boston.

纳尔德利在电话会议上对投资者表示：“我对自己的销售业绩感到失望。一年前制定的运营计划正在帮助提升毛利率。虽然这些计划并非完美无缺，但总比什么都不做要好。”

<!--en-->
"I'm disappointed with my sales performance," Nardelli told investors on a conference call. "The operational programs set in place a year ago are (helping) to expand gross margins. They are not all perfect, but it's better than doing nothing."

纳尔德利称，公司今年无法实现15%至20%的营收增长预期。首席财务官卡罗尔·托姆在电话会议上表示，第四季度的同店销售额预计将下降3%至5%。

<!--en-->
Nardelli said the company won't meet its revenue-growth forecast of 15 percent to 20 percent this year. Same-store sales are expected to fall 3 percent to 5 percent in the fourth quarter, Chief Financial Officer Carol Tome said on the call.

为吸引顾客，家得宝扩大了门店内的家电及家居装饰品类。发言人鲍勃·伯顿称，这些举措反而损害了销售额。根据一份监管文件，这些变动导致第二季度的同店销售额下降了2%至3%。

<!--en-->
Home Depot has enlarged the appliance and home-decor departments in its stores to attract customers. The moves hurt sales, spokesman Bob Burton said. The changes reduced same-store sales by 2 percent to 3 percent in the second quarter, according to a regulatory filing.

为阿恩霍尔德与S.布莱克罗德公司的分析师芭芭拉·艾伦称：“他们目前远远落后于劳氏。劳氏才刚刚开始站稳脚跟。”她给家得宝的评级为“中性”，并未持有该股。“我不确定纳尔德利是否明白家得宝真正需要什么。”

<!--en-->
"They've been running so far behind Lowe's. It's a company that's trying to get its footing," said Arnhold & S. Bleichroeder Inc. analyst Barbara Allen, who rates Home Depot a "neutral" and doesn't own the shares. "I don't have a good sense whether Nardelli understands what Home Depot really needs."

托姆表示，木材价格下跌使同店销售额下降了1%，而新开的家得宝门店抢走了老门店的生意，进一步导致销售额下降了4%。

<!--en-->
Falling lumber prices trimmed same-store sales by 1 percent, while new Home Depot stores pulling business from older ones hurt sales by 4 percent, Tome said.

总部位于亚特兰大的家得宝股价在纽约证券交易所综合交易中于上午9点45分下跌2.72美元，至25.88美元，此前已跌至25.05美元。今年以来，该股已下跌44%，是道琼斯工业平均指数30只成分股中跌幅最大的个股。

<!--en-->
Shares of Atlanta-based Home Depot fell $2.72 to $25.88 at 9:45 a.m. in New York Stock Exchange composite trading, after dropping to $25.05. The stock had tumbled 44 percent this year, making it the biggest decliner in the 30-member Dow Jones Industrial Average.

家得宝在一份声明中重申，其第四季度每股收益的盈利预期为31美分，比汤森第一呼叫机构统计的分析师平均预期低1美分。第三季度的盈利则符合分析师们的平均预期。

<!--en-->
Home Depot, in a statement, reiterated a fourth-quarter profit forecast of 31 cents a share, one cent less than the average analyst estimate from Thomson First Call. Third-quarter earnings met the analysts' average forecast.

财务数据可以成为你的助力 • 197 2001年第一季度，同店销售额下降了3%，这是纳尔德利执政以来的最大降幅。撰写这篇报道的记者马克辛·克莱顿大学毕业后便加入了彭博社。不过她的报道显示出她了解影响家得宝业绩的关键因素，并展现出其对零售行业的熟悉程度。文章的开篇段落解释了为何利润的增长速度快于销售额——原因是公司削减了门店运营成本。文章还说明了为何经营超过一年的家得宝门店销售额会出现下滑，克莱顿还补充了她在电话会议中得知的、读者可能感兴趣的信息，比如下一季度的销售额预期。

<!--en-->
Financial Numbers Can Be Your Friend • 197
Same-store sales fell 3 percent in the first quarter of 2001, the biggest decline under Nardelli.³
The reporter who wrote this story, Maxine Clayton, began working at Bloomberg just after graduating from college. Yet her story shows that she understands what is important to Home Depot's results and conveys her knowledge of the retail industry. Her lead paragraph explains why profits rose faster than sales—the company cut its expenses for running its stores. The story explains why sales fell at Home Depot stores open for more than one year, and Clayton adds comments from the conference call that she knows her readers will want to know about, such as sales estimates for the next quarter.

此外，这篇报道还包含了人们对这些业绩表现的反应，包括一位分析师的评论以及财报发布后股价下跌情况的描述。值得注意的是，在文章倒数第二段，这位记者告诉读者，家得宝公布的业绩与分析师的预期相符。这在报道一家公司的业绩表现时是一个重要的参考指标。如果业绩低于或高于华尔街的预期，克莱顿很可能会提前提及。最后，她报告了家得宝预计在下一季度公布的业绩——每股31美分——并指出这一预期比财报发布时的分析师预期低1美分。或许这就是股价下跌的原因。

<!--en-->
In addition, the story includes peoples' reactions to the results, with a comment from an analyst and a description of how the stock price fell after the earnings were released. Also note that in the next-to-last paragraph of the story, this reporter tells readers that the earnings reported by Home Depot were in line with analyst estimates. This is an important barometer when writing about a company's earnings performance. If the earnings had come in below or above Wall Street estimates, Clayton likely would have mentioned it earlier. Last, she reports the earnings Home Depot expects to report in the next quarter—31 cents per share—and points out that this guidance from the company is a penny lower than what analysts were expecting at the time of the release. Maybe that is why the stock price fell.

这类盈利指引对财经记者而言非常重要，因为公司股价往往会因这些信息的发布而出现大幅波动。每当一家公司发布关于其一个季度或全年盈利预期的声明时，财经记者都应将这些数字与华尔街的预期以及该公司此前给出的指引进行对比。其背后的原因虽简单却至关重要：如果一家公司发布的盈利指引高于其之前的预测或华尔街的预期，其股价很可能会在当天上涨。许多投资者会根据公司当年预计的盈利水平来决定愿意为该股票支付多少价格；如果公司预计盈利更高，投资者就会愿意出更高的价格购买该股票，反之亦然。如果一家公司透露其预计盈利将低于之前所述的水平或华尔街的预估，其股价则很可能下跌。财经记者在报道新指引发布情况时，应重点说明盈利预期为何发生变化，无论是向好还是向坏。在大多数情况下，变化的原因在于公司的业务表现好于或差于预期。

<!--en-->
Earnings guidance like this is important for business writers to track because the stock prices of companies can rise and fall dramatically on the basis of the release of this information. Any time a company issues a statement forecasting what it expects to report in earnings for a quarter or a year, a business reporter should compare those numbers against both Wall Street expectations and earlier guidance given by the company. The reasoning for this is simple but important. If a company issues earnings guidance that is higher than it previously stated or higher than Wall Street thought it would be, its stock price is likely to rise that day. Many investors decide how much they are willing to pay for a stock on the basis of how much a company is expected to report in earnings that year. If the company expects to report higher earnings, investors will be willing to pay a higher price for the stock. The reverse is also true. If a company discloses that it expects to report earnings lower than it previously stated or than Wall Street estimated, the stock price is likely to fall. A business reporter's story on the release of new guidance should emphasize why the earnings estimate has changed, for better or worse. In most cases, the reason is that the company's business is performing better or worse than expected.

以下是公司通常发布此类信息的方式：

<!--en-->
The following is how a company will typically release such information:

联合健康集团预计2003年仍能保持强劲的增长势头和运营表现，预计整体营业利润率将会上升，各个业务板块的利润率都将保持稳定或有所提升。[^2182]：³摘自M. Clayton于2002年11月19日发表在彭博新闻上的文章《家得宝因成本控制使第三季度盈利增长21%》，版权归彭博社所有，经许可转载。

<!--en-->
UnitedHealth Group anticipates a continuation of its strong growth and operating performance in 2003, expecting that its operating margins will increase in the aggregate, with every business segment showing stable or expanded margins next year.
[^2182]: ³ From “Home Depot 3rd-qtr earnings rise 21% on cost controls,” by M. Clayton, November 19, 2002, Bloomberg News. Copyright 2002 by Bloomberg L.P. All rights reserved. Reprinted with permission.

#### 专业人士的经验之谈

<!--en-->
*Tips from the Pros*

路透社记者Joe Rauch关于报道盈利情况的见解：

<!--en-->
Reuters reporter Joe Rauch on covering earnings:

**利用在线对比数据库**：充分利用这些工具。有时公司会提交修订后的季度报告或年度报告。一些SEC文件查询服务，如Morningstar Document Research（原10-K Wizard），能够对比原始版本与修订版本，突出显示文档中的所有差异。如果无法使用此类工具，手工对比虽然耗时但也能起到帮助作用。曾有一次，我负责报道的一家公司在其最初提交报告几周后又提交了修订后的季度报告，这本身就很不寻常。初步查看后发现，变化似乎出现在公司处理税收收益和损失的会计方式上；进一步细读后发现有一句话提到公司即将取消针对高管的地域性竞业限制协议，这立刻就成了一个值得报道的新闻点。

<!--en-->
**Use online comparative databases:** Take advantage of them. Sometimes companies will file amended quarterly or annual reports. Some SEC filing services, like Morningstar Document Research (formerly 10-K Wizard), can do a comparison between the original and the amended to highlight all of the differences in the document. Failing that, the by-hand method is time-consuming but helpful. In one instance, a company I was covering filed an amended quarterly report a few weeks after their initial filing. This in itself was unusual. At a glance, the changes seemed to be changes in how the company was accounting for tax gains and losses. A deeper read found a single sentence mentioning it was doing away with geographic noncompete agreements for executives, which was an immediate story.

198 • 财务数据可以是你的助力

<!--en-->
198 • Financial Numbers Can Be Your Friend

#### 专业人士的经验之谈

<!--en-->
*Tips from the Pros*

在挖掘10-Q和10-K文件中的有趣事实及有新闻价值的细节方面，没有哪个博客比由财经记者Michelle Leder运营的www.footnoted.org,做得更好。

<!--en-->
No blog does a better job of digging up fascinating factoids and newsworthy nuggets in 10-Q and 10-K filings than www.footnoted.org, which is run by business journalist Michelle Leder.

Leder曾是《坦帕论坛报》和佛罗里达州布拉登顿的《先驱报》的财经记者，她在2003年8月创建了自己的网站。从那时起，该网站吸引了来自全国各地的投资者、分析师和财经记者的关注。许多记者在他们的报道中都会引用她的网站内容。在2009年的股东委托书季期间，Leder的网站还为《纽约时报》的Dealbook博客提供了内容。

<!--en-->
Leder, a former business journalist at *The Tampa Tribune* and the *Bradenton* (Fla.) *Herald*, launched her site in August 2003. Since then, it's gained a following from investors, analysts, and business reporters from around the country. Reporters have credited her site in their stories. And during the 2009 proxy season, Leder's site contributed content to the *New York Times' Dealbook* blog.

2009年10月，Leder发表了一篇关于微软公司股东委托书中所披露的政治竞选捐款情况的文章。同年9月底，她又发表了一篇关于First Marblehead公司的文章，提到了该公司前高管们获得的巨额遣散费，而这些高管正是导致该公司股价大幅下跌的罪魁祸首。

<!--en-->
In October 2009, Leder had a post about a disclosure in Microsoft Corporation's proxy statement regarding its political campaign contributions. A late September posting about First Marblehead notes the huge severance packages given to former executives, who oversaw a large drop in the company's stock price.

虽然Leder的网站大部分内容都是免费的，但她最近推出了一个名为FootnotedPro的付费网站，订阅者每年只需支付2,500美元，就能获取更多由Leder及其团队每天审核的SEC文件中的信息和数据。

<!--en-->
While most of Leder's site is free, she recently launched a pay site called FootnotedPro in which subscribers who pay $2,500 a year can get even more information and data from the SEC filings that Leder and her team review each day.

在上周举行的年度投资者大会上，管理层公布了2003年的以下关键数据：

<!--en-->
At its annual Investor Conference last week, management provided the following key data points for 2003:

* 公司各业务板块的整体有机收入增长了13%，营收约为290亿美元。
* 营业利润至少为25.7亿美元。
* 利润率将从2002年的约8.7%上升至2003年的8.9%甚至更高。
* 每股收益将至少达到5.05美元，这一数值处于该公司指引范围的上限，比2002年目前预期的4.20美元高出20%。
* 2003年的经营活动产生的现金流将超过26亿美元，而2002年为23亿美元。
* 股本回报率在34%或以上。⁴ 该新闻稿的第四项内容是盈利预期，表明这家管理型医疗保健公司认为其2003年的盈利将高于此前预期。这份新闻稿是在早上6点过后不久发布的。虽然当时很可能没有多少记者在办公室，但许多公司仍喜欢在清晨发布此类公告，因为高管们知道，在一天忙碌起来之前，编辑们就会将相关报道分配给记者。一位路透社记者报道了联合健康集团的相关信息，并解释了该公司为何要公布这一消息——是为了扭转前一天因分析师担忧及股市反应导致的股价下跌势头。该记者指出，这一盈利预期是在一名华尔街分析师下调联合健康集团的评级、导致其股价下跌近10%后的第二天发布的。在公司公布盈利预测后，其股价上涨了约3.5%。报道还提到，该公司2003年的盈利预测略高于分析师的预估，而营收预测则与之前的预期一致。所有与盈利相关的报道都应包含这样的对比内容。公司发布的关于上一季度盈利情况或下一季度预测的公告，往往包含着企业最重要的新闻信息。这些公告可以被视为公司业绩的晴雨表，让外界了解该企业的运营状况是否良好。正因如此，企业新闻记者必须掌握如何解读这些公告，并将这些信息转化为能够解释实际情况的报道。

<!--en-->
* Revenues of approximately $29 billion, supported by 13 percent organic revenue growth across the aggregate of the company's businesses.
* Operating earnings at or above $2.57 billion.
* Margins expanding from an estimated 8.7 percent in 2002 to 8.9 percent or more in 2003.
* Earnings per share increasing to at least $5.05 per share, representing the high side of the Company's guidance range, 20 percent above $4.20 in earnings per share currently expected in 2002.
* Cash flows from operations exceeding $2.6 billion in 2003, up from $2.3 billion in 2002.
* Return on equity at or above 34 percent.⁴
The fourth bullet point in this release is the earnings guidance, and it indicates that UnitedHealth, a managed care company, believed that its earnings for 2003 would be higher than it had expected. This news release was issued shortly after 6 a.m. Though it's doubtful that many reporters were in their newsrooms at that time, many companies like to issue releases early in the morning because executives know that editors will assign the story to reporters before the day gets busy.
A Reuters reporter took the UnitedHealth information and explained why the company released the information—to counteract the previous day's drop in stock price based on an analyst's concerns and the stock market's reaction. The reporter noted that the earnings outlook came a day after a Wall Street analyst downgraded UnitedHealth, which caused its stock to fall by nearly 10 percent. After the company released its earnings projection, the stock rose about 3.5 percent. The story also noted that the company's earnings projections for 2003 were slightly higher than analyst estimates and that its revenue projections were in line with previous expectations. This comparison should be in every earnings-related story.
Company releases explaining earnings for the previous quarter or projections for the next quarter contain some of the most important news of a business. These releases can be a barometer of the company's performance, letting the rest of the world know whether the business is healthy or sick. That is why it is important for a business writer to know how to read these releases and turn the information into a story that will explain what is going on.

## 财务报告中的其他新闻

<!--en-->
*Other News in a Financial Report*

记者还可以在SEC提交的详细说明公司财务表现的文件——10-Q表格和10-K表格中找到除盈利信息之外的其他资料。这些文件中有很多有价值的信息，乍看之下可能并不像是在讲述什么故事。[^2199]：⁴ 联合健康集团公司新闻稿，2002年11月26日。版权所有2002年联合健康集团公司，经许可转载。

<!--en-->
Reporters can find information in addition to earnings in the SEC filings—Forms 10-Q and 10-K—that details a company's financial performance. There is a lot of good, useful information in these filings that at first glance may not seem to be telling anyone a story.
[^2199]: ⁴ United Health Group Inc. news release, November 26, 2002. Copyright 2002 by United Health Group Inc. Reprinted with permission.

财务数据可以是你的帮手 • 199 最为人熟知的SEC提交文件是10-Q表格。这是所有受SEC监管的公司需提交的季度财务报表。该表格必须在季度结束后的40天内提交给SEC。由于大多数公司的财年与日历年相同，5月10日、8月10日和11月10日都是大多数商业记者需要集中阅读这些文件的日子。季度通常在3月31日、6月30日、9月30日和12月31日结束。未能在规定时间内提交文件的公司通常会申请延期，而这往往意味着它们存在某种财务问题。

<!--en-->
Financial Numbers Can Be Your Friend • 199
The best-known SEC filing is a Form 10-Q. This is the quarterly financial statement for each company that falls under the SEC's regulations. This form must be filed with the SEC within 40 days following the end of the quarter. Because the fiscal year of most companies is the same as the calendar year, May 10, August 10, and November 10 are busy reading days for most business reporters. Quarters typically end on March 31, June 30, September 30, and December 31. Companies that do not file within this time frame typically ask for extensions and usually are having some sort of financial problem.

10-Q表格中有一部分用于阐述上一季度的财务表现，说明营收和利润的起伏情况。此外，这些文件还会告知商业记者该公司是否在回购自身股票。这是一项有趣的披露内容，有可能成为一篇有价值的报道素材，因为它能向投资者表明该公司的高管们认为股价是低还是高。如果一家公司在最近一个季度大量回购股票，那么其首席财务官或首席执行官很可能认为该公司是值得投资的对象；如果他们没有大量回购公司股票，或许是因为他们认为股价过高。这些都是商业记者希望传达给读者的信息，因为这些读者常常会根据这类信息来买卖股票。

<!--en-->
Form 10-Q filings have a section that discusses the financial performance during the previous quarter, explaining the ups and downs of revenues and profits. In addition, these filings tell the business reporter whether the company is buying its own stock. This is an interesting disclosure and one that could turn into a potential story because it tells investors whether the company's executives believe the stock is cheap or expensive. If a company has been repurchasing a large amount of its stock in the recent quarter, the CFO or CEO probably think the company is a good investment. If they have not purchased a significant amount of the company's stock, maybe they think the stock price is high. That is information a business reporter would want to tell his or her readers because those readers often buy and sell stocks on the basis of this information.

以下摘录展示了10-Q表格中是如何披露这类信息的：

<!--en-->
The following excerpt shows how this information is disclosed in a 10-Q:

该公司可在2002年12月31日前回购最多1.2亿美元的已发行A类普通股。2001年第二季度，该公司共回购了25,500股股票，总成本为734,295美元，平均价格为28.80美元。2000年第二季度，该公司则回购了149,957股股票，总成本为4,300,216美元。

<!--en-->
The Company may repurchase as much as $120 million of its outstanding Class A common stock through December 31, 2002. During the second quarter of 2001, 25,500 shares were repurchased at a total cost of $734,295 or an average price of $28.80. The Company repurchased 149,957 shares at a total cost of $4,300,216 during the second quarter of 2000.

（10-Q表格，Erie Indemnity公司，2001年，第20页）这对商业记者来说意味着什么？这段表述暗示，负责该公司股票回购计划的人可能认为，2000年前三个月的股票价格要比2001年第二季度便宜得多——2000年前三个月共花费430万美元购买股票，而2001年第二季度仅花费734,000美元。同样，公司往往会在股价较低且预计会上涨时回购自身股票。

<!--en-->
(Form 10-Q, Erie Indemnity, 2001, p. 20)
What does this tell the business reporter? This statement implies that whoever is in charge of this company's stock buyback plan may have thought the stock was a lot cheaper in the second three months of 2000, during which time $4.3 million was spent to buy stock, than in the second quarter of 2001, during which time only $734,000 was spent to buy stock. Again, companies tend to buy their own stock when it is cheap and they believe it is going to go up.

10-K文件是公司向美国证券交易委员会提交的年度报告，必须在财年结束后的60天内提交。通常情况下，2月的最后一周和3月的第一周是负责阅读这些报告的商业记者们最为忙碌的时期。10-K文件会介绍公司的业务历史与概况，对于刚开始报道该公司的记者而言是极具参考价值的资料。此外，它还会详细说明公司的员工人数及拥有的资产情况。

<!--en-->
The 10-K is a company's annual filing with the SEC, and it must be filed within 60 days of the end of the fiscal year, which typically makes the last week of February and the first week of March a busy time for business writers who read these filings. The 10-K provides a history and an overview of the company's business that is informative reading for a reporter just beginning to cover the company. It also details the number of employees a company has and the property it owns.

如果记者懂得如何对比报告中提供的两个数字的增长速度，这些信息或许就能成为一篇好新闻的素材。正如《芝加哥论坛报》的金融市场专栏作家比尔·巴恩哈特所言，判断这些数字是否存在差异非常重要。“在阅读管理层对业绩的解读之前，先找出这些差异，”巴恩哈特说，“通常在公司的财务报表中会出现一些有趣的趋势或异常现象，而公司却未能

<!--en-->
If a reporter knows how to compare the growth rate of two numbers provided in a filing, that information might make a story. As Bill Barnhart, financial markets columnist for the *Chicago Tribune*, wrote, it is important to determine whether there is a variance in the numbers. "Identify these variances before you read management's discussion of results," said Barnhart. "Often an interesting trend or anomaly will appear in the financial statements that the company fails

### 专业人士的建议

<!--en-->
*Tips from the Pros*

路透社记者乔·劳赫关于报道盈利情况的见解：

<!--en-->
Reuters reporter Joe Rauch on covering earnings:

**引用说明：**在查阅文件时最容易遇到的三个糟糕词汇。公司常常会选取与报告相关的其他文件，但不会将其完整附上供读者查看，而只是注明该文件的最初提交时间以及所属的报告类别。这是公司用来避免反复公开某些不想广泛传播的信息的关键策略，比如包含巨额遣散费的CEO雇佣合同。这意味着想要找到那份CEO雇佣合同将会十分困难。大多数记者在试图了解一家公司或挖掘相关报道的背景时，往往因为时间紧迫、缺乏精力或理解不足而跳过这一环节。

<!--en-->
**Incorporated by reference:**
Three of the worst words you can read while going through a filing. Companies often take a documents relevant to a filing and, rather than attaching it in whole for readers, will merely reference when it was originally filed and the document it was filed under. It's one key strategy companies can use to avoid showing information they don't want widely distributed over and over again, like a CEO's employment contract with that huge severance payout. It essentially means your hunt for that CEO's employment contract you're trying to find is going to be tough. Most reporters, if getting to know a company or trying to dig up the background on a relevant story, often skip over this in the essence of time, lack of effort or just lack of understanding.

不过，这些文件往往值得仔细查找，它们不仅能为你的报道增添色彩，至少还能为你提供采访所需的素材以及报道中的细节。这些引用信息总是放在文件末尾，如果发现有新内容或补充内容，一定要查看。正如一位前银行CEO曾对我说的那样，信息披露的目的就是向读者提供如此多的信息，以至于他们无法轻易找到想要的内容，最终选择放弃。

<!--en-->
But these documents are often worth hunting for and can add color to your story or, at the bare minimum, provide you with the ammunition you need for interviews, details in the stories, the works. The references are always posted at the end of the document. If something looks new or added, check it out. As one former bank CEO once told me, disclosure is about providing so much information to the reader that they can't find what they want easily, so they give up.

200 • 财务数据可能成为你的助力。在报道文本中提及这一点，你或许就能写出一篇好文章。在经济疲软时期尤其如此，因为此时公司可能会通过调整一些看似无关紧要的项目来提升利润”（巴恩哈特，2001年，第1页）。

<!--en-->
200 • Financial Numbers Can Be Your Friend to address in the report text. You may have a story. This is particularly true during sluggish economic times, when a company may grow profits by tweaking seemingly incidental line items” (Barnhart, 2001, p. 1).

例如，巴恩哈特研究过麦当劳公司的一份报告，其中显示该公司发行了24亿美元的长期债务，使得公司的负债率升至1991年以来的最高水平。巴恩哈特指出，该公司几乎把所有这笔钱都用于回购股票，因此在经营状况不佳的那一年，尽管业务现金流下降，但其每股收益却有所上升。换句话说，麦当劳那年的表现并不理想，但对于那些无法将股票回购与每股收益上升联系起来的缺乏专业知识的商业记者来说，却看起来不错。

<!--en-->
For example, Barnhart reviewed a filing from McDonald's Corporation that showed the company issued $2.4 billion in long-term debt, boosting the company's debt-to-equity ratio to its highest level since 1991. Barnhart noted that the company used nearly all of that money to repurchase its shares, causing its net income per share to increase, even as cash flow from its business declined during a tough year. In other words, McDonald's did not have a great year. But it looked like it did to the unsophisticated business reporter who could not connect the stock repurchase to the increase in net income per share.

在这些报告中还经常出现另一项重要的披露内容，即公司对未来用于改善基础设施或其他运营的支出估算。这可能包括建造新工厂或购置新电脑等。并非每家公司都会在10-Q或10-K报告中披露此类信息，但一旦披露，公司就可以预估其对未来收益的财务影响——这也是投资者会关注的重点。如果商业记者能在其他人发现之前就基于这些信息撰写报道，他的文章或许就能推动该公司股价的变动。

<!--en-->
Another important disclosure that is often found in these filings is an estimate of a company's future spending to improve its infrastructure or other operations. This may involve building a new factory or adding new computers. Not every company reports this in a 10-Q or 10-K filing, but when it does, it can estimate the financial impact on future earnings—something that investors will look for. If a business writer can write a story about this information before anyone else finds it, his story may move the company's stock price.

这类披露内容的大致表述如下：

<!--en-->
Disclosures like this can read something like the following:

2001年，该公司开始了多项电子商务项目的开发，旨在支持伊利保险集团仅通过独立代理人销售保险产品的业务模式。这些电子商务项目包括替换财产/意外伤害保险政策管理系统以及客户互动系统的计划，同时还涉及大量的信息技术基础设施投资。这些项目的目标是提升服务质量和效率，并增加销售额。该项目的五年总投入预计在1.5亿至1.75亿美元之间。这些项目的成本将由伊利保险集团的多家公司共同分担，其中包括该公司本身。根据初步估算（具体数值将在2001年下半年进一步细化），这些项目对该公司2001年的税后净利润的影响预计会使每股收益减少0.08美元至0.12美元；在接下来的四年里，每年的每股收益则预计会减少0.05美元至0.07美元。

<!--en-->
In 2001, the Company began the development of several eCommerce initiatives in support of the Erie Insurance Group's business model of distributing insurance products exclusively through independent agents. The eCommerce program includes initiatives to replace property/casualty policy administration systems as well as customer interaction systems. The eCommerce program also includes significant information technology infrastructure expenditures. The program is intended to improve service and efficiency, as well as result in increased sales. Total five-year expenditures for the program are estimated at $150 to $175 million. The cost of these initiatives will be shared among several companies of the Erie Insurance Group, including the Company. Based on preliminary estimates, which will be further refined in the second half of 2001, the after-tax effect on net income of the Company is estimated to reduce earnings per share between $0.08 and $0.12 for 2001 and between $0.05 and $0.07 per share for each of the next four years of the program.

（10-Q表格，Erie Indemnity Group，2001年，第21页）如果在10-Q或10-K文件中发现此类信息，商业记者应立即尝试查明华尔街是否已将该笔支出及较低的收益预期纳入股价考量。同时，评估该公司的竞争对手正在采取何种行动也很重要。如果当您所报道的公司正在建设新工厂或推出新产品线时，其竞争对手却没有这么做，那么就有充分的理由将这一信息写入您的报道中。

<!--en-->
(Form 10-Q, Erie Indemnity Group, 2001, p. 21)
A business writer who discovers information like this in a 10-Q or 10-K should immediately try to find out if Wall Street has factored this expenditure and lower earnings guidance into the stock price. It is also important to assess what the company's competitors are doing. If they are not building new plants or adding new product lines when the company you are writing about is, there could be a good reason to add that information to your story.

诉讼内容也经常出现在10-Q和10-K文件中。关于商业诉讼的详细内容将在第13章中探讨，目前只需知道，这些文件能为商业记者提供寻找相关信息的线索。商业诉讼可能十分棘手，并会影响股价。企业通常会预留资金以应对可能的和解或因诉讼而产生的不利裁决。如果诉讼涉及两家公司，这类信息对读者来说就更为重要。

<!--en-->
Litigation is also frequently discussed in 10-Q and 10-K filings. Business lawsuits are discussed in depth in Chapter 13, but suffice it to say for now that these filings can give the business writer clues as to where to look for this information. Business lawsuits can be quite nasty and can affect stock prices. Companies will often set aside money to pay for potential settlements or adverse rulings resultingfrom lawsuits. This information can be even more important to readers if the litigation involves two companies.

财务数据可能是你的好帮手 • 201 在可口可乐2009年2月提交的10-K文件中，该公司披露称，2000年10月27日，它及其部分高管在乔治亚州北部地区联邦法院遭到起诉。诉讼指控这些高管歪曲了公司的财务表现。另一起类似的诉讼则于2000年11月9日提起。文件中提到，法官在2001年将这两起诉讼合并审理，而该公司则在2001年9月提交了驳回诉讼的申请。公司还在文件中指出，最终于2008年5月以1.38亿美元的价格解决了这场诉讼，且法院也在2008年10月批准了该和解协议。

<!--en-->
Financial Numbers Can Be Your Friend • 201
In Coca-Cola's 10-K filed in February 2009, the company disclosed that it and some of its executives were sued in the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of Georgia on October 27, 2000. The lawsuit alleges that the executives misrepresented the company's financial performance. A similar lawsuit was filed on November 9, 2000. The filing notes that a judge consolidated these two lawsuits in 2001 and that the company filed a motion to dismiss in September 2001. The company noted in the filing that it finally settled the litigation in May 2008 for $138 million and that a court approved the settlement in October 2008.

查阅所报道公司竞争对手的诉讼相关章节也可能具有价值。例如，《里士满时报-派发版》的记者，由于工作职责需要撰写有关Markel Corporation的报道——这是一家为从马场到托儿中心等各类机构提供保险服务的本地公司——就会想要阅读其他保险公司的10-Q文件中的诉讼相关章节。

<!--en-->
A review of the litigation sections for competitors of the company a reporter is writing about may also have value. For example, a reporter for the *Richmond Times-Dispatch*, whose beat includes writing stories about Markel Corporation—a local company that provides insurance for everything from horse farms to day care centers—would want to read the litigation sections of 10-Q filings of other insurance companies.

Markel的10-Q文件披露了以下诉讼情况：

<!--en-->
A Markel 10-Q filing disclosed the following litigation:

2001年1月31日，该公司收到通知，知悉Palladium Insurance Limited与美国银行在纽约南区联邦法院针对Terra Nova Insurance Company Limited提起了诉讼，要求赔偿约2700万美元以及惩罚性赔偿金，起因是所谓的再保险协议问题。该公司认为自己拥有诸多抗辩理由，包括声称那些所谓的再保险协议无效。该公司打算积极应诉，但目前还无法预测诉讼结果。

<!--en-->
On January 31, 2001, the Company received notice of a lawsuit filed in the United States District Court for the Southern District of New York against Terra Nova Insurance Company Limited by Palladium Insurance Limited and Bank of America, N.A. seeking approximately $27 million plus exemplary damages in connection with alleged reinsurance agreements. The Company believes it has numerous defenses to these claims, including the defense that the alleged reinsurance agreements were not valid. The Company intends to vigorously defend this matter; however, it cannot predict the outcome at this time.

2001年5月29日，Reliance Insurance Company被宾夕法尼亚州保险部门责令进入重组程序。截至2001年6月30日及2000年12月31日，Reliance Insurance Company及其关联公司共欠该公司约3340万美元的已赔付及未赔付损失的再保险应收款项。在评估这些再保险应收款项的可回收性时，这些余额已被纳入考量范围。

<!--en-->
On May 29, 2001, Reliance Insurance Company was placed in rehabilitation by the Pennsylvania Insurance Department. At June 30, 2001 and December 31, 2000, Reliance Insurance Company and its affiliates owed the Company approximately $33.4 million in reinsurance recoverables for paid and unpaid losses. These balances were considered in the normal course of assessing the collectability of reinsurance recoverables.

（10-Q表格，Markel Corporation，2001年，第13页）不过，该文件并未披露与Markel相关的其他诉讼信息。如果负责报道该公司的记者能花些时间阅读其他保险公司的10-Q文件中的诉讼相关章节，他们就会发现PXRE Group的这条记录：

<!--en-->
(Form 10-Q, Markel Corporation, 2001, p. 13)
However, the filing did not disclose other litigation that involved Markel. If the reporter covering the company had spent some time reading the litigation sections of 10-Q filings by other insurers, they would have discovered this entry from PXRE Group:

PXRE在1999年5月与两个交易方签订了天气期权协议。2000年4月，这些交易方向PXRE Delaware提交了总额为8,252,500美元的发票，要求根据天气期权协议获得付款，而这些发票也已得到支付。PXRE Delaware通过由Terra Nova Insurance Company Limited（“Terra Nova”）出具的两份商业内陆海洋天气保险单为其在这些天气期权协议项下的义务投保。2000年4月，PXRE Delaware根据这些保险单向Terra Nova提出了索赔。

<!--en-->
PXRE entered into weather option agreements in May 1999 with two counter-parties. In April 2000, these counter-parties submitted invoices to PXRE Delaware in the aggregate sum of $8,252,500 seeking payment under the weather option agreements, which invoices have been paid. PXRE Delaware insured its obligations under these weather option agreements through two Commercial Inland Marine Weather Insurance Policies issued by Terra Nova Insurance Company Limited ("Terra Nova"). PXRE Delaware submitted claims under these policies to Terra Nova in April 2000. Terra

### 专业人士的建议

<!--en-->
*Tips from the Pros*

路透社记者Joe Rauch关于报道盈利情况的经验：

<!--en-->
Reuters reporter Joe Rauch on covering earnings:

诉讼方面：每份季度报告和年度报告都会列出该公司正在应对的所有重要法律案件。通常，这是你能从公司那里获得的关于其诉讼状况的唯一坦诚评估。

<!--en-->
Litigation: Each quarterly and annual report covers all of the important legal cases being contested by the company. Often, this is the only frank assessment you'll get from companies on their lawsuits.

202 • 财务数据可以是您的朋友 Nova公司拒绝承保，称其总代理人无权签发这些保单。PXRE Delaware不同意Terra Nova的拒保决定，并已在新泽西联邦地区法院对Terra Nova提起诉讼。双方均已向法院提交简易判决申请，该案的庭审已被推迟，等待法院对相关申请的裁决。8,252,500美元的总额被计入“其他资产”项下；管理层认为该笔款项可变现，无需计提估值准备金。

<!--en-->
202 • Financial Numbers Can Be Your Friend
Nova has denied coverage, contending that its Managing General Agent had no authority to issue these policies. PXRE Delaware disagrees with Terra Nova's denial and has filed suit against Terra Nova in the United States District Court for the District of New Jersey. Both parties have submitted motions for summary judgment to the court and the trial of this matter has been postponed pending the court's ruling on the pending summary judgment motions. The aggregate sum of $8,252,500 is included in Other Assets; management has concluded that it is realizable and no valuation allowance is necessary.

（PXRE集团有限公司2001年度10-Q报表，第15页）负责报道Markel公司的记者如今自己有了素材。由于他已持续关注该公司多年，因此知道Markel最近收购了另一家名为Terra Nova的保险公司，而该公司与PXRE之间存在纠纷，可能会给Markel带来经济损失。如果Markel被迫向PXRE支付这笔款项，其利润可能低于投资者的预期。

<!--en-->
(Form 10-Q, PXRE Group Limited, 2001, p. 15)
The reporter who writes stories about Markel has just found himself a story. Because the reporter has been covering the company for several years, he knows that Markel recently acquired another insurance company called Terra Nova, which is having a dispute with PXRE that appears to have the potential to cost the company some money. If Markel is forced to pay that money to PXRE, its profits could be less than investors expect.

通常，企业会在10-Q或10-K报表中披露近期交易的售价或收购价，或者利用10-Q报表向投资者通报近期收购的进展。财经记者总是对这些信息很感兴趣，因为这些价格很可能在其他地方未被披露，或者其中包含此前未见过的数字。以下是财产及意外伤害保险公司St. Paul和MetLife的一些例子。

<!--en-->
Quite often, a company will disclose the sale price, or purchase price, of a recent deal in a 10-Q or 10-K. Or it may use the 10-Q as a way to update investors on the progress of a recent acquisition. Business reporters are always interested in these nuggets of information because likely the price has not been disclosed elsewhere or it contains numbers that have not been seen before. Here are some examples from property and casualty insurers St. Paul and MetLife.

St. Paul关于某次收购的更新内容如下：

<!--en-->
St. Paul's update on an acquisition read:

针对对MMI的收购，我们计提了2800万美元的准备金，其中包括400万美元的员工相关费用以及2400万美元的运营相关费用。员工相关费用指的是需支付给被解雇员工的遣散费及相关福利，如职业转岗咨询费用，或是为这些员工支付的费用。我们预计MMI各层级将有约130个岗位被裁撤。截至2001年6月30日，已有118名员工被解雇，相关费用总计400万美元。我们预计在MMI方面剩余的员工相关费用将低于100万美元。

<!--en-->
In connection with the MMI purchase, we established a reserve of $28 million, including $4 million in employee-related costs and $24 million in occupancy-related costs. The employee-related costs represent severance and related benefits such as outplacement counseling to be paid to, or incurred on behalf of, terminated employees. We estimated that approximately 130 employee positions would be eliminated, at all levels throughout MMI. Through June 30, 2001, 118 employees had been terminated, with payments totaling $4 million. Our remaining obligations for employee-related costs at MMI are expected to be less than $1 million.

（St. Paul Companies 2001年度10-Q报表，第23页）在此案例中，准备金计提情况此前已有报告，但并未说明实际已支付的金额。此外，St. Paul似乎表示，解雇MMI员工的成本比最初预估的要高。

<!--en-->
(Form 10-Q, St. Paul Companies, 2001, p. 23)
In this case, the reserve charge had been previously reported, but not how much had been paid. Also, St. Paul appears to be saying that it is spending more to fire MMI employees than it originally estimated.

以下是总部位于纽约的大型人寿保险及资产管理公司MetLife提交的10-Q报表中的另一条记录：

<!--en-->
The following is another entry from a 10-Q filed by MetLife, the large life insurer and money manager based in New York:

2001年7月2日，该公司完成了对Conning Corporation（简称“Conning”）的出售，这家公司是在收购GenAmerica Financial Corporation时获得的关联企业。Conning专门从事保险公司投资组合的资产管理及投资研究工作。该公司从此次交易中获得了1.08亿美元，扣除1100万美元的所得税后，将在第三季度报告约1700万美元的收益。根据销售合同中的某些条款，销售价格仍可进行调整。

<!--en-->
On July 2, 2001, the Company completed its sale of Conning Corporation ("Conning"), an affiliate acquired in the acquisition of GenAmerica Financial Corporation. Conning specializes in asset management for insurance company investment portfolios and investment research. The Company received $108 million in the transaction and will report a gain of approximately $17 million, net of income taxes of $11 million, in the thirdquarter. The sale price is subject to adjustment under certain provisions of the sale contract.

财务数据可以是您的朋友 • 203（MetLife Incorporated 2001年度10-Q报表，第20页）在这份报表中，MetLife首次披露了出售一家子公司将获得多少资金，以及此次出售将如何影响其下一季度的盈利情况。由于这些数据此前从未公开，应当可以作为撰写报道的依据。

<!--en-->
Financial Numbers Can Be Your Friend • 203
(Form 10-Q, MetLife Incorporated, 2001, p. 20)
In this filing, MetLife discloses for the first time how much money it will receive for the sale of a subsidiary and how the sale is going to affect its earnings in the upcoming quarter. These numbers, particularly because they have not been disclosed before, should be the basis of a story.

企业在申报文件中还会披露其他业务交易的重要信息。例如，可口可乐公司10-Q报表的末尾有一节名为“近期动态”的内容，该部分的底部有一段文字，详细介绍了两项旨在推广该公司饮料的业务合同：

<!--en-->
Companies also disclose important information about other business transactions in their filings. For example, in the back of a 10-Q for Coca-Cola is a section called “Recent Developments.” At the bottom of this section is a paragraph detailing two business contracts designed to promote the company’s drinks:

2002年7月，本公司宣布与全国大学体育协会（NCAA）、CBS以及休斯顿太空人棒球俱乐部签订了总价值约为6.5亿至8亿美元的长期协议。本公司、CBS和NCAA将共同参与一项整合营销与媒体计划，其中本公司将负责饮料营销，并拥有22项运动项目的87场NCAA冠军赛事的媒体转播权。此外，本公司的子公司The Minute Maid Company与休斯顿太空人棒球俱乐部还将建立长期的营销与社区合作伙伴关系，包括为太空人球场命名，该球场将被更名为“Minute Maid Park”。

<!--en-->
In July 2002, our Company announced long-term agreements with the National Collegiate Athletic Association (NCAA) and CBS, and with the Houston Astros Baseball Club with a combined value of approximately $650 million to $800 million. Our Company, CBS and the NCAA will participate in an integrated marketing and media program that includes, for our Company, beverage marketing and media rights to 87 NCAA championships in 22 sports. Additionally, The Minute Maid Company, an operating unit of our Company, and the Houston Astros Baseball Club will participate in a long-term marketing and community partnership, including naming rights for Astros Field, which will be renamed “Minute Maid Park.”

（可口可乐公司2002年度10-Q报表，第27页）虽然这些交易本身可能算不上新闻，尤其是因为该公司已经发布了相关公告，但值得关注的是这些协议的金额。即便对于可口可乐这样的公司来说，6.5亿美元以上的金额也相当可观。

<!--en-->
(Form 10-Q, Coca-Cola Company, 2002, p. 27)
Now, these deals may not be news, particularly because the company issued releases about both of them, but what is news is the value of the agreements. Even for a company such as Coca-Cola, more than $650 million is a lot.

然而，从另一家公司的10-Q表格中的以下内容可以看出，这些披露信息并不总是好消息。

<!--en-->
However, as can be gleaned from the following item in another company’s Form 10-Q, these disclosures may not always be good news.

7月底，[Commerce Insurance]公司收到了马萨诸塞州教师协会（MTA）的通知，称该协会将终止与该公司之间的代理关系，并自2002年1月1日起撤回其对Commerce Insurance公司为MTA会员提供的个人汽车团体营销计划的认可。据预计，这将导致约1670万美元的已收保费无法续保。

<!--en-->
In late July, the [Commerce Insurance] Company received notice from the Massachusetts Teachers Association (MTA) that the MTA is terminating its agency relationship with the Company and has withdrawn their endorsement, effective January 1, 2002, of the personal automobile group-marketing plan made available to members of the MTA by The Commerce Insurance Company. Commerce expects that approximately $16.7 million of premiums written will not be renewed as a result of this.

（10-Q表格，Commerce Group，2001年，第14页）当MTA终止与这家保险公司的合同后，Commerce Group损失了近1700万美元。对于像Commerce这样规模的中型企业而言，这样的损失影响巨大。并非每份10-Q或10-K文件中的这类信息都会出现在相同位置；诉讼相关信息通常位于“或有事项”标题下，而关于费率上调及业务决策的信息则有时会出现在“管理层讨论”部分。在其他10-Q文件中，这类信息则可能出现在脚注中。有时，通读整个文件会更有助于获取所需信息。

<!--en-->
(Form 10-Q, Commerce Group, 2001, p. 14)
Commerce Group lost nearly $17 million when MTA terminated its contract with the insurer. For a mid-size business like Commerce, the loss of that money hurts. This information is not always contained in the same place for every 10-Q or 10-K. The lawsuit information is commonly under a header called “Contingency,” whereas the information about rate increases and business decisions can sometimes be found under “Management’s Discussion.” In other 10-Qs,
204 • Financial Numbers Can Be Your Friend this information is located in a footnote. Sometimes it pays to read the entire filing.

随着越来越多的人能够熟练掌握如何阅读和分析企业的财务报表以及企业公开的相关信息，商业记者们也开始着手研究如何利用这些数据来撰写更精彩的企业报道。

<!--en-->
With a good understanding of how to read and analyze a company's financial statements and the related information that many businesses disclose, a business reporter has begun taking the steps to a better understanding of how he can use these numbers to tell better stories about a company.
