<!--en-->
http://www� virtualgumshoe.com: Another excellent website for public records and online resources. Virtual Gumshoe has everything from adoption records to where to search for prison inmates by state.

http://www.powerreporting.com: 一个由普利策奖得主记者比尔·德德曼管理的网站。Power Reporting提供了如何寻找相关人物、政府消息来源的链接，同时还按各个新闻编辑部的报道领域分类整理了相关资源。

<!--en-->
http://www.powerreporting.com: A site managed by Pulitzer Prize winning journalist Bill Dedman. Power Reporting has links on how to find people, government sources and resources divided by individual newsroom beats.

http://www.facsnet.org: 该网站汇集了由独立非营利组织美国传播基金会此前维护的商业报告资源，其中有关于如何阅读财务报告及理解监管放松政策的优质文章。尽管美国传播基金会现已关闭，但该网站仍可供参考使用。

<!--en-->
http://www.facsnet.org: Site full of business reporting resources previously maintained by The Foundation for American Communications, an independent, non-profit organization. Good articles on reading financial reports and understanding deregulation. Although FACS has now shut down, the website will remain available for reference.

http://www.nfoic.org: 国家信息自由联盟网站。其“资源”页面列有全国各州的链接。这些链接提供了有关公共记录和公共会议的实用信息，以及各州政府机构的链接。此外还包含如何撰写信息自由申请信的指引。

<!--en-->
http://www.nfoic.org: National Freedom of Information Coalition website. The Resources page has links to every state in the country. These links provide a handy resource for public records and public meetings, as well as links to state agencies. Also included are links on how to write FOI letters.

http://sabew.org: 美国商业编辑与作家协会的主页。如果您是会员，请登录后在“仅限会员”板块查看面向商业记者的链接与资源。此处还设有用于发布简历和搜索工作的板块。

<!--en-->
http://sabew.org: Home page for the Society of American Business Editors and Writers. If you're a member, log in and check out the links and resources for business journalists under the "Members Only" section. There's also a section here to post résumés and to search for jobs.

http://www.ire.org: 调查记者与编辑网站。该网站拥有数千篇报道的副本，还有针对各类主题的写作提示与指南，会员可免费获取。

<!--en-->
http://www.ire.org: Investigative Reporters and Editors website. This location has copies of thousands of stories, as well as tip sheets and guides to writing stories about any topic, available for free if you're a member.

http://www.peoplesearchpro.com/journalism: 该网站由一名全职记者运营，拥有300个不同的网页以及超过6,000个链接，旨在帮助记者（及其他任何人）快速找到有用信息。

<!--en-->
http://www.peoplesearchpro.com/journalism: Run by a full-time journalist, this site has 300 different Web pages with more than 6,000 links designed to help journalists (and anyone else) find useful information fast.

http://www sigmaxi.org：此处可免费获取与科技相关新闻的来源。该网站由科学研究协会 Sigma Xi 运营。

<!--en-->
http://www sigmaxi.org: Sources for science and technology-related stories are available here for free. Run by Sigma Xi, the Scientific Research Society.

https://profnet.prnewswire.com: 另一个寻找适合采访的专家的好资源。该网站由 PRNewswire 运营，但您无需在 ProfNet 上注册，即可向数千名新闻发言人发送咨询请求。

<!--en-->
https://profnet.prnewswire.com: Another good source for finding experts to interview for stories. This site is operated by PRNewswire, but you may send a query to thousands of information officers without registering for ProfNet.

http://www.score.org: 该网站由一个非营利组织运营，其成员为退休高管及小型企业主，他们担任其他企业高管的导师和培训师。对于寻找行业专家以及获取商业领域的背景信息而言，该网站颇具价值。

<!--en-->
http://www.score.org: Site run by a nonprofit organization of retired executives and small business owners who act as mentors and trainers for other business executives. Can be valuable for locating experts and background information on the business world.

http://www.washingtonpost.com/wp-dyn/business/specials/glossary/index.html: 该词汇表收录了1,250多个商业术语，经过整理并设置了相互引用，以便您查阅。

<!--en-->
http://www.washingtonpost.com/wp-dyn/business/specials/glossary/index.html: The glossary contains more than 1,250 business terms, organized and cross-referenced for your convenience.

http://topics.nytimes.com/top/news/technology/cybertimesnavigator/index.html: 《互联网商业、金融与投资资源精选指南》，由《纽约时报》电子媒体公司主编里奇·梅斯林编撰。

<!--en-->
http://topics.nytimes.com/top/news/technology/cybertimesnavigator/index.html: A selective guide to Internet business, financial and investing resources, compiled by Rich Meislin, editor in chief of the New York Times Electronic Media Co.

http://www.investopedia.com: 一个很棒的教程网站，还配有商业术语词典。输入几乎任何单词，Investopedia都会为其定义，并在商业参考资料中给出示例。362 • 网络让一切更加便捷

<!--en-->
http://www.investopedia.com: Good site for tutorials and a business term dictionary. Insert virtually any word, and Investopedia will define it and use it in a business reference.
362 • The Web Makes it Easier

http://www.investorwords.com: 网上最全面、最优秀的投资术语网站。对于查找任何不理解的商务术语也非常有用。

<!--en-->
http://www.investorwords.com: The biggest, best site for investing terms on the Web. Also very good for looking up any business term you don't understand.

http://www.economist.com/research/Economics: 按字母顺序排列的经济学术语词汇表。

<!--en-->
http://www.economist.com/research/Economics: An economics terms glossary organized alphabetically.

http://www.militarysearch.org: 可通过国防部直接出具的报告来确认某人是否确实服过兵役。获取此信息需要支付费用。

<!--en-->
http://www.militarysearch.org: Find out whether a person actually served in the military with a report directly from the Department of Defense. There is a fee to get this information.

### 经济数据与资源

<!--en-->
*Economic Data and Resources*

http://minneapolisfed.org/bb/: 由明尼阿波利斯联邦储备银行在《褐皮书》中维护的档案。《褐皮书》每年发布8次，时间在每次FOMC会议前两周。各联邦储备银行通过收集银行及分支行负责人的报告，以及与重要商界人士、经济学家、市场专家等对象的访谈，获取其所在辖区当前经济状况的各类信息。《褐皮书》会按地区和行业对这些信息进行汇总。它并非对联邦储备银行官员观点的评论。

<!--en-->
http://minneapolisfed.org/bb/: Archive maintained by the Minneapolis Federal Reserve on the Beige Book. The Beige Book is released two weeks prior to each FOMC meeting eight times per year. Each Federal Reserve bank gathers anecdotal information on current economic conditions in its district through reports from bank and branch directors and interviews with key businessmen, economists, market experts, and other sources. The Beige Book summarizes this information by district and sector. It is not a commentary on the views of Federal Reserve officials.

http://www.bls.gov: 商务部下属的劳工统计局提供了海量信息。从消费者价格指数到进出口数据，再到行业信息，应有尽有。这是最全面的政府信息网站之一。

<!--en-->
http://www.bls.gov: Tons of information is available at the Bureau of Labor Statistics, run by the Department of Commerce. Everything is here, from the Consumer Price Index to import/export data to industry information. This is one of the most comprehensive sites for government information.

http://www.census.gov: 美国商务部下属的美国人口普查局主页。如果您正在寻找关于2002年或2007年经济普查的通用数据或信息，可从此处开始查询，这些普查资料按行业、州、县及大都市统计区对国家经济状况进行了分类。

<!--en-->
http://www.census.gov: Home page for the U.S. Census Bureau, part of the Department of Commerce. This is where to begin if you're looking for general data or information on the 2002 or 2007 Economic Census, which breaks down the country's economy by industry, state, county and metropolitan statistical area.

http://www.census.gov/cgi-bin/briefroom/BriefRm: 人口普查局经济简报室。这里是获取人口普查局最新报告的地点，这些报告包括建筑支出、新建住宅销售情况、房屋开工数量以及库存数据等。

<!--en-->
http://www.census.gov/cgi-bin/briefroom/BriefRm: The Economic Briefing Room for the Census Bureau. This is where to go to get the latest reports from the Census Bureau, such as construction spending, new home sales, housing starts and inventories.

http://www.census.gov/econ/cbp/index.html:《县区商业格局》是一套年度系列报告，按行业提供各县区及各州的经济数据。该系列有助于研究小范围区域的经济活动、分析经济随时间的变化趋势，还可作为经济普查之间各类统计系列、调查报告及数据库的参考基准。企业可利用这些数据来分析市场潜力、评估销售与广告活动的效果、设定销售目标以及制定预算。

<!--en-->
http://www.census.gov/econ/cbp/index.html: County Business Patterns is an annual series that provides county and state economic data by industry. The series is useful for studying the economic activity of small areas; analyzing economic changes over time; and as a benchmark for statistical series, surveys and databases between economic censuses. Businesses use the data for analyzing market potential, measuring the effectiveness of sales and advertising programs, setting sales quotas, and developing budgets.

http://www.conference-board.org: 会议委员会的主页，您可在此查看最新的消费者信心指数调查结果。该网站还会汇总有关领先经济指标的调查数据。

<!--en-->
http://www.conference-board.org: Home site of the Conference Board, where you go to look at the latest Consumer Confidence Index survey results. It also compiles a survey on leading economic indicators.

http://www.econdata.net: 该网站由经济发展协会赞助，EconData.net 拥有 1,000 个指向社会经济数据源的链接，这些链接按主题和提供方进行分类，同时还列出了寻找区域经济数据的十大最佳网站。

<!--en-->
http://www.econdata.net: Sponsored by the Economic Development Association, EconData.net has 1,000 links to socioeconomic data sources, arranged by subject and provider, and its own list of the ten best sites for finding regional economic data.

http://www.federalreserve.gov: 美国中央银行的首页。请从菜单中查看“经济研究与数据”，以及“新闻与活动”板块，在那里您可以获取美联储成员的演讲和证词。

<!--en-->
http://www.federalreserve.gov: Home page for the central bank of the United States. Check out "Economic Research and Data" from the menu, as well as the "News and Events" section, which is where you can access speeches and testimony by Fed members.

http://federalreserve.gov/otherfrb.htm: 这些链接指向12个联邦储备区，您可以在这些区域找到相关的经济研究资料及数据。许多此类网站还提供工作论文，这些论文能帮助您了解各地区联邦储备机构的思考方向。

<!--en-->
http://federalreserve.gov/otherfrb.htm: Links to the 12 Federal Reserve districts, where there is also economic research and data available for that specific geographic region. Working papers are available on many of these websites. They can give you a clue as to what the regional feds are thinking.

http://www.philadelphiafed.org/index.cfm: 费城储备银行的主页。之所以特别提及它，是因为它会发布关于宾夕法尼亚州、新泽西州和特拉华州经济活动指数及先行指数的数据，这些数据有时能作为反映全国其他地区的晴雨表。

<!--en-->
http://www.philadelphiafed.org/index.cfm: Home page of the Philadelphia Reserve. Singled out here because of its surveys on economic activity indexes and leading indexes for Pennsylvania, New Jersey and Delaware, which sometimes can be a barometer for the rest of the country.

http://www.ny.frb.org: 纽约储备银行的主页。页面设有关于银行业的精彩板块，包括发送给各银行的备忘录，还有面向消费者的内容。主页还会实时更新外汇汇率及定期存单利率信息。

<!--en-->
http://www.ny.frb.org: Home page for the New York Reserve. Has a nice section on the banking industry, including memos sent to banks, and a consumer section. Home page has a quick update on foreign currency exchanges and certificate of deposit rates.

http://www.economy.com/dismal: Dismal Scientist，是由总部位于宾夕法尼亚州的公司Economy.com运营的网站，旨在为专业投资者、政府机构等提供有关经济趋势与研究的新闻及信息。

<!--en-->
http://www.economy.com/dismal: Dismal Scientist, a site run by Economy.com, a Pennsylvania-based company, to provide news and information about economic trends and research for professional investors, government agencies and others.

http://www.imf.org/external/index.htm: 国际货币基金组织。如果您要撰写有关在国外开展业务的公司或企业的文章，这是一个很好的参考来源。该网站能让您了解该国的经济状况。

<!--en-->
http://www.imf.org/external/index.htm: The International Monetary Fund. A good place to go to if you're writing about a company or business with operations in an international country. This site can give you an indication of that country's economic shape.

http://bea.gov: 商业部的经济分析局。点击此处可获取按行业和州划分的国内生产总值数据，同时还提供按州划分的个人收入信息。

<!--en-->
http://bea.gov: The Bureau of Economic Analysis at the Commerce Department. Go here to get data on the Gross Domestic Product by industry and by state. Also has information on personal income by state.

http://research.stlouisfed.org/system_change_notice.html: 点击此处订阅电子邮件系统，即可接收圣路易斯联邦储备银行提供的经济数据与研究出版物。（注：其他许多联邦储备银行网站在有新内容添加时也会提供电子邮件通知服务。）

<!--en-->
http://research.stlouisfed.org/system_change_notice.html: Go here to subscribe to an e-mail system that allows you to receive economic data and research publications from the Federal Reserve in St. Louis. (Note: Many of the other Federal Reserve sites also have an e-mail notification system whenever something has been added.)

http://www.stat-usa.gov: 作为美国商务部推出的服务，该网站专为美国商业、经济及贸易界打造，提供联邦政府的权威信息。“国家状况”板块汇集了联邦政府发布的几乎所有重要经济报告。网络让一切更便捷 • 363

<!--en-->
http://www.stat-usa.gov: A service of the U.S. Commerce Department, this is a site for the U.S.business, economic and trade community, providing authoritative information from the Federal government. The State of the Nation section has virtually all of the major economic reports from the federal government.
The Web Makes it Easier • 363

http://www.nber.org: 国家经济研究局网站，由一个致力于提升人们对经济运行机制理解的私人非营利组织运营。该网站的两个最出色的功能包括一份记录过去两个世纪商业周期的日历，以及另一份显示关键经济数据发布时间的日历。

<!--en-->
http://www.nber.org: The National Bureau of Economic Research website, this is run by a private, nonprofit organization dedicated to promoting a better understanding of how the economy works. Two of its best features include a calendar of business cycles for the past two centuries and another calendar showing when key economic data will be released.

http://www.bls.gov/data/inflation_calculator.htm: 这使得任何人都能将美元的价值换算为经过通货膨胀调整后的现值。

<!--en-->
http://www.bls.gov/data/inflation_calculator.htm: This allows anyone to calculate the value of a dollar into present-day values, adjusted for inflation.

http://www.treasurydirect.gov/indiv/tools/tools_savingsbondcalc.htm: 公共债务局的储蓄债券计算器。可用于查询债券当前的估值。

<!--en-->
http://www.treasurydirect.gov/indiv/tools/tools_savingsbondcalc.htm: The Bureau of Public Debt's savings bond calculator. Helps find what the worth of a bond is today.

http://www.x-rates.com: 一个用于追踪美元兑其他国家货币汇率的网站。该网站还提供货币计算器以及查询美元历史汇率的功能。

<!--en-->
http://www.x-rates.com: Site that tracks the value of the U.S. dollar to currencies from other countries. This site also has a currency calculator and a way to look up the historic value of the dollar.

http://cgi.money.cnn.com/tools/costofliving/costofliving.html: 来自CNNMoney.com的生活成本计算器。它利用消费者价格指数来比较不同时期美元的实际购买力。

<!--en-->
http://cgi.money.cnn.com/tools/costofliving/costofliving.html: A cost of living calculator from CNNMoney.com. Uses the Consumer Price Index to compare the real buying power in historical dollar amounts.

http://www.ficalc.com: 一种用于计算债券价值的计算器，可处理从国债到市政债和政府债的所有类型债券。这里也有一些欧洲债券。

<!--en-->
http://www.ficalc.com: A calculator for the value of bonds, everything from treasuries to municipal and government bonds. Also some European bonds are here.

http://www.smartmoney.com/Investing/Bonds/Bond-Calculator-7917: 由《Smart Money》杂志提供的债券计算器。首先输入债券的票面利率和到期日。如果接着输入价格，计算器将显示该债券的到期收益率；如果输入收益率，计算器则会显示相应的价格。

<!--en-->
http://www.smartmoney.com/Investing/Bonds/Bond-Calculator-7917: A bond calculator offered by *Smart Money* magazine. Begin by entering the bond's coupon rate and maturity. If you then enter a price, the calculator will display the bond's yield to maturity; if you enter a yield, the calculator will show you the corresponding price.

http://www.gpoaccess.gov/indicators/browse.html: 可轻松获取最新的联邦经济指标。它提供了多个联邦机构发布的信息链接。经济统计简报室中的所有信息均由这些机构的统计部门负责维护和更新。联邦统计简报室中列出的各项指标的估算值均为当前可获得的最新数据。这些指标包括就业、生产力、交通、收入、国际事务、货币、产出以及价格等方面。

<!--en-->
http://www.gpoaccess.gov/indicators/browse.html: Easy access to current Federal economic indicators. It provides links to information produced by a number of Federal agencies. All of the information included in the Economic Statistics Briefing Room is maintained and updated by the statistical units of those agencies. All the estimates for the indicators presented in the Federal Statistics Briefing Rooms are the most currently available values. The indicators include employment, productivity, transportation, income, international, money, output, and prices.

#### 与商业相关的网站

<!--en-->
*Business-Related Sites*

http://www.seekingalpha.com: 大多数上市公司的财报电话会议记录。如果您需要在一天内报道多场财报发布会，这些记录将极具价值。

<!--en-->
http://www.seekingalpha.com: Transcripts of earnings conference calls for most public companies. The transcripts can be invaluable if you're covering several earnings in one day.

http://www.annualreportservice.com: 一个提供上市公司年度报告的免费网站。需要注册才能访问该网站，但它拥有数千份年度报告的资料。

<!--en-->
http://www.annualreportservice.com: A free site that provides annual reports for public companies. You need to register to access this site, but it does have access to thousands of annual reports.

http://www.fis.dowjones.com/products/pe.html: 提供有关另类资产和私募股权投资的信息。如果您正在撰写关于接受风险投资支持的私营公司的文章，不妨看看这个网站。

<!--en-->
http://www.fis.dowjones.com/products/pe.html: Provides information about alternative asset and private equity investments. If you're writing about private companies with venture capital investments, you may want to look at this site.

http://www.bigbook.com: 一个在线目录，可让您查询国内任何企业的邮寄地址和电话号码。还可以搜索某个地址附近的场所。

<!--en-->
http://www.bigbook.com: Online directory that lets you look up the mailing address and phone number of any business in the country. Can also search to find what's near an address.

http://www.bizweb.com: 按行业对公司进行分类，涵盖从古董到网络领域的各类企业。该网站收录了200多个类别中超过46,000家公司的信息。

<!--en-->
http://www.bizweb.com: Breaks down companies by industry, from antiques to the Web. This site has listings for more than 46,000 companies in more than 200 categories.

http://www.bbb.org: 商业改进局。点击主页左上角的“查看企业或慈善机构”图标，即可在该网站查询全国范围内的任何企业信息。

<!--en-->
http://www.bbb.org: The Better Business Bureau. Check out any business in the nation at this site by clicking on the "Check out a Business or Charity" icon near the top left of the home page.

http://www.businesswire.com/portal/site/home/: 按行业、地区和主题分类提供来自企业及其他来源的新闻稿。同时还设有重大行业会议的日程表。

<!--en-->
http://www.businesswire.com/portal/site/home/: Provides news releases from companies and other sources by industry, geography and subject. Also has an events calendar for major industry conferences.

http://www.ceres.org/page.aspx?pid=705: 环境责任经济联盟（CERES），该组织致力于推动企业在经营过程中遵守环境准则，同时鼓励投资者和资金管理者投资于这类企业。

<!--en-->
http://www.ceres.org/page.aspx?pid=705: The Coalition for Environmentally Responsible Economies (CERES), which tries to encourage companies to adhere to an environmental code when conducting business. Also encourages investors and money managers to invest in such companies.

http://www.corptech.com: 拥有超过90,000家美国科技公司的资料，包括这些公司的产品以及负责管理它们的高管信息。其中包含各类科技产品制造商和开发者的详细资料，涵盖小型私营企业在内的各类主体。该数据库涵盖了从工厂自动化到生物技术、从计算机到制药、从国防到环境领域的17个高科技行业。

<!--en-->
http://www.corptech.com: Has profiles of more than 90,000 U.S. technology companies, their products and the executives who run them. It contains detailed profiles on public and private manufacturers and developers of technology products including smaller, privately held companies. Seventeen high-tech industries are covered from factory automation to biotech, computers to Pharmaceuticals and defense to environmental.

http://www.edgar-online.com: 按个人姓名搜索美国证券交易委员会的备案文件，或显示与特定公司名称相关的所有人员。需要订阅服务。

<!--en-->
http://www.edgar-online.com: Searches SEC filings by a person's name or displays all people associated with a specific company name. Requires subscription.

http://www.hoovers.com: 关于所有上市公司以及众多私营公司的详尽背景信息，其中还包括竞争对手的相关资料。

<!--en-->
http://www.hoovers.com: Nice background information on all public and many private companies. Includes competitors.

http://www.mergerstat.com: 一个追踪全球并购活动的网站。其主页按年初至今的口径，展示从当前年度到上一年度的并购交易动态。

<!--en-->
http://www.mergerstat.com: Website that tracks mergers and acquisitions activity around the globe. The home page tracks deal flow for the current year to the previous year on a year-to-date basis.

http://www.prnewswire.com: 就像其名称所示——互联网上的新闻稿。作为记者，您可以注册仅接收您感兴趣的行业和公司的新闻稿。http://www.researchmag.com/Pages/default.aspx: 该网站还提供企业简介和概况资料，以及分析师报告和行业研究。

<!--en-->
http://www.prnewswire.com: Exactly what it sounds like—press releases on the Internet. As a reporter, you can sign up to receive releases from only the industries and companies you want.http://www.researchmag.com/Pages/default.aspx: Corporate profiles and fact sheets are available at this site, as well as reports on analysts and industry studies.

http://www.searchsystems.net: 提供超过10,000个通往全球各类公共记录数据库的链接，帮助您查找企业、个人及相关信息。使用该网站无需付费，但部分公共记录数据库则需收取访问费用。

<!--en-->
http://www.searchsystems.net: Provides more than 10,000 links to public record databases around the world to help you locate businesses, people and information. There is no cost to use this website, but some of the public records databases do charge a fee to access.

http://www_switchboard.com: 查找公司高管的家庭住址和电话号码以及其他相关信息。网上还有其他类似的搜索引擎，但 Switchboard.com 可能是最全面的。

<!--en-->
http://www_switchboard.com: Find home addresses and phone numbers for company executives and other sources. There are other search engines like this available on the Web, but Switchboard.com is perhaps the most comprehensive.

http://www.thomasnet.com: 一个易于使用的可搜索数据库，收录了数千家公司及其生产的产品。如果您知道某款产品但不知道其制造商，这里正是您该找的地方。

<!--en-->
http://www.thomasnet.com: Easy to use searchable database of thousands of companies and the products they manufacture. If you know a product but don't know who makes it, this is the place to go.

http://publicrecords.netronline.com: 在线公共记录。查找某人住所时最实用的网站，拥有各州的数据库。在某些州，搜索结果还会提供房屋的照片。

<!--en-->
http://publicrecords.netronline.com: Public records online. The best site to use when trying to find someone's house. Has databases for every state. In some states, the search will also give you photos of the house.

http://biz.yahoo.com/i: Yahoo! 公司与基金指数。这是一个便捷的参考工具，可帮助您获取有关上市公司的资讯。

<!--en-->
http://biz.yahoo.com/i: Yahoo! company and fund index. Quick and easy reference tool that can take you to information about public companies.

http://finance.yahoo.com: Yahoo!上的财经新闻首页。其最出色的功能之一便是股票代码查询选项，它能帮助你找到上市公司的股票代码。（彭博网站也有类似的功能。）

<!--en-->
http://finance.yahoo.com: Home page for finance news on Yahoo! One of its best features is the symbol lookup option, which allows you to find the stock ticker of a public company. (A similar feature is also on the Bloomberg site.)

http://dir.yahoo.com/Business_and_Economy: 另一个很棒的网站，它按类别整理商业信息搜索内容，涵盖道德与责任、交通以及商学院等主题。

<!--en-->
http://dir.yahoo.com/Business_and_Economy: Another good website that breaks down searching for business information by categories, from ethics and responsibility to transportation to business schools.

http://www.inta.org/index.php?option=com_trademarkchecklist&func=display&catid=123&get_content=1&Itemid=133: 国际商标协会的清单网站。从A1牛排酱到Zippo打火机，应有尽有。364 • 网络让这一切更加便捷

<!--en-->
http://www.inta.org/index.php?option=com_trademarkchecklist&func=display&catid=123&get_content=1&Itemid=133: The International Trademark Association's checklist site. Everything from A1 steak sauce to Zippo cigarette lighters.
364 • The Web Makes it Easier

#### 行业与领域信息

<!--en-->
*Industry and Sector Information*

http://agriculture.einnews.com: 农业行业的新闻与资讯。包含指向特定农业新闻来源的链接。

<!--en-->
http://agriculture.einnews.com: News and information about the agriculture industry. Has links to specific agriculture news sources.

http://www.aha.org: 美国医院协会的主页。还提供了各州、地区及大都市区医院组织的链接。网站上有大量关于医院行业的优质背景数据与信息，同时还具备医院查找功能。

<!--en-->
http://www.aha.org: Home site of the American Hospital Association. Also has links to state, regional and metropolitan hospital organizations. Lots of good background statistics and information on the hospital industry, as well as a hospital locator function.

http://www.ama-assn.org: 美国医学会的网页。点击首页顶部的“patients”，那里有一个搜索引擎，可以按姓名和专业领域查找全国各地的医生。

<!--en-->
http://www.ama-assn.org: American Medical Association's web page. Click on "patients" near the top of the home page, and there's a search engine to find doctors throughout the country by name and specialty.

http://www.asaecenter.org: 美国协会执行人员协会。在此可搜索超过6,500家不同的行业协会与组织。

<!--en-->
http://www.asaecenter.org: American Society of Association Executives. Search through more than 6,500 different industry associations and organizations here.

http://www.aba.com: 美国银行家协会的主页。该网站将内容合理地划分成了多个与不同行业相关的话题，涵盖从农业信贷到信托业务等多个领域。

<!--en-->
http://www.aba.com: The home page of the American Bankers Association. The main site is divided nicely into a number of different industry-related issues ranging from agriculture credit to trust departments.

http://www.opensecrets.org/lobbyists/index.asp: 使用此搜索引擎查询某家公司为请州级和联邦级立法者共进晚餐并与其交流，支付给了游说人士多少费用。

<!--en-->
http://www.opensecrets.org/lobbyists/index.asp: Use this search engine to find out how much a company has been paying lobbyists to take state and federal lawmakers out to dinner to schmooze them.

http://www.mbda.gov: 少数族裔商业发展局，致力于为少数族裔企业主提供帮助。该机构在各主要城市设有区域负责人，可作为有用的资源渠道。

<!--en-->
http://www.mbda.gov: The Minority Business Development Agency, which helps minority business owners. The MBDA has regional directors that could be useful sources located in major cities throughout the country.

http://www.nfib.com: 全国独立企业联合会为全国各地的小型企业进行游说。其网站上有一个链接，可查询该组织在各国各州正在推进的工作。

<!--en-->
http://www.nfib.com: The National Federation of Independent Business lobbies for small businesses around the country. Its website has a link to find out what it's working on in every state in the country.

http://www.nrf.com: 全国零售联合会致力于维护该国零售商的利益。它还会针对父亲节等特定节日开展消费者消费习惯调查，相关结果会发布在这里。

<!--en-->
http://www.nrf.com: The National Retail Federation looks after the interests of the country's retailers. It also does surveys on consumer spending habits for certain events such as Father's Day that are posted here.

http://www.bankrate.com: 这是一个很好的地方，可用于比较您所在州与全国其他地区的利率。页面顶部有选择州的选项。完成选择后，再挑选相应的产品，如汽车贷款或抵押贷款。

<!--en-->
http://www.bankrate.com: Good place to go to compare interest rates in your state to the rest of the country. At the top of the page there's a way to select a state. After you've done that, select the product, such as an auto loan or a mortgage loan.

http://www.docboard.org/docfinder.html: 医疗委员会考官所在州的协会链接。这些州级委员会大多提供在线名录，可让您查看医生的执照是否有效或已过期。

<!--en-->
http://www.docboard.org/docfinder.html: Links to state associations of medical board examiners. Many of these state boards have online directories that will allow you to see if a doctor's license is up to date or has expired.

http://www.freep.com/index/autos.htm: 由《底特律自由报》运营的、专注于汽车行业的网站。如果您不在底特律，需要快速了解汽车行业动态，这里正是您该访问的地方。

<!--en-->
http://www.freep.com/index/autos.htm: Site run by the *Detroit Free Press* that covers the auto industry. If you are not in Detroit and need a quick rundown on the auto business, this is the place to go.

http://www.landings.com: 飞机所有权数据库。点击页面顶部的“数据库”选项。然后查看您所关注的公司是否拥有用于在全国范围内运送高管的喷气机机队。网络让这一切更加便捷 • 365

<!--en-->
http://www.landings.com: Database for airplane ownership. Click on "Databases" at the top of the page. Then find out if a company you cover owns a fleet of jets to transport its executives across the country.
The Web Makes it Easier • 365

**http://api-ec.api.org:** 美国石油协会的主页。“证词/演讲”栏目中收录了向国会提交的证词。要进入该栏目，请在主页上点击“新闻中心”。

<!--en-->
**http://api-ec.api.org:** Home page for the American Petroleum Institute. The "Testimony/Speeches" section has Congressional testimony. To get to this section, click on "Newsroom" on the homepage.

**http://www.nielsen.com:**** Nielsen 为消费品和服务行业提供市场研究、信息、分析及洞察报告。这些报告并非免费，且价格可能相当昂贵。有时，企业会自行提供其所在行业的市场份额数据。

<!--en-->
**http://www.nielsen.com:** Nielsen provides market research, information, analysis and insights to the consumer products and service industries. The reports are not free, and they can be quite expensive. Sometimes a company will provide the market share data for its industry.

**http://www.restaurant.org:**** 在主页左上角的“研究与洞察”栏目下，全国餐饮协会提供了一些优质的免费行业报告。在同一页面上还可以找到关于门店数量、员工人数、销售额及销售增长情况的各州统计数据。

<!--en-->
**http://www.restaurant.org:** The National Restaurant Association has some nice free industry reports under its "Research & Insights" header near the top left of the home page. There are also state statistics on number of locations, employees, sales and sales growth available in the same location.

**http://www.snl.com:**** 一家专注于跟踪房地产投资信托、银行业、金融服务、保险及能源行业的私营公司。其出版物并非免费，但它有一些不因投行费用而受制于任何公司的分析师，愿意提供相关见解。

<!--en-->
**http://www.snl.com:** Private company that tracks the real estate investment trust business, banking, financial services, insurance and energy. Its publications aren't free, but it has analysts who aren't tied to companies through investment banking fees willing to talk.

**http://www.sba.gov/aboutsba/sbaprograms/onlinewbc/index.html:**** 由美国小企业管理局为女性企业家运营的网站。如果您正在撰写关于女性拥有的企业的文章，这里有很有用的信息。

<!--en-->
**http://www.sba.gov/aboutsba/sbaprograms/onlinewbc/index.html:** Website operated by the Small Business Administration for women business owners. Good information if you're writing about a business owned by a woman.

**http://dir.yahoo.com/business_and_Economy/Organizations/Professional:** Yahoo!上的专业机构名录，涵盖从会计师到工会的各种组织。这是一份关于行业机构的综合指南。**

<!--en-->
**http://dir.yahoo.com/business_and_Economy/Organizations/Professional:** Yahoo!'s directory of professional organizations, ranging from accountants to unions. This is a comprehensive guide to industry organizations.

## 华尔街

<!--en-->
*Wall Street*

**http://www.aimr.org:** CFA协会是一个国际性的非营利组织，拥有来自100多个国家的5万多名投资从业人士与教育工作者。它提供有关投资专业人士的各类信息，例如薪资情况。**

<!--en-->
**http://www.aimr.org:** The CFA Institute is an international, nonprofit organization of more than 50,000 investment practitioners and educators in more than 100 countries. Good information on investment professionals, such as pay.

**http://www.nyse.com:**** 纽约泛欧交易所的主页。可访问市场数据、历史数据、图表及相关工具。

<!--en-->
**http://www.nyse.com:** Home page of NYSE Euronext. Provides access to market and historical data, charts and tools.

**http://bigcharts.marketwatch.com:**** 一个很棒的网站，能让用户快速了解纳斯达克指数和道琼斯工业平均指数在当天的表现。

<!--en-->
**http://bigcharts.marketwatch.com:** Great site that can give viewers a quick glimpse of how the NASDAQ and Dow Jones Industrial Average are performing during the day.

**http://www.bondsonline.com:**** 这是一个用于追踪债券价格与债券市场新闻，以及搜索优先股和可转换优先股的平台。Bondsonline.com 提供超过 15,000 只债券的实时报价。

<!--en-->
**http://www.bondsonline.com:** The source for tracking bond prices and bond market news and searching for preferred stocks and convertible preferred stocks. Bondsonline.com has real-time pricing for more than 15,000 bond offerings.

**http://www.cboe.com:** 芝加哥期权交易所，另一家期货交易所。CBOE为1,200多种广为交易的股票提供期权交易。除了股票期权外，CBOE还提供股票指数期权（例如标准普尔100指数期权，缩写为OEX）、利率期权、被称为LEAPS的长期期权以及行业指数期权。

<!--en-->
**http://www.cboe.com:** The Chicago Board Options Exchange, another futures exchange. The CBOE lists options on more than 1,200 widely held stocks. In addition to stock options, the CBOE lists stock index options (e.g., the S&P 100 Index Option, abbreviated OEX), interest rate options, long-term options called LEAPS, and sector index options.

**http://www.cmegroup.com:** 芝加哥商品交易所提供四个主要产品领域的期货及期货期权：利率、股票指数、外汇和商品。这些商品包括牛肉、乳制品、林产品以及生猪。**

<!--en-->
**http://www.cmegroup.com:** The Chicago Mercantile Exchange, which offers futures and options on futures in four basic product areas: interest rates, stock indexes, foreign exchange and commodities. The commodities include beef, dairy, forest and hog.

**http://www.dailystocks.com:**** DailyStocks.com 自称是最大的股票研究网站。该网站确实提供了一些针对上市公司的研报。

<!--en-->
**http://www.dailystocks.com:** DailyStocks.com bills itself as the biggest website for stock research. The site does have some research reports available for public companies.

**http://www.earningsbase.com:** 一个提供华尔街及经济信息的好新闻网站。它还解读“传闻数据”，即分析师和经济专家对企业盈利及经济指标的实际走势的预测。**

<!--en-->
**http://www.earningsbase.com:** Nice news site for Wall Street and economic information. Also provides insight on "Whisper numbers," what analysts and economic experts predict will actually happen as far as corporate earnings and economic indicators.

**http://www.quote.com/home.action:** 该网站允许您免费创建最多包含10只股票的投顾组合并对其进行跟踪。此外还能查看股票的评级变动以及当日交易最活跃的股票。**http://thomsonreuters.com/products_services/financial/financial_products/investment_management/market_data_content/first_call:** First Call会汇总分析师的预测与评级，并提供相关数据。在撰写有关公司盈利预测的文章，或想了解分析师群体是否真的改变了其股票评级标准时，查阅这些数据会很有帮助。不过，这项服务需要付费。

<!--en-->
**http://www.quote.com/home.action:** This site allows you to create a portfolio of up to 10 stocks and track them for free. Can also review stock upgrades and downgrades and most-active stocks trading on the day.
**http://thomsonreuters.com/products_services/financial/financial_products/investment_management/market_data_content/first_call:** First Call compiles analysts' estimates and ratings and provides these numbers. Good to check them when you're writing about a company's earnings estimates or whether the analyst community has actually changed how it rates stocks. This costs money, however.

**http://www.adviserinfo.sec.gov/IAPD/Content/IapdMain/iapd_SiteMap.aspx:** 由美国证券交易委员会运营的投资顾问公开披露网站。您可以在该网站上搜索特定的投资顾问公司，并查看该公司的ADV表格。投资顾问需提交ADV表格以便在SEC及/或各州进行注册。ADV表格中包含有关投资顾问及其业务运营的信息，同时还列有与该顾问及其核心人员相关的某些纪律处分事件的披露内容。**

<!--en-->
**http://www.adviserinfo.sec.gov/IAPD/Content/IapdMain/iapd_SiteMap.aspx:** The Investment Advisor Public Disclosure web site run by the Securities and Exchange Commission. You can search for an investment adviser firm on this website and view that firm's Form ADV. Investment advisers file Form ADV to register with the SEC and/or the states. Form ADV contains information about an investment adviser and its business operations. Form ADV also contains disclosure about certain disciplinary events involving the adviser and its key personnel.

**http://www.djaverages.com:**** 如果您需要了解道琼斯股票指数中的某一只走势如何，这里正是您该查看的地方。它既追踪行业指数，也追踪更广泛的市场指数。

<!--en-->
**http://www.djaverages.com:** If you need to find out how one of the Dow Jones stock indexes is moving, this is the place to go. Tracks the industry indexes as well as the broader market indexes.

**http://moneycentral.msn.com/investor/research/welcome.asp:**** 一个用于追踪内幕买卖的不错网站。该网站列出了内幕买卖最频繁的Top 10公司。点击对应公司的股票代码即可查看实际的交易记录。

<!--en-->
**http://moneycentral.msn.com/investor/research/welcome.asp:** Nice site for tracking insider buying and selling. This site lists the top 10 companies for insider buying and insider selling. Click on the stock ticker for the company to see the actual transactions.

**http://www.ipofinancial.com:** 关于希望转为上市公司的非公众公司的有用信息，包括它们计划向公众出售股票的日程表。366 • 网络让这一切更加便捷

<!--en-->
**http://www.ipofinancial.com:** Good information about private companies wanting to convert to public status, including a calendar of when they plan to sell stock to the public.
366 • The Web Makes it Easier

http://www.kcbt.com: 堪萨斯城商品交易所被粮食仓库、出口商、磨坊主及生产商用来通过买卖期货和期权来保护自身的现金头寸。股市投资者也会使用KCBT的各类产品。不过，对于许多KCBT的会员而言，现金粮食交易依然是他们的核心业务。

<!--en-->
http://www.kcbt.com: The Kansas City Board of Trade is used by grain elevators, exporters, millers and producers to protect their cash positions by buying or selling futures and options. Stock market investors also utilize KCBT products. Nonetheless, cash grain trading is still the core business of many of KCBT's members.

http://www.moneypage.com: 这是一个不错的网站，提供了关于投资及其他主题的基础介绍。其中还有针对股票市场新手的入门指南。

<!--en-->
http://www.moneypage.com: Nice site with basic background on investing as well as other topics. There is a guide to getting started to investing that is a primer for everyone new to the stock market.

http://www.moodys.com/cust/default.asp: 穆迪投资者服务公司的网站，提供债券发行的评级与研究资料。该网站允许用户通过公司名称查找特定债券发行。

<!--en-->
http://www.moodys.com/cust/default.asp: Website for Moody's Investors Service, which provides ratings and research on bond issues. The website allows you to look for an issue by corporate name.

http://www.morningstar.com: 关于共同基金及其持有股票的信息。这是为您所撰写的公司寻找投资者的好方法。列出了所有共同基金的主要持股情况。

<!--en-->
http://www.morningstar.com: Information about mutual funds and what stocks they hold. Good way to find investors for companies you are writing about. Lists the top stock holdings for all mutual funds.

https://commerce.us.reuters.com/purchase/default.do: 实时获取华尔街大型投行提供的卖方分析师报告。需要用户名和密码。查阅这些分析师报告可能需要付费，但这项服务值得为此付出精力。

<!--en-->
https://commerce.us.reuters.com/purchase/default.do: Real-time access to sell-side analyst reports from the big Wall Street firms. Username and password required. Accessing the analyst reports can cost money, but this service is worth the hassle.

http://www.nasdaq.com: 另一种查找你所撰写的上市公司投资者，并追踪其股票买卖情况的有效方法。

<!--en-->
http://www.nasdaq.com: Another good way to find investors of public companies you are writing about and to track their buying and selling of those stocks.

http://www.finra.org: 财务行业监管局会对违反FINRA规则、联邦证券法律、法规以及市政证券规则制定委员会规章的企业和个人采取惩戒措施。您可在此网站查询任何相关的惩戒措施。

<!--en-->
http://www.finra.org: The Financial Industry Regulatory Authority takes disciplinary actions against firms and individuals for violations of FINRA rules; federal securities laws, rules, and regulations; and the rules of the Municipal Securities Rulemaking Board. Look up any disciplinary action on this site.

http://www.cmegroup.com: 芝加哥商品交易所是期货和期权交易的场所。它还拥有纽约商品交易所。

<!--en-->
http://www.cmegroup.com: The Chicago Mercantile Exchange is where futures and options are traded. It also owns the New York Mercantile Exchange.

http://www.nyse.com: 纽约证券交易所每天都有超过2,800家公司的股票进行交易。

<!--en-->
http://www.nyse.com: The New York Stock Exchange has more than 2,800 companies whose stocks trade on a daily basis.

http://www.standardandpoors.com: 标准普尔的主页，提供债券信用评级与研究报告，以及股票研究内容。标准普尔自称是股市的独立分析机构，因为它不会为所研究的公司提供投资银行服务。该网站上的搜索功能尤为实用，同时还可以查询标准普尔股票指数。

<!--en-->
http://www.standardandpoors.com: Home site for Standard & Poors, which provides credit ratings and research on bonds, as well as equity research. S&P is billing itself as an independent analyzer of the stock market because it doesn't do investment banking for the companies it covers. Search function on this site is particularly useful. Also has access to S&P stock indexes.

http://www.stockpatrol.com: 这是一家面向投资者及股市关注者的较为持怀疑态度的网站。StockPatrol.com 会针对证券市场中的各种有趣、奇特或反常现象进行调查、研究并撰写报道。如果你正在撰写的某家公司曾成为该网站尖锐批评的对象，可以到这里查看。

<!--en-->
http://www.stockpatrol.com: One of the more skeptical websites for investors and those who follow the stock market. StockPatrol.com investigates, researches, and reports on interesting, odd and unusual developments in the securities markets. Look here to see if a company you're writing about has been the subject of one of its scathing exposes.

http://www.valueline.com: 投资界知名机构，负责发布关于上市股票的研究报告。查看这些报告需要订阅者的用户名和密码。

<!--en-->
http://www.valueline.com: A well-known name in the investment community that publishes research on publicly traded stocks. Accessing these reports requires a subscriber username and password.

http://finance.yahoo.com: Yahoo! 网站，可查询任何公司的历史股价。这些历史股价至少可追溯到1970年。输入股票代码并点击“获取报价”，然后点击左侧的“历史价格”。或者使用http://bigcharts.marketwatch.com/historical.

<!--en-->
http://finance.yahoo.com: Yahoo! site that allows you to get historical stock prices on any company. The historical stock prices go back to at least 1970. Enter stock ticker and click "Get Quote," then click "Historical prices" on the left. Or use http://bigcharts.marketwatch.com/historical.

## 监管信息

<!--en-->
*Regulatory Information*

http://www.publicrecordsources.com: 它本身不提供公开记录，但会指引你找到存放所需记录的机构（该网站按州和县分类列出了650多条记录）。Public Records Sources还会告知你获取记录的流程与限制、检索费用等信息。不过，如果相关机构提供免费在线访问服务，你可以直接链接到该网站。

<!--en-->
http://www.publicrecordsources.com: Does not provide the public record itself, but it does point you to the agency that houses the record you need (it's got more than 650 listings by state and county). Public Records Sources also informs you of access procedures and restrictions, search fees and more. However, if the agency offers free online access you can link to that site.

http://www.autoexchange.net/dmv/: 全国各州机动车管理部门的链接。其中一些机构可在线查询车辆登记信息。

<!--en-->
http://www.autoexchange.net/dmv/: Links to all state Department of Motor Vehicle departments throughout the country. Some of them have access to vehicle registration information online.

http://www.bls.gov: 劳工统计局。点击此处可查看有关失业率、工资就业人数以及平均时薪的信息。

<!--en-->
http://www.bls.gov: Bureau of Labor Statistics. Go here to check on information about the unemployment rate, payroll employment and the average hourly rate.

http://www.business.gov: 该网站由小企业管理局及一个跨部门工作组创建，旨在帮助企业更好地与联邦政府沟通。对于寻求商业相关信息的记者而言，它也是一个非常有用的资源。

<!--en-->
http://www.business.gov: Created by the Small Business Administration and an interagency task force to help businesses interact better with the federal government. It is also a helpful site for journalists looking for business-related information.

http://www.sec.gov: 这不仅适用于上市公司的备案文件。“诉讼”与“监管行动”板块也能提供大量有用信息。该网站还提供每日新闻摘要，涵盖委员会近期的各项行动，包括执法程序、规则提交、政策声明以及即将召开的委员会会议。

<!--en-->
http://www.sec.gov: Not just for the filings by public companies. The "Litigation" and "Regulatory actions" sections can also hold great information. The site also contains a daily news digest of information on recent commission actions, including enforcement proceedings, rule filings, policy statements, and upcoming commission meetings.

http://documentresearch.morningstar.com（也在http://www.10kwizard.com）：一个基于订阅用户的网站，可帮助你访问美国证券交易委员会的备案文件。该网站最出色的功能之一便是搜索功能，允许你在所有SEC备案文件中查找特定词汇——这一功能也是SEC近期新增的。这是查找有关个人的信息或城市、城镇相关提及内容的绝佳途径。

<!--en-->
http://documentresearch.morningstar.com (also at http://www.10kwizard.com): Subscriber-based site that allows you to access SEC filings. One of the best features on this page is a search that allows you to look for particular words in all SEC filings—a feature recently added by the SEC as well. Great way to find information about people or references to towns and cities.

http://www.statelocalgov.net/index.cfm: 可访问超过8,000个州级和地方政府网站。该网站非常实用，因为它是为数不多提供多州政府机构以及诸如全国州长协会之类的国家级组织链接的网站之一。

<!--en-->
http://www.statelocalgov.net/index.cfm: Access to more than 8,000 state and local governmentwebsites. This site is useful because it's one of the few places that has links to multi-state government entities and national organizations such as the National Governors Association.

**http://www.commerce.gov:** 美国商务部主页。“附近的商务服务与办事处”下的国家地图提供了指向当地商务部办事处的链接，这些链接可能会很有用。如需贸易方面的经济信息，也可访问此处。

<!--en-->
**http://www.commerce.gov:** Home page for the U.S. Department of Commerce. The country map under "Commerce Services and Offices Near You" has links to local Commerce Department offices that can be helpful. Also go here for economic information on trade.

**http://www.csbs.org:** 由州银行监管者会议提供的州级银行监管机构链接。

<!--en-->
**http://www.csbs.org:** Links to state banking regulators provided by the Conference of State Bank Supervisors.

**http://www.epa.gov:** 美国环境保护局。点击主页顶部的待办事项列表，即可查看该机构发布的法规相关的《联邦公报》公告、支持文件及公众意见，以及各类非监管活动的相关信息。此外还提供一个便捷的环境信息搜索引擎，可通过邮政编码查询受EPA监管的企业名单。

<!--en-->
**http://www.epa.gov:** The U.S. Environmental Protection Agency. Click on the docket on the top of the home page to see Federal Register notices, support documents and public comments for regulations the agency publishes and various non-regulatory activities. Also a nice search engine of environmental information available by ZIP Code, which lists EPA regulated businesses.

**http://www.epa.gov/epahome/regions.htm:** 地区环保局及各州环境监管机构的链接。**

<!--en-->
**http://www.epa.gov/epahome/regions.htm:** Links to regional EPA offices and state environmental regulatory agencies.

**http://www.fedstats.gov:** 来自100多家美国机构的资讯入口。支持按主题、州、地区以及机构名称进行搜索。**

<!--en-->
**http://www.fedstats.gov:** The gateway to information from more than 100 U.S. agencies. Allows you to search by topic, by state, by region and by agency name.

**http://www.fdic.gov:** 联邦存款保险公司是一家负责监管银行存款的联邦机构。这里最实用的信息之一是按照《社区再投资法》要求接受审查的银行的月度清单。点击此处即可查询您所在地区的银行是否正在被审查。此外，还提供各银行的市场份额数据。

<!--en-->
**http://www.fdic.gov:** The Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation is a federal agency that oversees bank deposits. One of the best pieces of information here is a monthly list of banks being reviewed for compliance for the Community Reinvestment Act. Go here to find out if a bank in your area is being looked at. There's also market share data on individual banks available.

**http://www3.fdic.gov/idasp:** 由联邦存款保险公司运营的金融机构名录。可以查询到所有受联邦存款保险公司保障的银行控股公司或其所在地点，搜索结果还会显示该银行的总存款额和总资产。

<!--en-->
**http://www3.fdic.gov/idasp:** Financial institutions directory operated by the Federal Deposit Insurance Corp. Can find any bank holding company or location insured by the FDIC. Search results will tell you the bank's total deposits and total assets.

**http://www.fdic.gov/bank/analytical/stateprofile:** 另一个联邦存款保险公司的网站。该网站会按州提供每州的银行业务状况与经济数据，且数据每季度更新一次，对任何从事银行与金融报道的记者来说都是非常有用的信息来源。

<!--en-->
**http://www.fdic.gov/bank/analytical/stateprofile:** Another Federal Deposit Insurance Corp. site. This one has banking and economic conditions for each state, updated quarterly. Good, useful information for any banking and finance reporter.

**http://www.ffiec.gov:** 联邦金融机构检查委员会有权为联邦储备系统、联邦存款保险公司、国家信用合作社管理局、货币监理局以及储蓄机构监管局对金融机构进行的联邦层面检查制定统一的原则、标准及报告格式。点击“执法行动”即可查看相关内容。

<!--en-->
**http://www.ffiec.gov:** The Federal Financial Institutions Examination Council is empowered to prescribe uniform principles, standards and report forms for the federal examination of financial institutions by the Federal Reserve System, the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation, the National Credit Union Administration, the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency, and the Office of Thrift Supervision. Click on "Enforcement Actions."

**http://www.ftc.gov:** 联邦贸易委员会提供了其正式执法行动的链接，同时还设有在线提交信息自由请求以获取相关文件的渠道。

<!--en-->
**http://www.ftc.gov:** The Federal Trade Commission has links to its formal actions, as well as a place to make Freedom of Information requests online for documents.

**http://www.govexec.com/top200/2000top/index.htm:** 想知道所报道的公司是否与联邦政府有业务往来？该网站按政府部门分类列出了规模最大的政府承包商。

<!--en-->
**http://www.govexec.com/top200/2000top/index.htm:** Want to know if a company you're writing about does business with the federal government? This website lists the largest government contractors by agency.

**http://www.statelocalgov.net/50states-secretary-state.cfm:** 该网站包含所有州务卿办公室的网站链接，这些链接可引导用户访问公开记录以及关于公司、合伙企业、企业和其他实体信息的网页，还有统一商法典（UCC）的备案信息。网站 **http://www llrx.com/columns/roundup29.htm** 也提供了各州UCC备案的相关信息。

<!--en-->
**http://www.statelocalgov.net/50states-secretary-state.cfm:** This website contains links to all Secretary of State Internet websites with links to Internet addresses for online access to public records and information on corporations, partnerships, businesses and other entities, plus Uniform Commercial Code (UCC) filings. The site **http://www llrx.com/columns/roundup29.htm** also has info about states' UCC filings.

**http://www.nass.org/:** 另一个可查询州务卿办公室记录的网站，由全国州务卿协会运营。页面左侧也可找到UCC备案信息，目前需要登录才能查看这些内容，注册是免费的。

<!--en-->
**http://www.nass.org/:** Another website that offers access to Secretary of State records. This one is run by the National Association of Secretaries of State. UCC filings are also available on the left-hand side of the page. You have to login to see this information now. Registration is free.

**http://www.ncua.gov:** 国家信用合作社管理局是由总统任命并经美国参议院批准的三人董事会管理的独立联邦机构，负责特许设立并监管联邦级信用合作社。点击顶部“数据与服务”菜单下的“信用合作社数据”，即可查找该国任意一家信用合作社的具体信息。

<!--en-->
**http://www.ncua.gov:** The National Credit Union Administration, governed by a three-member board appointed by the President and confirmed by the U.S. Senate, is the independent federal agency that charters and supervises federal credit unions. Click on "Credit Union Data" under the "Data and Services" menu at the top to find specific information about any credit union in the country.

**http://vocserve.berkeley.edu/CenterFocus/CF8guide.html:** 儿童劳动资源指南。该网站列出了您所在州劳工部的联系方式，便于您了解该州的儿童劳动法规相关信息。

<!--en-->
**http://vocserve.berkeley.edu/CenterFocus/CF8guide.html:** A child labor resource guide. This site lists contacts at your state Department of Labor for information concerning your state child labor law.

**http://www.bls.gov/iif/oshstate.htm:** 劳工统计局的网站，用于追踪职业病、工伤及死亡情况。点击对应州即可查看所需信息。

<!--en-->
**http://www.bls.gov/iif/oshstate.htm:** Bureau of Labor Statistics website that tracks occupational illnesses, injuries and fatalities. Click on the state for the information you want.

**http://www.dol.gov:** 美国劳工部的主页上有关于工资、健康计划与福利以及失业率的信息，还列有全美各地劳工部办事处的名录。主页上的统计摘要能提供很好的概览。

<!--en-->
**http://www.dol.gov:** The home page for the U.S. Department of Labor contains information about wages, health plans and benefits, and unemployment. Also has a directory of Department of Labor offices around the country. The statistical summary on the home page is a nice overview.

**http://moneyline.cq.com/pml/home.do:** 很棒的游说者名录，同时还有关于特定竞选活动获得捐款金额的信息。右下角的“快速参考”栏目下有CQ MoneyLine用户指南。

<!--en-->
**http://moneyline.cq.com/pml/home.do:** Nice lobbyist directory, as well as information on how much money has been contributed to specific campaigns. There is a CQ MoneyLine User Guide under "Quick Reference" at the bottom right.

**http://www.census.gov/econ/index.html:** 美国人口普查局的资料索引，涵盖从少数族裔及女性拥有的企业到建筑许可及制造商调查等各类信息。大部分数据都按州和县划分，对几乎所有记者而言都是非常重要的信息来源。

<!--en-->
**http://www.census.gov/econ/index.html:** An index of U.S. Census Bureau information, from minority and women-owned businesses to building permits and manufacturer survey. Much of this data is broken down by state and county, making it vital information for virtually any reporter.

**http://www.irs.gov/taxstats/index.html:** 美国国税局的税收统计数据可在此处查阅。这些统计数据按提交的纳税申报表数量，以及个人、企业和免税组织提交的申报表进行分类。“网络让工作更便捷” • 367 368 • 网络让工作更便捷

<!--en-->
**http://www.irs.gov/taxstats/index.html:** Internal Revenue Service tax statistics are available here. Statistics are arranged by the number of returns filed, as well as returns filed by individuals, businesses and tax-exempt organizations.
The Web Makes it Easier • 367
368 • The Web Makes it Easier

http://patft.uspto.gov: 美国专利商标局。您可以搜索已获批的专利以及专利申请信息，还能查找您所在城镇或城市的最新专利与商标申请记录。

<!--en-->
http://patft.uspto.gov: U.S. Patent and Trademark Office. You can search for issued patents as well as patent applications. Look up recent patent and trademark applications for your specific town or city.

http://www.naic.org/state_web_map.htm: 由全国保险专员协会提供的各州保险部门链接。不同网站的资讯差异较大，有些会提供有关个别公司费率上调的信息，而有些则完全没有该行业的相关资料。

<!--en-->
http://www.naic.org/state_web_map.htm: Links to all state Insurance Departments, provided by the National Association of Insurance Commissioners. The information on the individual sites varies, with some having information about individual company rate hikes and others having no information at all about the industry.

**http://www.treas.gov: 美国财政部。通过URL http://www.treas.gov/topics 可以了解从货币与硬币到财政部通缉名单等各类内容。分别负责监管银行和储蓄机构的货币监理局及储蓄机构监管局可在“局别”栏目下找到。

<!--en-->
http://www.treas.gov: The U.S. Department of Treasury. Use the URL http://www.treas.gov/topics to get discussions on everything from currency and coins to the Treasury Department's Most Wanted List. The Office of the Comptroller of the Currency and the Office of Thrift Supervision, which regulate banks and thrifts, respectively, can be found under "Bureaus."

**http://www.fedworld.gov: 该网站由商务部维护，链接指向数千个联邦政府网站。如果您不知道去哪里查找信息或正在寻找政府雇员，可以来这里。

<!--en-->
http://www.fedworld.gov: A site maintained by the Department of Commerce, this has links to thousands of federal government Web locations. Go here if you're stuck and don't know where to find information or are looking for a government employee.

**http://www.usda.gov: 农业部主页。如果您负责报道农业、食品或林业行业，这里有大量关于影响这些行业近期问题的信息。

<!--en-->
http://www.usda.gov: Department of Agriculture home page. If you cover the agriculture, food or forest industries, this has plenty of information on recent issues affecting all of them.

http://www.utilityconnection.com/page5.asp: 全国各州公用事业监管机构的链接。其中许多是公共服务委员会，能够获取待处理事项清单以及其所监管的公司名单。

<!--en-->
http://www.utilityconnection.com/page5.asp: Links to state utility regulatory agencies across the country. Many of these are public service commissions that have access to dockets and lists of companies they regulate.

http://topics.law.cornell.edu/wex/white-collar_crime: 法律信息研究所维护着该网站，上面列有按州划分的打击白领犯罪的执法机构链接，包括各州总检察长办公室、证券监管机构等。

<!--en-->
http://topics.law.cornell.edu/wex/white-collar_crime: The Legal Information Institute maintains this website with links to white collar crime enforcement agencies by state. Includes state attorney general offices, securities regulators and others.

### 消费者与劳动相关网站

<!--en-->
*Consumer and Labor-Related Sites*

http://activistcash.com: 介绍反消费者权益保护活动组织的概况，以及其巨额资金的来源信息。将这些资金来源拆分到各类活动组织、基金会、名人以及活动界的重要个人参与者身上。

<!--en-->
http://activistcash.com: Profiles anti-consumer activist groups, along with information about the sources of their exorbitant funding. Breaks them up among activist groups, foundations, celebrities and major individual players in the activist community.

http://www.aflcio.org: 该国规模最大的工会。这里有关于工人权利的实用信息，还有按州划分的经济概况，涵盖了贫困、医疗保障以及州预算等问题。

<!--en-->
http://www.aflcio.org: The nation's largest labor union. Nice information on workers' rights, as well as a state-by-state economic snapshot that reviews issues such as poverty, health care coverage and state budget issues.

http://www.alpa.org: 美国航空飞行员协会提供了关于飞行员与航空公司谈判新合同时的最新进展信息。此外，还有相关的演讲和证词可供查阅。

<!--en-->
http://www.alpa.org: The Air Line Pilots Association has good updates on negotiations between pilots and airlines when they're negotiating new contracts. Speeches and testimony are also available.

http://www.cch.com: 商业清算所网站，非常适合查看税收规则的汇总信息。

<!--en-->
http://www.cch.com: The Commerce Clearing House site, which is excellent for summaries of tax rules.

http://www.consumerfed.org: 美国消费者联合会，该组织代表消费者向国会及其他政府机构游说。其主要关注的领域包括食品、金融、医疗保健、隐私、安全与环境卫生以及公用事业，因此如果您对其中某个话题感兴趣，可以访问该网站。

<!--en-->
http://www.consumerfed.org: Consumer Federation of America, which lobbies Congress and other government agencies on behalf of the consumer. Its major concerns are food, finance, health care, privacy, safety and environmental health and utilities, so if you're interested in one of these topics, go there.

http://www.cpsc.gov: 美国消费品安全委员会的首页，在这里您可以获取有关产品召回的信息。此外，您还可以注册，以便在CPSC宣布重大召回时收到通知。该页面位于http://www.cpsc.gov/cpsclist.aspx.

<!--en-->
http://www.cpsc.gov: Home page of the U.S. Consumer Product Safety Commission, where you can find out information about product recalls. There's also a way to sign up to be notified whenever the CPSC announces a major recall. That is at http://www.cpsc.gov/cpsclist.aspx.

http://www.cpsc.gov/cpscpub/pubs/amuse.pdf: 该文件按州列出了负责监管游乐园游乐设施的机构。

<!--en-->
http://www.cpsc.gov/cpscpub/pubs/amuse.pdf: This file lists who regulates amusement park rides on a state-by-state basis.

http://www.clearhq.org: 执照、执法与监管委员会。该讨论板上有着来自全国各地州级监管机构的有趣建议，内容涉及如何更好地为消费者服务。你或许能在那里找到故事灵感。此外，点击“资源”可查找各类职业的监管机构信息。

<!--en-->
http://www.clearhq.org: Council on Licensure, Enforcement and Regulation. The discussion board has interesting submissions from state regulators across the country on how to better serve consumers. You might find a story idea there. Also, click on "Resources" to find regulatory boards of professions.

http://www.ebri.org: 员工福利研究协会是唯一一家致力于经济安全与员工福利方面的数据发布、政策研究及教育工作的非营利性、无党派组织。此处可查阅有关员工福利的研究成果。

<!--en-->
http://www.ebri.org: The Employee Benefit Research Institute is the only nonprofit, nonpartisan organization committed exclusively to data dissemination, policy research and education on economic security and employee benefits. Research is available here on employee benefits.

http://www.dot.gov: 正在寻找有关汽车召回的信息？请访问美国交通部及国家公路交通安全管理局的网站。如果您从事汽车行业，或者货运业是您所在地区经济的重要支柱，可在此处查找相关信息。

<!--en-->
http://www.dot.gov: Looking for information about auto recalls? Go to the Department of Transportation and the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration. If you cover the auto industry, or if trucking is a major part of your local economy, look here for information.

http://www.eeoc.gov: 平等就业机会委员会负责调查针对企业不公平就业行为或歧视行为的投诉。页面左下角的“统计数据”板块提供了该机构所采取各项行动的月度报告链接。此外，还有专门区域展示各类歧视的统计数据，涵盖种族、怀孕、年龄及宗教信仰等方面。

<!--en-->
http://www.eeoc.gov: The Equal Employment Opportunity Commission investigates charges against businesses for unfair employment practices or discrimination. The "Statistics" section near the bottom left of the page has a link to a monthly report on all of the actions taken by the agency. There's also an area for statistics on various types of discrimination, ranging from race and pregnancy to age and religious beliefs.

http://www.fda.gov/ForConsumers/ProtectYourself/default.htm: 美国食品药品监督管理局推出的一个优秀网站，介绍了该机构针对网上销售药品及医疗产品所采取的措施。位于www.fda.gov,的FDA主页上也列出了药品召回信息。

<!--en-->
http://www.fda.gov/ForConsumers/ProtectYourself/default.htm: Nice website from the Food and Drug Administration about the action taken by the agency against the selling of medicine and medical products online. The FDA's home page, located at www.fda.gov, also lists drug recalls.

http://www.fda.gov: FDA网站，可查询其关于食品、药品、医疗设备、动物饲料、化妆品以及手机等辐射产品的监管相关各类信息。您也可以在此处订阅其电子邮件新闻简报。网络让一切更便捷 • 369

<!--en-->
http://www.fda.gov: FDA site that provides access to various issues about its regulation of food,drugs, medical devices, animal food, cosmetics and radiation-emitting products such as cell phones. You can also subscribe to its e-mail newsletters here.
The Web Makes it Easier • 369

http://www.fraud.org: 国家欺诈信息中心由全国消费者联盟设立，旨在打击电话营销和网络欺诈行为。该网站上有相关统计数据。

<!--en-->
http://www.fraud.org: The National Fraud Information Center was established by the National Consumers League to combat telemarketing and Internet fraud. Statistics are available on the site.

http://www.ftc.gov/bcp/consumer.shtm: 美国联邦贸易委员会的消费者保护主页提供了从身份盗窃到投资等各类主题的链接，对于撰写相关报道的记者来说非常有用。

<!--en-->
http://www.ftc.gov/bcp/consumer.shtm: The Federal Trade Commission's consumer protection home page has links for topics ranging from identity theft to investments that can be useful for reporters writing about these topics.

http://www.ic3.gov: 互联网欺诈投诉中心是由联邦调查局与国家白领犯罪中心共同建立的机构。此处可查询相关统计数据及警示通知。

<!--en-->
http://www.ic3.gov: The Internet Fraud Complaint Center is a partnership between the Federal Bureau of Investigation and the National White Collar Crime Center. Statistics and warning notices are available here.

http://www.ibew.org: 国际电气工人兄弟会网站上有关于工会会员资格以及与一些大型雇主谈判的相关信息。

<!--en-->
http://www.ibew.org: The International Brotherhood of Electrical Workers website has information on union membership and negotiations with some larger employers.

http://www.jdpower.com: 针对汽车、游艇、房屋建筑商、金融服务提供商以及旅游等各类产品的消费者评分。某些市场的相关评分也可查看。

<!--en-->
http://www.jdpower.com: Consumer-based ratings on various products, such as cars, boats, homebuilders, financial service providers and travel. The ratings can be viewed for certain markets as well.

http://www.lemonlawamerica.com/Lemon-Law-Statutes.htm: 一份州级柠檬法索引，这些法律允许消费者在认为购买了有缺陷的汽车、卡车、SUV、游艇、摩托车或其他消费品时进行维权。也可参阅http://www.carlemon.com/lemonstat.html.

<!--en-->
http://www.lemonlawamerica.com/Lemon-Law-Statutes.htm: An index of state lemon laws that allow consumers to fight back if they believe they've purchased a defective car, truck, SUV, boat, motorcycle or other consumer product. Also look at http://www.carlemon.com/lemonstat.html.

http://www.nacaa.net: 全国消费者机构管理者协会是一个总部位于华盛顿特区的非营利性组织，专为政府消费者保护机构的管理人员服务。该网站的亮点在于其会员列表，其中提供了全国各联邦、州及地方消费者保护机构的链接。会员列表仅向会员开放；注册免费，但您的申请必须获得NACAA的批准。

<!--en-->
http://www.nacaa.net: The National Association of Consumer Agency Administrators is a Washington, DC-based nonprofit association for government consumer protection agency administrators. This site is best for its Member List, which provides links to federal, state and local consumer protection agencies across the country. The Member List is only available to members; registration is free, but your application must be approved by the NACAA.

http://www.nasuca.org: 全国州级公用事业消费者权益保护协会，代表40个州及哥伦比亚特区的消费者在州级和联邦机构前维护其利益。其提交的证词与文件清单十分详尽。

<!--en-->
http://www.nasuca.org: National Association of State Utility Consumer Advocates, which represents the interest of consumers before state and federal agencies in 40 states and the District of Columbia. Nice list of its testimony and filings.

http://www.consumeraction.gov: 在页面左侧的“投诉受理机构”一栏中列出了消费者保护团体和机构的名单。

<!--en-->
http://www.consumeraction.gov: Has lists of consumer protection groups and agencies under "Where to file a complaint" on the left side of the page.

http://www.cpsc.gov 和 http://www.fda.gov/safety/recalls/default.htm:：这里有两个不错的搜索引擎，可用于查询美国消费品安全委员会和食品药品监督管理局发布的产品召回信息。两者都可以通过产品名称或公司名称进行搜索。

<!--en-->
http://www.cpsc.gov and http://www.fda.gov/safety/recalls/default.htm: Two nice search engines here for product recalls from the Consumer Product Safety Commission and the Food and Drug Administration. Both can be searched by product or company name.

http://www.osha.gov/oshstats: 职业安全与健康管理局的统计数据页面允许您按行业查看各公司的事故调查报告和检查报告。

<!--en-->
http://www.osha.gov/oshstats: The Occupational Safety and Health Administration statistics and data page allows you to look at accident investigation reports and inspection reports for companies by industry.

http://www.osha.gov/pls/imis/establishment.html: 此页面允许用户通过企业名称搜索 OSHA 的执法检查记录。

<!--en-->
http://www.osha.gov/pls/imis/establishment.html: This page enables the user to search for OSHA enforcement inspections by the name of the establishment.

http://pueblo.gsa.gov: 联邦公民信息中心提供大量在线订购的出版物，内容涵盖从汽车到小型企业等各种主题。该网站由总务管理局运营。

<!--en-->
http://pueblo.gsa.gov: The Federal Citizen Information Center has plenty of publications that can be ordered online about a variety of topics, from cars to small business. The site is operated by the General Services Administration.

http://www.epa.gov/TRI: 有毒物质排放清单是一个记录制造设施中有毒化学品排放与转移情况的数据库。若符合四项标准，相关设施必须上报其有毒化学品的排放情况。该数据库可通过地理区域、设施名称、母公司以及行业进行检索。

<!--en-->
http://www.epa.gov/TRI: The Toxics Release Inventory is a database of information about releases and transfers of toxic chemicals from manufacturing facilities. Facilities must report their releases of a toxic chemical if they fulfill four criteria. This can be searched by geographic regions as well as by facility, parent company and industry.

http://www.nhtsa.dot.gov: 美国国家公路交通安全管理局的官方网站。有关特定车辆及设备的安全问题以及地区性的召回信息，可在http://www-odi.nhtsa.dot.gov/cars/problems/recalls.查看。

<!--en-->
http://www.nhtsa.dot.gov: Home site of the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration. Safety problems with specific vehicles and equipment, as well as regional recalls, are available at http://www-odi.nhtsa.dot.gov/cars/problems/recalls.

http://www.nlrb.gov: 国家劳资关系委员会负责调查企业与工人之间的纠纷。其网站会提供每周处理的案件汇总，页面右下角还有信息自由法案链接（“FOIA”），可指导用户如何申请相关文件。

<!--en-->
http://www.nlrb.gov: The National Labor Relations Board investigates disputes between companies and workers. Its site has a nice weekly summary of cases it's handled, as well as a Freedom of Information link ("FOIA") at the bottom right of the page that shows you how to request documents.

http://www.planetfeedback.com: 在本网站搜索关于任何产品及任何公司的投诉或好评。如果您正在撰写有关消费品公司的文章，这里的帖子或许能为您提供一些写作灵感。

<!--en-->
http://www.planetfeedback.com: Search for complaints or compliments about any product and any company at this site. If you're writing about consumer products companies, the postings here might provide some story ideas.

http://www.uaw.org/: 美国国际汽车、航空航天及农业机械工人联盟的首页上有关于影响其会员的最新新闻的信息，以及该联盟认为重要的与政府相关议题的链接。

<!--en-->
http://www.uaw.org/: The International Union, United Automobile, Aerospace and Agricultural Implement Workers of America home page has information on recent news affecting its members and links to government-related issues it thinks are important.

## 法律信息

<!--en-->
*Legal Information*

http://www.abanet.org: 美国律师协会的主页提供律师查询服务，同时还列有针对少数族裔律师和女性律师团体等专业组织的链接。

<!--en-->
http://www.abanet.org: The American Bar Association home page has a lawyer locater service, as well as links to specialty organizations such as minority lawyer and female lawyer groups.

http://www.lawyersandsettlements.com: 关于针对数十个行业提起的集体诉讼的信息可在此处找到。此外还列有待处理的诉讼清单，对行业记者很有帮助。370 • 网络让这一切更加便捷

<!--en-->
http://www.lawyersandsettlements.com: Information about class action lawsuits filed against dozens of industries can be found here. Also has a pending list of litigation that can be helpful for industry reporters.
370 • The Web Makes it Easier

http://www.bmcgroup.com: 该网站记录了该国一些规模最大的破产案件的法庭文件，包括Conseco、TWA和W.R. Grace等以往的案例。

<!--en-->
http://www.bmcgroup.com: This site tracks the court filings of some of the country's largest bankruptcy cases, including past cases such as Conseco, TWA and W.R. Grace.

http://courtexpress.westlaw.com: 一个注册网站，可让您追踪全国各地的法庭案件，查看哪些案件已被列入审理日程。该网站还提供文档服务，但费用可能较高。

<!--en-->
http://courtexpress.westlaw.com: Registration site that allows you to track court cases across the country to see what's been put on the docket. Also provides a document service, which can be pricey.

https://litigator.lexisnexis.com/Courtlink: 由 LexisNexis 运营的网站，可在线查阅最新案件、联邦及州级法院记录，提供新案件提交时的电子邮件提醒，并具备自动案件追踪功能。您需要注册，且这些服务并非免费。

<!--en-->
https://litigator.lexisnexis.com/Courtlink: Site run by LexisNexis that provides online access to current cases, federal and state court records, E-mail alerts about new case filings and automatic case tracking. You must register, and the services are not free.

http://www.martindale.com: 在全国范围内寻找律师。也可以按律所或业务领域进行搜索。

<!--en-->
http://www.martindale.com: Find a lawyer anywhere in the country. Can also search by firm or area of practice.

http://www.uscourts.gov/courtlinks: 包含从破产法院、上诉法院到地方法院的所有联邦法院的链接。此外还有税务法院和联邦索赔法院等其他联邦法院的相关有用链接。

<!--en-->
http://www.uscourts.gov/courtlinks: Links to all federal courts, from bankruptcy courts to court of appeals to district courts. Also other helpful links for other federal courts such as the Tax Court and the Federal Claims Court.

http://pacer.psc.uscourts.gov: PACER服务中心是联邦司法系统负责美国地区法院、破产法院及上诉法院案件记录电子查询的集中注册、计费与技术支持机构。该服务允许您通过姓名或社会安全号码在破产案件索引中、通过案由名称在民事案件索引中、通过被告姓名在刑事案件索引中、以及通过当事方名称在上诉案件索引中进行全国范围的检索。此项服务需收取费用，但如果您需要深入查找诉讼相关信息，其价值还是值得的。

<!--en-->
http://pacer.psc.uscourts.gov: The PACER Service Center is the Federal Judiciary's centralized registration, billing and technical support center for electronic access to U.S. District, Bankruptcy and Appellate court records. The service will allow you to search nationwide by name or social security number in the bankruptcy index, name or nature of suit in the civil index, defendant name in the criminal index, and party name in the appellate index. There is a fee for this service, but it is worth it if you're doing serious searches for lawsuit information.

http://pacer.psc.uscourts.gov/lookup.html: 一个网站，可让您查询美国某个司法管辖区内的所有县，或按县查询特定司法管辖区。

<!--en-->
http://pacer.psc.uscourts.gov/lookup.html: Website that allows you to search for all counties in a U.S. Court district, or to search for a district by county.

http://www.law.villanova.edu/Library/Research%20Guides/Federal%20Court%20Locator.aspx: 该列表由维拉诺瓦大学提供，其中列出了全国各联邦法院的链接。

<!--en-->
http://www.law.villanova.edu/Library/Research%20Guides/Federal%20Court%20Locator.aspx: Provided by Villanova University, this is another list of links to federal courts across the country.

http://www.isoc.org/internet/law: 关于日益发展的互联网法律领域的信息可在此处查看。如果您是科技记者，这里有该行业法律方面的重要趋势与问题。

<!--en-->
http://www.isoc.org/internet/law: Information about the growing field of Internet law is available here. If you're a technology reporter, this has important trends and issues on the legal aspects of the industry.

http://securities.stanford.edu/index.html: 证券集体诉讼信息中心提供了有关联邦层面证券欺诈集体诉讼的起诉、辩护及和解方面的详细信息。自1995年《私人证券诉讼改革法》通过以来，该中心维护着一份列有在相关联邦证券欺诈集体诉讼中被提及的发行人的名录。此外，该中心还存有这些案件中提交的30,000多份投诉书、诉状、申请文件及其他与诉讼相关的材料副本。如果您正在撰写关于公司因抬高股价而面临诉讼的文章，这里正是您需要的资料来源。

<!--en-->
http://securities.stanford.edu/index.html: The Securities Class Action Clearinghouse provides detailed information relating to the prosecution, defense and settlement of federal class action securities fraud litigation. The clearinghouse maintains an index of issuers that have been named in federal class action securities fraud lawsuits since passage of the Private Securities Litigation Reform Act of 1995. The clearinghouse also contains copies of more than 30,000 complaints, briefs, filings and other litigation-related materials filed in these cases. If you're writing about companies being sued for inflating their stock price, this is the place to go.

http://www.uscourts.gov/Press_Releases: 美国法院系统行政办公室发布的新闻稿。虽然这是联邦法院系统，但其中仍包含大量可针对全国范围内对更多法官的需求进行本地化解读的信息。

<!--en-->
http://www.uscourts.gov/Press_Releases: News releases from the administrative offices of the U.S. Court System. While this is the federal court system, there is plenty of information here that can be localized about the need for more judges across the country.

http://www.westlaw.com: Westlaw的在线法律研究服务。它能够让用户快速便捷地获取大量的法律资源、新闻以及商业和公共记录信息。不过，这项服务需要付费。

<!--en-->
http://www.westlaw.com: Westlaw's online legal research service. It provides fast and easy access to an extensive collection of legal resources, news, business and public records information. However, there is a fee for this service.

## 房地产信息

<!--en-->
*Real Estate Information*

http://indorgs.virginia.edu/portico/personalproperty.html: 各州的房地产记录索引。点击所需州后，网站会将您引导至该州的县级列表，进而进入当地的房产所有权数据库。这对于查询房屋的评估税值极具价值。

<!--en-->
http://indorgs.virginia.edu/portico/personalproperty.html: State-by-state index of real estate records. After you click on the state you want, the site takes you to a county listing, which then takes you to the local property ownership database. Invaluable for finding the appraised tax value of a home.

http://publicrecords.netronline.com: 该网站可查询全国范围内的免费房产交易信息以及大量其他公共记录。

<!--en-->
http://publicrecords.netronline.com: This site has access to free property transactions across the country as well as plenty of other public records.

http://www.realtor.com: 全美房地产经纪人协会网站。可根据价格及其他因素帮助查找全国各地的待售房屋，并提供抵押贷款产品比较工具。

<!--en-->
http://www.realtor.com: Site of the National Association of Realtors. Helps locate homes for sale across the country based on price and other factors, and offers a mortgage lending comparison tool.

http://www.nahb.org: 全国房屋建筑商协会在“住房数据”选项卡的“经济与住房数据”板块中提供了有关该行业的有趣统计数据。

<!--en-->
http://www.nahb.org: The National Association of Home Builders has some interesting statistics on the industry under economics and housing data in the "Housing Data" tab.

http://portal.hud.gov: 美国住房和城市发展部主页，提供有关少数族裔房屋拥有率等主题的报告。

<!--en-->
http://portal.hud.gov: U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development home page that has reports on topics such as minority homeownership.

http://www.huduser.org/datasets/pdrdatas.html: 提供来自各类调查的数据，包括美国住房调查数据、HUD规定的家庭收入中位数标准，以及有关住房歧视、HUD承保的多元住宅房源和公共住房居民等主题的研究成果。它为撰写有关低收入群体住房问题的报道提供了大量有用信息。

<!--en-->
http://www.huduser.org/datasets/pdrdatas.html: Provides data from a variety of surveys, including the American Housing Survey, HUD median family income limits, as well as data from research initiatives on topics such as housing discrimination, the HUD-insured multifamily housing stock and the public housing population. It has great information for low-income housing stories.

http://www.realestate.com: 该网站提供搜索功能，可查看特定街道或地址范围内的房屋销售情况、特定房屋的过往售价，还能比较某一区域内价格区间内的所有已售房屋。并非所有美国县区都包含在这项免费服务中。

<!--en-->
http://www.realestate.com: This site offers searches to look at the sale of homes on a particular street or range of addresses, previous sale prices of specific houses and a way to compare all homes sold in a certain area for a specific price range. Not all U.S. counties are included in this free service.

http://www.zillow.com: 一个允许记者比较整个社区或街道房屋价值的网站。

<!--en-->
http://www.zillow.com: A site that allows a reporter to compare home values for an entire neighborhood or street.

http://policy.rutgers.edu/CUPR: 城市政策研究中心因其在经济适用房、土地使用政策、艺术与文化政策、发展影响分析、城市无序扩张的成本、交通信息系统、环境影响以及社区经济发展等方面的研究而备受认可。点击此处可查看他们针对这些主题的研究成果。网络让一切更便捷 • 371

<!--en-->
http://policy.rutgers.edu/CUPR: The Center for Urban Policy Research is recognized for its researchon affordable housing, land use policy, the arts and cultural policy, development impact analysis, the costs of sprawl, transportation information systems, environmental impacts and community economic development. Go here to see their research on these topics.
The Web Makes it Easier • 371

## 个人理财

<!--en-->
*Personal Finance*

http://www.nchc.org: 国家医疗保健联盟的网站提供了关于医疗成本不断上升的丰富信息，且立场中立。该联盟代表了涵盖1.5亿美国人的各类团体。

<!--en-->
http://www.nchc.org: The National Coalition on Health Care site has great information about the rising cost of health care and is non-partisan. It represents groups that encompass 150 million Americans.

http://www.ebri.org: 员工福利研究机构拥有大量关于401(k)计划等员工福利主题的研究成果。该机构不会为任何提案进行游说或倡导。

<!--en-->
http://www.ebri.org: The Employee Benefit Research Institute has lots of research available about employee benefit topics such as 401(k) plans. It does not lobby or advocate for any proposals.

http://www.401khelpcenter.com: 关于退休计划的客观信息。该网站提供了关于执法行动以及各类退休相关主题背景的详尽资料。

<!--en-->
http://www.401khelpcenter.com: Unbiased information about retirement plans. This site has great information about enforcement action and backgrounds on different retirement-related topics.

http://www.urban.org: 城市研究所提供了有关残疾保险、社会保障及其他相关问题的信息。

<!--en-->
http://www.urban.org: The Urban Institute has information on disability coverage, Social Security and other issues.

http://www.annualcreditreport.com: 该网站允许消费者每12个月向全国三大消费者信用报告机构各申请一次免费的信用报告披露。

<!--en-->
http://www.annualcreditreport.com: The site that allows consumers to request a free credit file disclosure once every 12 months from each of the three nationwide consumer credit reporting companies.

http://www.bankrate.com/finance/credit-cards/understanding-credit-cards.aspx: 消费者关于建立信用所需了解的一切。事实上，bankrate.com 上有大量优质信息，能够帮助商业记者快速掌握个人财务相关知识。

<!--en-->
http://www.bankrate.com/finance/credit-cards/understanding-credit-cards.aspx: Everything a consumer needs to know about establishing credit. In fact, bankrate.com has tons of great information to get a business reporter up to speed about personal finance issues.

http://lectlaw.com/files/ban16.htm: 帮助商业记者了解信用卡、信用报告以及欺诈行为。

<!--en-->
http://lectlaw.com/files/ban16.htm: Helps a business reporter understand credit cards, credit reports and fraud.

http://www.creditorweb.com/articles/understanding-credit-card-terms.html: 又一篇帮助商业记者了解信用卡条款的精彩文章。

<!--en-->
http://www.creditorweb.com/articles/understanding-credit-card-terms.html: Another great article that helps a business reporter understand credit card terms.

http://www.rtohq.org: 进步租赁组织协会，即分期付款租赁行业。该行业曾因收取过高的利率而受到批评。

<!--en-->
http://www.rtohq.org: The Association of Progressive Rental Organizations, the rent-to-own industry. The industry has come under criticism in the past for charging exorbitant interest rates.

http://www.uspirg.org/issues/consumer-protection/predatory-lending: 公益研究小组发布的关于掠夺性贷款的媒体背景资料。

<!--en-->
http://www.uspirg.org/issues/consumer-protection/predatory-lending: Media backgrounder on predatory lending from the Public Interest Research Group.

http://www.fdic.gov/news/news/financial/2005/fil1405a.html: 联邦存款保险公司针对可获偿付贷款机构的指导方针。

<!--en-->
http://www.fdic.gov/news/news/financial/2005/fil1405a.html: Guidelines for payable lenders from the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation.

http://www.mortgage101.com: 提供了关于抵押贷款的基本问题解答以及负担能力计算器。对于撰写房地产市场报道的财经记者来说，它是一份非常有用的资源。

<!--en-->
http://www.mortgage101.com: Has answers to basic mortgage questions and an affordability calculator. It can be a handy resource for personal finance reporters writing about the housing market.

http://www.interest.com: 搜索您所在地区的抵押贷款利率。查找并比较不同的利率及抵押贷款产品。

<!--en-->
http://www.interest.com: Search mortgage rates in your area. Find and compare interest rates and mortgage home loans.

http://www.aaii.com: 美国个人投资者协会，一个非营利组织。业务范围涵盖股票投资、财务规划以及退休资金筹备。

<!--en-->
http://www.aaii.com: American Association of Individual Investors, a nonprofit organization. Stock investing to financial planning and retirement funding.

http://www.aarp.org/money: 美国退休人员协会提供的关于个人财务的新闻与信息，包括退休计算器及相关文章。

<!--en-->
http://www.aarp.org/money: News and information from the American Association of Retired Persons about personal finance, including a retirement calculator and articles.
